title: Non-parallel corpus-oriented cross-language document theme alignment method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a non-parallel corpus-oriented cross-language document theme alignment method, which comprises the following steps of: 1, performing data preprocessing and data enhancement on a non-parallel corpus cross-language data set to obtain document pairs with similar semantics; the method comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a topic inference network, 2, encoding a document to obtain a document vector representation, 3, establishing the topic inference network, and inputting the document vector representation into the network to obtain document-topic distribution; 4, training the network by taking Dirichlet prior loss, intra-language comparison loss and cross-language comparison loss as a joint optimization target; according to the method, by constraining the theme consistency of the same-language documents and the theme distribution closeness of cross-language semantic similar documents at the same time, different-language documents are aligned in a shared theme space, so that cross-language document theme alignment under the non-parallel corpus condition is realized. According to the method and the device, cross-language topic alignment and consistent topic representation can be realized under the condition that parallel corpora or dictionary resources are not needed.
claims: Method and apparatus for non-parallel corpus-oriented cross-language document theme alignment method.

title: Low-resource programming language corpus enhancement method based on cross-language migration
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-language migration-based low-resource programming language corpus enhancement method, which comprises the following steps of: receiving a source language code, and driving a large language model to generate an initial target language code through a two-way retrieval mechanism fusing example guidance and knowledge constraint; secondly, constructing an automatic iterative repair closed loop by utilizing the feedback of a compiler, and carrying out self-correction on codes which fail to be compiled; thirdly, high-quality codes are screened out through automatic quality gating and fed back to a corpus and a knowledge base, and self-enhancement circulation of data and knowledge is formed; finally, the method further comprises an offline model evolution step based on grammar and semantic alignment driven by a compiler, a big language model is trained by collecting preference data generated by an online process, and the ability of the big language model to understand a target language is improved fundamentally. According to the method, the core problems of low quality, poor efficiency and lack of self-evolution ability of a low-resource programming language in code migration are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for low-resource programming language corpus enhancement method based on cross-language migration.

title: Cross-platform calling method and system for corpus training library
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of speech synthesis, in particular to a corpus training library cross-platform calling method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the text content of a to-be-synthesized audio, disassembling the text content to obtain a pause position sequence, selecting a corresponding corpus training library according to a preset language identifier, extracting the pronunciation duration of character phonemes, and calculating the duration of basic phonemes. Text emotion features are recognized through an emotion classification model, a three-dimensional emotion feature vector containing emotion density, emotion variance and distribution entropy is constructed, and a first phoneme adjustment coefficient is determined according to the three-dimensional emotion feature vector to correct basic phoneme duration. And when a difference value exists between the corrected phoneme duration and the target audio duration, carrying out compression processing on the phonemes when the difference value is a positive number, and generating an optimal second phoneme adjustment coefficient sequence and a pause duration sequence by using a genetic algorithm when the difference value is a negative number. According to the invention, the problem of speech speed and pause duration optimization under the preset audio length is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-platform calling method and system for corpus training library.

title: Multi-modal sentiment classification method and system based on corpus enhancement and cross-modal generation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and emotion recognition, and discloses a multi-modal emotion classification method and system based on corpus enhancement and cross-modal generation, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, carrying out the preprocessing and feature extraction of multi-modal data; wherein the multi-modal data comprises a video modal, a text modal and an audio modal; 2, projecting each modal feature to a low-dimensional shared space; wherein video, text and audio modal features are respectively mapped to a unified low-dimensional space through a full connection layer so as to eliminate dimension differences among modals, and an ReLU activation function is adopted to enhance expression ability; and step 3, performing feature enhancement based on a text library on each input modal feature to output the enhanced modal features. The scheme supports single-mode, dual-mode and three-mode input, adapts to diversity of data missing in practical application, and is high in model recognition accuracy.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-modal sentiment classification method and system based on corpus enhancement and cross-modal generation.

title: Cross-modal image and text corpus association analysis system
abstract: The invention provides a cross-modal image and text corpus association analysis system, and relates to the field of image and text analysis. Comprising a data collection and preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a cross-modal association learning module and a model training and optimization module. The data collection and preprocessing module collects image and text data from multiple sources and preprocesses the image and text data; the feature extraction module extracts image and text features by using CNN and NLP models; the cross-modal association learning module enhances the semantic consistency of image and text features through feature alignment, weighted summation, an attention mechanism and a cross-modal interaction unit; the model training and optimizing module adopts an unsupervised learning method to train a model and uses an optimization algorithm to adjust parameters; according to the system, through an innovative cross-modal association learning mechanism and an advanced deep learning model, the accuracy and reliability of cross-modal image and text corpus association analysis are effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-modal image and text corpus association analysis system.
assignee: SOUTHERN POWER GRID ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title: Cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on dynamic window compact convolution transformer
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on a dynamic window compact convolution transformer, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a spectrum feature map of a speech signal, and carrying out the convolution calculation, thereby obtaining a spectrum feature; after position embedding is carried out on the frequency spectrum features, the frequency spectrum features with position information are input into a transformer encoder layer for self-attention learning to obtain initial emotion features and a weight matrix, and importance calculation is carried out on the weight matrix to obtain importance features; inputting the initial emotion features and the importance features into a dynamic window transformer together to dynamically segment a sample, and calculating global context emotion features; and inputting the global context emotion features into a pre-trained classifier to obtain an emotion classification result. According to the method, the requirement for the training data volume is reduced, and the features containing more emotion information can be extracted from the voice.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on dynamic window compact convolution transformer.

title: Cross-corpus and cross-algorithm generative text steganalysis method
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-corpus and cross-algorithm generative text steganography analysis method, which comprises the following steps of: inputting a text fragment into a pre-established and trained text steganography detection model to realize the discrimination of a natural text and a steganography text; the text steganography detection model comprises a word importance semantic coding module, an inter-word association multi-scale sensing module and a ridge regression classification model which are connected in sequence; wherein the word importance semantic coding module is used for extracting semantic features of text fragments; the inter-word association multi-scale sensing module is used for acquiring inter-word association features from semantic features; and the ridge regression classification model is used for distinguishing the natural text and the steganographic text according to the inter-word association characteristics. According to the method, the natural text and the steganographic text can still be accurately distinguished in a few-sample scene, and the performance index exceeds that of an existing method.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus and cross-algorithm generative text steganalysis method.
assignee: NANHAI RES STATION INSTITUTE OF ACOUSTICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Cross-language corpus synthesis method, speech synthesis model training method and related devices
abstract: The invention provides a cross-lingual corpus synthesis method, a speech synthesis model training method and related equipment. The cross-lingual corpus synthesis method comprises the steps of obtaining a cross-lingual text, a target speaker embedding vector and language embedding vectors corresponding to languages contained in the cross-lingual text; determining character embedding vectors respectively corresponding to characters contained in the cross-language text; determining a speech spectrum corresponding to the cross-lingual text according to the language embedding vector corresponding to each language contained in the cross-lingual text, the character embedding vector corresponding to each character contained in the cross-lingual text, and the target speaker embedding vector; and forming a cross-lingual corpus by the voice spectrum and the cross-lingual text. According to the method and the device, the speech spectrum of language switching of the same speaker can be synthesized, so that the cross-language corpus composed of the speech spectrum and the cross-language text is obtained, and the speech synthesis model with higher speech synthesis naturalness can be subsequently constructed based on the obtained cross-language corpus.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-language corpus synthesis method, speech synthesis model training method and related devices.

title: Cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of speech recognition, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, extracting MFCC features and statistical features of a speech signal, taking the MFCC features and statistical features as the input of a system, and representing information highly related to an emotion classification label; 2, the statistical features of the two corpora serve as input of a DNN to be used for training a DNN model, a transfer learning relation from a source domain feature to a target domain feature is established, transformation alignment of the statistical features of the two domains is achieved, and the domain self-adaptive capacity between the features of the two corpora is improved; step 3, according to the confusion degree matrix, constructing a multi-level classification model taking the CNN as a tree node; and 4, taking the aligned source domain data as the input of the CNN-decision tree model to carry out final sentiment classification evaluation.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus speech emotion recognition method based on deep learning.

title: Cross-language vector-based ASEAN region news parallel corpus mining method
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-language vector-based ASEAN region news parallel corpus mining method, wherein the method comprises the steps: classifying articles according to language types by crawling multilingual news website contents; preprocessing the articles in different languages to obtain a chapter set; performing sentence segmentation on the chapter set to obtain a sentence set; coding statements by using a multi-language coding model, to obtain a vector set; calculating the similarity of the statements through the vectors corresponding to the statements to obtain parallel statement pairs; and judging whether the sentences are stored in a comparable corpus or not according to the proportion of the sentences in the parallel sentence pairs in an original article, so as to obtain a large amount of parallel corpora. In the process, a knowledge distillation method is used, so that a large-model cross-language sentence vector model can have better performance under the condition that fewer parallel corpora are used. Finally, the problem that for low-resource corpora in the ASEAN region, no large amount of parallel corpora exist to construct a neural machine translation system, and thus parallel statement mining cannot be achieved is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-language vector-based asean region news parallel corpus mining method.

title: Cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on graph convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on a graph convolutional neural network, and is applicable to the field of speech emotion recognition. The method comprises the following steps of: acquiring two audio databases with emotion tags, deleting the emotion tags from two selected partial samples, performing feature extraction on audios of the two audio databases to obtain a plurality of emotion feature groups, establishing a graph convolutional neural network model, forming an edge between each node in a GCN and a node closest to the node, and finally, connecting nodes and edges to form a new graph, defining the audios as the nodes of the GCN to be input into a two-layer graph convolutional neural network, putting the audios with emotion labels and audios without emotion labels into the graph convolutional neural network to be trained, and finally completing emotion recognition through the voice emotion label probability. The steps are simple, training across multiple databases is achieved, and the accuracy of the image convolutional neural network after training is effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on graph convolutional neural network.

title: Cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on transfer learning and attention mechanism
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of transfer learning, emotion calculation and the like, and relates to a cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on transfer learning and an attention mechanism. According to the method, coding-decoding is used for training on a source corpus, emotion dependence and transmission conditions in a context are extracted through a recurrent convolutional neural network (RNN), and feature parameters such as coding and context emotion dependence are migrated to training of a target corpus. The migration loss is controlled within a certain range through training so as to complete knowledge migration, the operation of coding-context feature parameter extraction-classification is carried out on the target corpus by means of the knowledge of migration learning, and finally the task of judging the emotional state of the speaker on the target corpus is completed, and the problem of insufficient small sample training can be effectively solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on transfer learning and attention mechanism.

title: Cross-platform tax intelligent customer service corpus migration method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-platform tax intelligent customer service corpus migration method and device. The method comprises the steps of removing duplication of a source corpus of an original platform by utilizing a pre-constructed corpus model of a target platform to obtain a standard problem and a similar problem; respectively extracting answers corresponding to the standard questions from a source corpus of the original platform; organizing format data corresponding to each standard problem according to a style template corresponding to the corpus model to obtain a target corpus suitable for the target platform; and migrating the target corpus suitable for the target platform to the target platform, so that the target platform generates an intelligent customer service knowledge base by utilizing the target corpus. According to the method, the corpus of the original platform of the intelligent customer service staff can be quickly and accurately migrated to the target platformof the intelligent customer service staff, cross-platform migration of the corpus is completed, accurate search of the corpus by an intelligent customer service staff system is met, and the satisfaction degree of taxpayers for customer services is gradually improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-platform tax intelligent customer service corpus migration method and device.

title: Cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on adaptive semi-supervised non-negative matrix decomposition
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of emotion recognition of speech, relates to a cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on adaptive semi-supervised non-negative matrix decomposition,and solves the problem that existing cross-corpus speech emotion recognition methods have low accuracy of emotion recognition due to mismatching of a user's speech. As a feature space and a tag spaceshare coding information, speech emotion feature representations which are more discriminative can be learned; differences of the feature representations can be measured via maximum mean difference,so that mismatching of a speaker's speech is lessened; information of the original feature space is retained in new feature representations as far as possible according to the hypothesis of manifold match-up, so that the speech emotion feature representations are more robust. Unweighted mean recall of four groups of cross-corpus speech emotion recognition tasks reaches 43.74%, while weighted meanrecall reaches 43.84%; accuracy of cross-corpus speech emotion recognition is increased effectively. The method of the invention is applicable to the technical field of emotion recognition for speech.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-corpus emotion recognition method based on adaptive semi-supervised non-negative matrix decomposition.

title: System and Method for AI-Driven Patent Infringement Analysis and Prior Art Review of Marketed Products
abstract: An advanced system and method for conducting automated patent infringement analysis and prior art review are disclosed. The system utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, to evaluate target products against existing patents and prior art references. The invention features a data ingestion module capable of processing patent documents, including design patent drawings and utility claim texts, and a machine learning model trained to identify patterns indicative of patent infringement. Additionally, the system includes a novelty detection module that benchmarks product attributes against prior art to assess innovation. Users interact with the system through a secure interface to input product data and receive comprehensive analysis reports, which detail infringement risks, similarity scores, and novelty assessments. By automating traditionally manual processes, the invention reduces the time and cost of intellectual property analysis while increasing accuracy and scalability.
claims: Method and apparatus for system and method for ai-driven patent infringement analysis and prior art review of marketed products.

title: Appearance patent image retrieval method and system based on prior enhanced bilingual meaning
abstract: The invention discloses a priori enhanced bilingual meaning-based appearance patent image retrieval method, which comprises the following steps of: inputting an image-text pair in an image-text multi-modal data set into an image encoder and a text encoder to obtain an image feature and a text feature, and inputting the image feature and the text feature into a Transform to obtain a text-image related feature; after the text-image related features are mapped through a full connection layer, the text-image related features are input to a text decoder, a loss function is used for training, an image subtitle generation network is obtained, and image subtitles are output by the image subtitle generation network; generating binary Hash codes by using the image subtitles, and adding the binary Hash codes into a Hash code database; a user inputs a query image or text to the image subtitle generation network, and an image with high similarity is returned. According to the method, guidance of priori vision and text double-layer semantics is carried out by utilizing a large model, subtitles are generated in combination with an image subtitle generation model, a large number of manual annotation processes are avoided, and the retrieval requirements of users are enriched.
claims: Method and apparatus for appearance patent image retrieval method and system based on prior enhanced bilingual meaning.

title: Worldwide Prior Art and Legal Representative Repository and System for Cooperation Between Worldwide National Patent Offices
abstract: Using the private blockchain, the present invention will permit simultaneous cooperation between multiple, worldwide Patent Offices when reviewing patent applications by having a single repository for 1. prior art submitted by the applicant; 2. prior art identified by the various examiners at the NPOs; and 3. third parties. All prior art for a given patent in examination is stored in one repository (such as provided by the present invention) and it is (at first) controlled by cooperating national patent Offices. The repository can be controlled by other parties that are not national patent Offices. Using the private blockchain, the present invention will permit a patent Owner or Applicant to select worldwide patent law firms to draft and prosecute a patent application in worldwide countries. The patent Owner or Applicant can select which countries he wants to file patent applications in. The patent Owner or Applicant can list specific requirements regarding the background/education/work experience for which patent attorneys should file his patent applications.
claims: Method and apparatus for worldwide prior art and legal representative repository and system for cooperation between worldwide national patent offices.

title: SYSTÈME, APPAREIL ET PROCÉDÉ DE POSITIONNEMENT DE PATIENTS AVANT, PENDANT ET/OU APRÈS DES ACTES MÉDICAUX
abstract: A system for positioning a patient before, during or after a medical procedure can include an arm assembly and a surgical drape for use with the arm assembly. The surgical drape can be configured to be placed around a surgical site where an operative procedure is to be conducted. The surgical drape includes a transparent viewing window, multiple handle covers, and an expandable opening on the top side of the surgical drape. Additionally, the surgical drape may also include adhesive components on the bottom side of the drape that may be independently removed in order to affix the drape around a surgical site.
claims: Method and apparatus for système, appareil et procédé de positionnement de patients avant, pendant et/ou après des actes médicaux.

title: PRIOR ART SEARCHING SERVICE PROVIDING METHOD ON STANDARD PATENT
abstract: PURPOSE: A method for providing a service of searching standard patent leading data is provided to use a database and a webpage, which are constructed by utilizing features of a standard patent in advance, thereby efficiently supplying the service of searching the standard patent leading data. CONSTITUTION: Information for target sentences and clauses of a standard document section of standard patent invention is inputted. A standard document version reflecting the target sentences and the clauses; a date of the standard document version; and contribution information for suggesting the change of the target sentences and the clauses in the standard document version are provided. Information for the standard document version is compared with a leading standard document version. A database is constructed corresponding to information for difference between the target sentences and the clauses.
claims: Method and apparatus for prior art searching service providing method on standard patent.

title: COPY RIGHT ORIGINAL DOCUMENT AND COPY RIGHT SUPPLEMENTAL ORIGINAL DOCUMENT OF THE WORLD FASTEST ULTRA-SUPER COMPUTER DEVICE FOR FULL PAYMENT OF DEBTS OF THE NATION AND MUNICIPALITY (IF BUSINESS, NATION, AND MUNICIPALITY PRODUCES WORLD FASTEST ULTRA-SUPER COMPUTER DEVICE PRODUCT OWING TO PATENT FILING BY COMPANY WITH NO PATENT OWNERSHIP, AND EARNS PROFIT, EVEN STATE ORGANIZATION WILL BE ACCUSED OF CONSPIRACY OF EMBEZZLING AS THE PARTY OBTAINING PROFITS FROM EMBEZZLING OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHT) THE INVENTION RELATES TO COPY RIGHT OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHT THAT CLAIMS PRIOR COPY RIGHT FOR TECHNIQUE OF FULL PAYMENT OF DEBTS OF THE NATION AND MUNICIPALITY WITH VIEW TO ABSOLUTELY 100% OF NATIONAL AND MUNICIPAL INTERESTS
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem of conventional ultra-supercomputers that much heat is trapped and an air-conditioner and a large quantity of electricity therefore are required for cooling, and a speed of information collection is limited due to tape reeling.SOLUTION: By installing a piezoelectric element four-electron magnetic division device, the inventor has arrived at the technique of removing only electric resistance out of electricity for the first time in the world. By introducing the rail motor technique for magnetic pole switching inverter control, which consumes the least electricity in the world, electricity consumption is reduced, and with a technique of a digital circuit including light hydrogen, a high-speed circuit has been completed. A piezoelectric element magnetic body IC tip enables piezoelectric element magnetic body auto repair of disarray of an electromagnetic field. By introducing the world smallest beautiful image device with a neon battery IC circuit tip technique, the path to a new ultra-supercomputer will be started, and the invention relates the copy right original document thereof.

title: MOTEUR RENFORCÉ POUR LA RECHERCHE DE L'ÉTAT DE LA TECHNIQUE DES BREVETS
abstract: A method and system for rating the relevance of pror art references for patent application is provided. The method comprises receiving an electronic version of a patent application from and end-user, comparing the patent application with the contents of a prior art database, identifying prior art references that are relevant to the prior art, and determining a relevance rating for at least one of the identified prior art references.
claims: Method and apparatus for moteur renforcé pour la recherche de l'état de la technique des brevets.

title: Prior Art Notes Associated with Patent Applications
abstract: Improved methods for drafting, preparing, submitting and examining a patent application are described. The system incorporates a web-based tool in which applications are drafted. The web-based tool allows further allows for the submission, association, and display of notes regarding applications. The notes may be text or hyperlinks to prior art references. The relevance of the prior art documents to the patent application may be indicated by visible indicia.
claims: Method and apparatus for prior art notes associated with patent applications.

title: Enhanced Patent Prior Art Search Engine
abstract: A search engine configured to search a database of documents and provide search results to an end user is described. The search engine may be configured to provide the end user with a list of synonyms for terms in the search query submitted by the end user and allow the end user to identify those synonyms which should be included in the search engine. Alternatively or additionally, the search engine may be configured to provide the end user with survey questions, the answers to which, may be used to further define the search query. The database may include notes and/or advertisements that are associated with specific documents in the database.
claims: Method and apparatus for enhanced patent prior art search engine.

title: Scientific and technical literature controllable abstract generation method based on large language model and term clustering
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing and text summary operation and maintenance, and discloses a scientific and technical literature controllable summary generation method based on a large language model and term clustering, which comprises the following steps: S1, term extraction and representation: extracting domain specific terms from an original text summary and a citation text of a target scientific and technical literature to form a term set; s2, obtaining a high-dimensional semantic vector of each term by using a pre-training language model, and mapping the high-dimensional semantic vector to a low-dimensional semantic space through a UMAP dimension reduction algorithm; and S3, adaptive term clustering: adopting a hierarchical clustering algorithm based on density to perform unsupervised adaptive clustering on the term vectors after dimension reduction, automatically capturing potential research aspects formed by key terms in the literature, and forming a plurality of term clusters with independent semantics. According to the scientific and technical literature controllable abstract generation method based on the large language model and term clustering, the problems of key point offset and insufficient controllability generally existing when an existing large language model is used for processing scientific and technical literatures are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature controllable abstract generation method based on large language model and term clustering.
assignee: NANJING UNIV OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Scientific research literature chart data multi-strategy fusion extraction and verification method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific research literature chart data multi-strategy fusion extraction and verification method, and relates to the technical field of crossing of computer vision, scientific data processing and artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a scientific research literature chart image, and carrying out the cutting, size unification, blank region removal, graying, color space conversion and drawing region boundary recognition of the scientific research literature chart image; inputting the processed chart image into a visual language model to obtain a chart type, coordinate axis information, double-longitudinal-axis information, data series information and a graphic element type; selecting at least two strategies of visual language model direct extraction, color separation extraction and state estimation trajectory tracking extraction according to the series number, color distinguishing, line overlapping and double-longitudinal-axis conditions; coordinate mapping, series matching, horizontal axis alignment and numerical value fusion are carried out; and finally, reverse drawing, superposition position deviation verification and structured data output are carried out.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific research literature chart data multi-strategy fusion extraction and verification method.

title: Method for automatically identifying, extracting and aligning multi-modal data of metal material scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention discloses a metal material scientific and technical literature multi-modal data automatic identification extraction and alignment method and device, and relates to the technical field of metal material scientific data accumulation. The method comprises the steps of performing standardization processing on metal material science and technology literature data based on an optical character recognition technology to obtain standardized literature data; obtaining a literature data extraction demand; performing multi-modal data integration on the standardized literature data by using a large language model according to literature data extraction requirements to obtain multi-modal literature data; based on a metal material data extraction rule, according to the multi-modal literature data, performing structured data extraction and alignment by using a large language model to obtain structured metal material literature data; and carrying out data standardization processing on the structured metal material literature data to obtain a metal material AI-ready data set. The automatic identification, extraction and alignment method for the multi-modal data of the scientific and technical literature aims at the scientific information of metal materials, and is efficient and accurate.
claims: Method and apparatus for method for automatically identifying, extracting and aligning multi-modal data of metal material scientific and technical literature.

title: Scientific and technological literature representation and quotation prediction method based on time perception Transform
abstract: The invention relates to the field of scientific and technical literature representation and quotation prediction, and discloses a scientific and technical literature representation and quotation prediction method based on time perception Transform, which comprises the following steps: extracting and splicing literature contents, compressing long text contents by using an extraction type compression algorithm, and retaining key sentences; constructing a literature representation encoder: constructing an input text sequence based on a negative sampling data set, citation-containing literatures and balanced positive and negative samples, improving a SciBERT encoding module through pre-training, outputting a literature initial vector sequence containing citation relation information, constructing a time attention layer TA to perform feature alignment on the vector sequence output in S2, and performing feature alignment on the vector sequence output in S2; mapping the time difference into a time feature vector, fusing the time feature vector with a semantic vector, and encoding the fused feature to obtain a deep interaction representation vector sequence containing the citation literature and the context literature; and a basis is provided for measurement analysis and knowledge discovery based on literature contents.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature representation and quotation prediction method based on time perception transform.

title: Knowledge graph construction method and system for scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention relates to a knowledge graph construction method and system for scientific and technical literature, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the analysis of a chapter structure of the scientific and technical literature through employing a dual-channel fusion strategy of a numbering rule channel and a visual feature channel; segmenting the text content corresponding to the chapter hierarchical tree obtained by analysis into N knowledge units by adopting a self-adaptive segmentation strategy based on semantic integrity, and performing recursive decomposition on academic logic statements in each knowledge unit, atomic semantic units which are connected based on logic operators and marked with logic semantic role tags and chapter semantic role tags are generated, the atomic semantic units are mapped into triples of a graph structure, all the triples are subjected to simplification processing and then fused with the chapter hierarchical tree, and the knowledge graph is generated. Therefore, according to the method, the high-quality and reasonable knowledge graph can be automatically constructed from the structure of the scientific and technical literature, so that the technical problems of incomplete knowledge extraction, low graph quality and inaccurate retrieval and reasoning in the prior art are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for knowledge graph construction method and system for scientific and technical literature.
assignee: CHENGDU BRANCH OF NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific literature information extraction method based on general large language model
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature information extraction method based on a general large language model, which comprises the following steps of: 1, constructing a sample set, preprocessing a scientific literature to be processed, and dividing the scientific literature into text blocks; 2, constructing an initial prompt based on the basic prompt template, the domain expert knowledge and a training subset of the sample set, and obtaining an optimal prompt word through iterative optimization; 3, solving an optimal context example number based on the sample set, and further obtaining a global context example; and step 4, outputting a structured extraction result by the information extraction model for the text block of each scientific literature to be extracted. Under the condition that large-scale data annotation and model training are not needed, automatic extraction of structured information in scientific literatures can be achieved, and the manual annotation and model training cost is remarkably reduced; by improving the quality of the cue word and the context example, the accuracy and the consistency of the information extraction result can be effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature information extraction method based on general large language model.

title: Medical scientific research literature intelligent interpretation method based on large language model
abstract: The invention discloses a medical scientific research literature intelligent interpretation method based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing and medical informatics crossing. According to the method, three input modes of PMCid, XML full text and webpage URL are supported through a multi-source literature acquisition module, and after standardized fields and metadata are extracted through a literature structuring analysis module, a core intelligent interpretation engine based on the '36 policy-medical scientific research logic methodology' is used for analyzing the standard fields and the metadata through eight sub-engines and a multi-node collaborative reasoning chain architecture. And realizing deep structured interpretation of the medical scientific research literature, and finally aggregating and outputting an eight-chapter standard document. According to the method, a professional medical scientific research methodology is systematically embedded into a large language model reasoning process, the problems that traditional manual interpretation is low in efficiency and existing AI tool interpretation is shallow and non-standard are solved, the deep interpretation time of a single document is shortened from several hours to several minutes, and the professionality, standardization and repeatability of an interpretation result are guaranteed.
claims: Method and apparatus for medical scientific research literature intelligent interpretation method based on large language model.

title: Intelligent literature question and answer method and system based on children tumor scientific research large model
abstract: The invention provides a literature intelligent question-answering method and system based on a child tumor scientific research large model, and relates to the technical field of large models, and the method comprises the steps: firstly receiving a natural language child tumor scientific research problem inputted by a researcher, and calling a semantic knowledge path construction module to generate a scientific research problem semantic knowledge path; triggering a literature knowledge matching module to directionally retrieve literatures based on the scientific research problem semantic knowledge path to obtain a matched literature set; calling a dynamic knowledge association module to construct a dynamic knowledge association network; integrating the dynamic knowledge gateway network information and extracting knowledge content of the answer question to generate a question and answer result; and associating and integrating the question and answer result and the network core structure schematic diagram to form final output content, and sending the final output content to the scientific research personnel interaction terminal. According to the invention, the efficiency and accuracy of acquiring literature answers by researchers are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent literature question and answer method and system based on children tumor scientific research large model.

title: Scientific and technical literature entity association extraction and atlas generation method based on natural language processing
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing and knowledge maps, and discloses a scientific and technical literature entity association extraction and map generation method based on natural language processing. The method comprises the steps that scientific and technological literatures are preprocessed, scientific and technological entities are extracted through a multi-mode natural language processing model, and entity disambiguation is completed in combination with context semantics and a domain dictionary; identifying an association relationship between entities based on syntactic analysis and semantic role labeling, and introducing co-occurrence frequency, semantic similarity and domain weight to calculate association strength; constructing an initial knowledge graph, and optimizing a graph structure through redundancy removal, conflict detection and a dynamic updating mechanism; and the scientific and technical literature knowledge graph with high accuracy, integrity and timeliness is generated. The method solves the problems that traditional scientific and technological literature entity extraction is low in accuracy, association recognition is one-sided, and a graph is staticized, efficient conversion from literature texts to structured knowledge is achieved, and powerful support is provided for scientific and technological intelligence analysis and scientific research innovation mining.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature entity association extraction and atlas generation method based on natural language processing.
assignee: XINJIANG RAILWAY VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title: Biomedical literature scientific problem extraction system and extraction method
abstract: The invention discloses a biomedical literature scientific problem extraction system and extraction method, and belongs to the field of biomedical literature data processing.The extraction system comprises a semantic perception and preprocessing module, a cascade logic screening module, a core element abstraction and extraction module and a structured output module which cooperate in sequence; the method comprises the five steps of data access cleaning, cascade logic screening, core element extraction, logic review reconstruction and structured packaging storage, accurate screening is achieved through research normal form recognition, macroscientific problems are extracted through demolecularization reconstruction, bilingual term mapping is synchronously established, and finally ICD-11 standardized JSON format structured data are output. According to the method, non-related literatures are greatly filtered, the scientific research information acquisition efficiency is improved, cross-domain reuse of scientific problems is realized, high-quality data support is provided for biomedical knowledge graph construction and vertical domain AI model training, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. The technical problems that an existing tool is low in retrieval accuracy, extraction of core scientific problems is distorted, and unstructured texts cannot be reused are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for biomedical literature scientific problem extraction system and extraction method.

title: Scientific literature extraction task-oriented field tracing method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature extraction task-oriented field traceability method and a scientific literature extraction task-oriented field traceability system. According to the method, based on an extraction result and a layout analysis result of the scientific literature, the extracted content is quickly and accurately positioned and highlighted in the scientific literature; the phenomenon that the extracted contents of different levels deviate when the extracted contents of the hierarchical structure are traced is solved in a multi-level query construction mode; through a matching mode of table text and paragraph text separation and numerical text and non-numerical text separation, traceability accuracy is improved, and traceability time consumption is shortened. Aiming at the calculation bottleneck (input text length) of the Rianker under long text input and the characteristic that the density of extracted content information is concentrated, a sliding window type chunk strategy is introduced, and the reasoning speed is remarkably improved on the premise of ensuring the traceability precision.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature extraction task-oriented field tracing method and system.

title: Scientific and technical literature innovativeness evaluation method based on large model Agent technology
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature innovativeness evaluation method based on a large model Agent technology, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the hierarchical classification of subjects and research branches for each reference source in a reference data set, determining the subject field code and the specific research branch code according to a subject classification system, and obtaining reference distribution data containing a complete classification label; counting the reference quantity and proportion of each research branch in the reference distribution data, and calculating the spanning degree of the literature among different research branches; the large model Agent comprehensively evaluates the innovation value of the literature based on the spanning degree between the branches and the quoted total number, and meanwhile adjusts the weights of different literatures according to the spanning degree between the branches to generate an innovation value scoring data set; and the large model Agent performs cross validation on the candidate literature list, confirms the validity of the cross-domain breakthrough feature in combination with the quotation number proportion information of each branch, completes final labeling, and identifies breakthrough innovation literatures.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature innovativeness evaluation method based on large model agent technology.
assignee: GUANGZHOU QIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: Trend feature and periodic feature fused scientific and technical literature trend prediction method and device
abstract: The invention provides a trend feature and periodic feature fused scientific and technical literature trend prediction method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining channel sequence data corresponding to scientific and technical literatures and data groups corresponding to the channel sequence data, each data group comprises a plurality of pieces of block data formed by segmenting one piece of channel sequence data; executing a double-path feature extraction step on each data group, wherein the step comprises the following steps of: extracting trend feature data and periodic feature data corresponding to each piece of block data in the current data group; fusing the trend feature data and the periodic feature data to obtain fused feature data; obtaining channel prediction sequence data corresponding to the current data group based on the fused feature data; and splicing the prediction sequence data of each channel to obtain target time prediction data for scientific and technical literature trend prediction. The method can effectively solve the problem that the prediction precision is low due to the fact that an existing time sequence prediction model cannot accurately capture the overall trend of scientific and technical literatures.
claims: Method and apparatus for trend feature and periodic feature fused scientific and technical literature trend prediction method and device.

title: Hotspot technology mining method and system based on scientific and technical literature data
abstract: The invention provides a hotspot technology mining method and system based on scientific and technological literature data, and relates to the technical field of scientific and technological information mining, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining a scientific and technological literature data set containing papers and patent literatures, and constructing a current technical element network through technical phrase extraction and semantic normalization processing; dividing the technical element network segment into a time-serialized technical element network segment set according to time slices, calculating nodes and edge time sequence importance indexes to judge an emerging technical cluster, carrying out dynamic graph representation learning and future associated edge prediction on the set, generating a potential technical combination prediction set, and evaluating the potential technical combination prediction set; and finally, generating an emerging technology theme list and a technology fusion direction list in combination with an emerging technology cluster node growth trend and a prediction association edge evaluation result, thereby improving the accuracy, comprehensiveness and foresight of hotspot technology mining.
claims: Method and apparatus for hotspot technology mining method and system based on scientific and technical literature data.
assignee: CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RESEARCH INST GROUP CO LTD

title: College scientific research topic selection recommendation system based on academic literature map and implementation method
abstract: The invention discloses a college scientific research topic selection recommendation system based on an academic literature map and an implementation method. According to the invention, through the interdisciplinary association mining module, academic resources in different disciplinary fields can be deeply integrated, and scientific researchers are helped to discover cross innovation points which are difficult to perceive in a traditional single-disciplinary perspective. By means of abundant entity relation networks in an academic literature map, the system can accurately capture potential association among keywords, technical methods and research requirements of different subjects, guide scientific researchers to find a new research direction from cross-domain cooperation, effectively break subject barriers and push frontier exploration of multidisciplinary fusion. Meanwhile, the research conclusion conflict detection module can sensitively recognize conclusion differences or conflicts for the same scientific problem in existing literatures, a breakthrough entry point is provided for scientific research topic selection, researchers are prevented from repeatedly inputting in the existing consensus field, and the originality and perspectiveness of research are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for college scientific research topic selection recommendation system based on academic literature map and implementation method.

title: Entity pair guided scientific and technical literature document level relation extraction method and system
abstract: The invention provides an entity pair guided scientific and technical literature document level relation extraction method and system, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the entity recognition of an input scientific and technical literature document, and obtaining an entity set in the scientific and technical literature document; based on an entity pair pre-screening mechanism of multiple sampling and similarity verification, screening out a candidate entity pair set from all possible entity pairs of the entity set; then generating enhanced relation description fusing corresponding entity type information and relation semantics between the entity pairs; based on a pre-constructed relation semantic knowledge base, a double-layer filtering mechanism is adopted, and a corresponding fine screening candidate relation set is retrieved for each enhanced relation description; and guiding the large language model to perform triple fact judgment by using detailed semantic description of the candidate relationship to obtain an output result. According to the method, high-precision relation extraction is ensured, and meanwhile, the calculation overhead of long text processing is remarkably reduced, so that scientific and technical literature document-level relation extraction is more accurate and efficient.
claims: Method and apparatus for entity pair guided scientific and technical literature document level relation extraction method and system.
assignee: CHENGDU BRANCH OF NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Model performance analysis and authenticity discrimination method in scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention discloses a model performance analysis and authenticity discrimination method in scientific and technical literatures, and relates to the field of paper intelligent analysis, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal information in a paper; extracting parameter data of the target model and inputting the parameter data into the training budget calculation model and the reasoning budget calculation model to obtain a training budget and a reasoning budget; extracting parameter data of the baseline model as a comparison and obtaining a training budget and a reasoning budget; obtaining performance improvement parameters of the target model relative to the baseline model in the thesis; and inputting the training budget and the reasoning budget of the target model and the baseline model and the performance improvement parameters into a comparison model, and outputting the actual performance improvement reason category of the target model in the thesis based on the comparison model. According to the invention, whether the model performance improvement is derived from algorithm improvement or computing power stacking can be effectively distinguished; meanwhile, the possibility of data counterfeiting is distinguished through consistency comparison of experimental instruments and data; and the possible problem of image counterfeiting or beautifying in the paper is identified by combining image processing.
claims: Method and apparatus for model performance analysis and authenticity discrimination method in scientific and technical literature.
assignee: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title: General scientific research entity corpus construction method and device based on scientific and technical literature and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a general scientific research entity corpus construction method and device based on scientific and technical literature and a medium, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing and knowledge engineering. Performing automatic pre-labeling of general scientific research entities on the scientific and technical literature abstract set to obtain an extracted general scientific research entity set and a confidence coefficient set; filtering and screening the confidence coefficient set to obtain a difficult sample set; extracting the difficult sample set to obtain a large language model pre-labeling result set; and obtaining a large language model correction labeling result set and a large language model correction degree set. According to the method and the device, the technical problems of low scientific research entity extraction efficiency and insufficient accuracy caused by incomplete general scientific research corpus construction process and lack of an effective feedback optimization mechanism of a model in the prior art are solved, and the technical effects of realizing a high-quality general scientific research entity corpus construction process and improving the entity extraction efficiency and accuracy are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for general scientific research entity corpus construction method and device based on scientific and technical literature and medium.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Double-layer adaptive fusion method and system for scientific and technical literature knowledge
abstract: The invention provides a double-layer adaptive fusion method and system for scientific and technical literature knowledge, and relates to the technical field of language processing, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a double-layer adaptive fusion architecture; receiving a scientific and technical literature text and extracting a text basic feature vector; the general knowledge layer processing module performs general high-dimensional feature vector mapping, and the professional knowledge layer processing module performs professional high-dimensional feature vector mapping; and the adaptive fusion module performs field confidence calculation, configures an adaptive fusion weight parameter, performs weighted fusion on the general-text high-dimensional feature vector and the professional text high-dimensional feature vector, and applies an output module to perform processing of the scientific and technical literature by using the fused feature vector. According to the method and the device, the technical problem of inaccurate knowledge fusion caused by poor adaptability of a general model, limited generalization ability of a field-specific model and lack of adaptability of static knowledge integration in the prior art can be solved, and the accuracy of knowledge fusion is improved by constructing a double-layer adaptive fusion architecture.
claims: Method and apparatus for double-layer adaptive fusion method and system for scientific and technical literature knowledge.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Four-dimensional index-based scientific and technical literature knowledge automatic labeling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a four-dimensional index-based scientific and technical literature knowledge automatic labeling method and system, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a four-dimensional index architecture; the method comprises the following steps: receiving multi-format scientific and technical literatures through a data input layer, and performing index analysis to obtain a document layer semantic structure, a paragraph layer semantic relation graph, a sentence semantic relation network and an entity semantic relation; performing semantic density calculation and knowledge enrichment region recognition to obtain a knowledge enrichment region recognition result; and establishing a cross-hierarchy semantic association model, performing entity boundary prediction and multi-level labeling on a knowledge enrichment area recognition result to obtain a structured semantic labeling result, and performing visual output and display. The technical problem that in the prior art, scientific and technical literature knowledge recognition is not accurate, hierarchical labeling is insufficient, and consequently the literature processing efficiency and accuracy are low is solved, and the technical effects that precise recognition and multi-hierarchical labeling of scientific and technical literature knowledge are achieved, and the literature processing efficiency and accuracy are improved are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for four-dimensional index-based scientific and technical literature knowledge automatic labeling method and system.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature semantic novelty search method and system based on large-scale pre-training model
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature semantic novelty search method and system based on a large-scale pre-training model, and relates to the technical field of information retrieval, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a query input text and a retrieval constraint condition of a target user, and carrying out preprocessing and standardization processing to obtain a preprocessed query input text; performing multi-granularity semantic coding fusion, and determining a semantic vector of the preprocessing query input text; field self-adaptive fine tuning is carried out, and an optimized BERT model is obtained; constructing an element classifier, and performing element semantic representation generation to obtain an element semantic representation result; performing comprehensive novelty evaluation to obtain a comprehensive novelty rating; and performing automatic difference analysis to obtain a difference analysis result. The technical problem that in the prior art, a retrieval scheme based on a pre-training model adopts single-granularity semantic representation, composite semantic structures of terminologies cannot be fully captured, and consequently the novelty retrieval result is not accurate enough is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature semantic novelty search method and system based on large-scale pre-training model.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature recessive problem identification method based on turning semantics and knowledge graph
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature hidden problem identification method based on turning semantics and a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing, the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a target scientific and technical literature to obtain a structured corpus containing a sentence boundary, a grammatical structure and a term annotation; positioning turning words and identifying semantic questions based on a pre-constructed hierarchical turning word bank to obtain a first candidate question set; processing the negative expression in combination with a negative expression pattern library and a co-occurrence analysis mechanism to obtain a second candidate question set; constructing a science and technology knowledge graph to execute hole detection, and obtaining a third candidate problem set; and after clustering, deduplication and scoring are carried out on the obtained three types of sets, a target scientific and technical literature hidden problem structuring result is output. The technical problem that in the prior art, it is difficult to recognize expression in recessive modes such as turning and negative in the scientific and technical literature is solved, and the technical effects that the recessive technical problems in the scientific and technical literature are precisely recognized, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of recognition are remarkably improved are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recessive problem identification method based on turning semantics and knowledge graph.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technological literature retrieval method and system guided by large model and based on semantic sorting
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a scientific and technological literature retrieval method and system guided by a large model and based on semantic sequencing, the method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a semantic index for each scientific and technological literature in a scientific and technological literature library, the semantic index comprising a generalized research theme and a specific key phrase; 2) for a retrieval demand, retrieving by adopting a basic retriever based on the constructed semantic index to obtain candidate generalized research topics and candidate specific key phrases, and identifying core generalized research topics and core specific key phrases based on the candidate generalized research topics and the candidate specific key phrases under the guidance of a large model; and then reordering the core generalized research subject and the core specific key phrases based on the core generalized research subject and the core specific key phrases as well as the candidate generalized research subject and the candidate specific key phrases. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of scientific and technological literature retrieval accuracy, semantic understanding depth and the like.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature retrieval method and system guided by large model and based on semantic sorting.
assignee: BEIJING ZHIPU HUAZHANG TECH CO LTD

title: Scientific and technical literature question and answer method and system based on self-feedback iterative optimization
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature question and answer method and system based on self-feedback iterative optimization, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a user question, and generating an initial response through employing a retrieval enhancement generation strategy; taking the initial response as iterative input, and performing multi-dimensional evaluation on the iterative input to obtain structured feedback with a plurality of specific feedbacks; extracting an information demand from the structured feedback, and performing supplementary retrieval according to the information demand to obtain supplementary information; performing progressive information fusion on the supplementary information and the iterative input according to the priority ranking of the specific feedback to obtain an optimized content; verifying and correcting references in the optimized contents to obtain iterative output; and judging whether an iteration termination condition is met or not according to the iteration output, if so, taking the iteration output as a final response, and otherwise, taking the iteration output input as the iteration input to carry out iteration optimization until the final response is obtained. According to the invention, the answering quality of academic answers can be greatly improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature question and answer method and system based on self-feedback iterative optimization.
assignee: CHENGDU BRANCH OF NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature table knowledge chain generation method based on large language model
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature table knowledge chain generation method based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of semantic processing, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a table image, a PDF extraction region and a structured source code from scientific and technical literature, and generating initial input information in combination with table context information; calling a multi-modal large language model to carry out table content identification and structured processing; performing iterative self-correction based on the initial HTML structure representation and the original table image and table context information; based on a preset scientific entity ontology, semantic information extraction is carried out on the high-fidelity HTML structure representation; and organizing a knowledge chain according to a preset logic normal form and the entity extraction result. According to the method and the device, the technical problem that in the prior art, identification errors are likely to occur when complex and non-standardized tables are processed, and the content identification precision is insufficient due to insufficient deep logic relation mining capacity can be solved, and the precision of table content identification and structure analysis is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature table knowledge chain generation method based on large language model.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Multi-type question and answer data chain generation method for scientific and technical literature question and answer system
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature question-answering system-oriented multi-type question-answering data chain generation method, which relates to the technical field of data generation, and comprises the following steps: performing content and structure hierarchical analysis on scientific and technical literature to be questioned and answered, and generating an initial question according to literature content characteristics; matching in a question and answer type library to obtain a question-chasing question type set; dynamically selecting at least one question type, constructing a question question and obtaining question answer content; re-matching is executed in the questioning question type set, and multiple rounds of questions are generated; and evaluating a question chain of the initial question-question-multi-round question based on literature content features, performing question chain compensation optimization according to an evaluation result, and generating a question data chain by using the question chain meeting an evaluation target to correspond to questions, answers and analysis data. The technical problem that in the prior art, a question-answering system is difficult to deeply understand scientific research content can be solved, and the technical effect of improving the quality of the question-answering system is achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-type question and answer data chain generation method for scientific and technical literature question and answer system.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific research literature management system and method based on core literature identification and frontier prediction
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of literature management, in particular to a scientific research literature management system and method based on core literature identification and frontier prediction, and the system comprises a data collection and preprocessing module, a core literature identification module, a frontier literature supplement module, a trend analysis and prediction module and an error processing and adaptive engine. And the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for realizing automatic acquisition, cleaning and standardization of literature data. By combining citation network structure analysis and frontier semantic modeling, the scientific research literature management system with high accuracy, interpretability and perspectiveness is constructed, the literature screening efficiency is improved, an intelligent, visual and predictive scientific research auxiliary tool is provided for scientific research personnel, and the scientific research literature screening efficiency is improved. The method can be widely applied to scientific research activities such as topic selection design, review writing and research trend judgment.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific research literature management system and method based on core literature identification and frontier prediction.

title: Time sequence semantic alignment method for stable identification of scientific literature trend
abstract: The invention relates to the field of literature analysis, and provides a time sequence semantic alignment method for stable identification of a scientific literature trend, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a timestamp mark of an existing literature, determining a literature source, carrying out time difference updating, and obtaining synchronous literature data and a synchronous timestamp; inputting the synchronous literature data into a large language model to obtain a keyword list, and performing data cleaning to obtain a target keyword list; inputting the target keyword list into a semantic embedding model to obtain a keyword vector; performing preliminary clustering on the keyword vectors through a comprehensive hierarchical clustering algorithm to obtain a clustering table; and embedding the clustering table again, performing hierarchical clustering by using an average distance method, obtaining a keyword anchor point by changing a distance threshold value, and obtaining a literature trend analysis result through the keyword anchor point and a synchronous timestamp, thereby completing literature trend analysis and display. The scientific literature trend can be analyzed.
claims: Method and apparatus for time sequence semantic alignment method for stable identification of scientific literature trend.

title: Scientific and technical literature type labeling method
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technical literature type labeling method, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, determining type information of literature by utilizing a plurality of information sources based on technologies of character matching, semantic matching and the like, and then, formulating a priority rule according to information source characteristics and method characteristics so as to determine a final type when the type information of the plurality of information sources is inconsistent. According to the method, a multi-source information fusion strategy is introduced to determine the literature type, and the misjudgment risk possibly brought by a single information source is effectively reduced by integrating feature information from different channels. According to the scheme, only key features need to be efficiently coded and stored, and the problem that in a traditional method, resource consumption is too large due to comprehensive collection and processing of all possible information is solved. Under the fusion mechanism, the literature types can be accurately identified and labeled by utilizing limited computing resources, so that the problems of disordered literature management and low retrieval efficiency caused by insufficient information or misclassification are effectively prevented.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature type labeling method.
assignee: NORTH SCIENCE AND TECH INFORMATION INSTITUTE

title: LLM-based scientific literature topic discovery method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature topic discovery method and device based on LLM. The method comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring text representation of each scientific literature sample and encoding the text representation by using a text encoder to obtain a document representation matrix corresponding to the scientific literature sample; 2) clustering the scientific literature samples to obtain clustering results of different themes; calculating an entropy value of each scientific literature sample, and selecting a high-uncertainty sample; 3) calculating semantic similarity between each high-uncertainty sample and other scientific literature samples, and constructing a plurality of triple tasks; fine-tuning the text encoder by using each triple task through a comparative learning method; 4) encoding the text representation of each scientific literature sample by using a text encoder to obtain a document representation matrix corresponding to the scientific literature sample; and 5) performing topic clustering on each scientific literature sample by using the document representation matrix of each scientific literature sample, and generating a clustering tag and a topic division result of each scientific literature sample.
claims: Method and apparatus for llm-based scientific literature topic discovery method and device.

title: Scientific and technical literature intelligent retrieval method based on generative artificial intelligence and related equipment
