abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technological literature intelligent retrieval method and related equipment based on generative artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the multi-layer semantic annotation of medical scientific and technological literatures, constructing a symptom-disease dynamic association map, and building a medical scientific and technological literature knowledge base; performing medical context analysis and multi-modal feature extraction on user query, and generating a unified retrieval vector in combination with Boolean operation nested analysis and semantic alignment processing; performing evidence grading retrieval and clinical scene matching based on the unified retrieval vector to obtain a preliminary candidate literature set, and optimizing the preliminary candidate literature set into a target candidate literature set through fine-grained semantic recalculation; and calculating a retrieval prior probability according to the evaluation dimension, performing knowledge weighted fusion on the candidate literature, and generating a medical science and technology literature recommendation report. According to the method, the medical term association relationship is deeply understood through the association map, the result is ensured to be matched with the patient characteristics through evidence grading retrieval and clinical scene matching and screening, and the accuracy of document retrieval is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature intelligent retrieval method based on generative artificial intelligence and related equipment.

title: Alloy structured information acquisition method based on scientific literature
abstract: The invention discloses an alloy structured information acquisition method based on scientific literatures, and aims to efficiently and accurately extract experimental data of related chemical materials such as alloys from massive literatures and effectively solve the problems of identifying related terminologies of biochemistry and extracting association between chemical components and material performance. The invention relates to a text mining method based on a natural language processing technology. Through a MatSciBERT model, chemical elements, alloy components and related terms are accurately identified from literatures, and association between the chemical components and material performance is extracted. The method comprises the steps of document downloading, data preprocessing, sentence classification, named entity recognition, relation extraction and the like, a structured database is generated, a machine learning model is established through the data, and the alloy performance is predicted. According to the method, material design based on data driving is effectively realized, experimental resources and cost are saved, and the method has important practical application value.
claims: Method and apparatus for alloy structured information acquisition method based on scientific literature.

title: Scientific and technical literature entity comprehensive sorting method based on association network
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature entity comprehensive sorting method based on an association network, and the method comprises the steps: a data collection and preprocessing module which collects academic file data, social network data and data in other fields, carries out the cleaning, denoising and standardization processing of the collected data, and outputs the processed data; the association network construction and weight initialization module is used for constructing an association network based on the preprocessed data and carrying out weight initialization on nodes and edges in the network; and the parameter setting and initial vector calculation module is used for setting related calculation parameters and calculating an initial vector according to the processed data. According to the scientific and technical literature entity comprehensive sorting method based on the association network, multi-source data are integrated, the value of scientific and technical literature entities can be more comprehensively reflected, a more accurate sorting result is provided for scientific researchers, and complex association relationships are effectively mined by constructing the association network and the semantic enhancement matrix.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature entity comprehensive sorting method based on association network.
assignee: SHAANXI XIANGGUANG YUNDUAN TECH CO LTD

title: Scientific and technical literature enhanced retrieval method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technical literature enhanced retrieval method and system, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a query request, and rewriting the query request into a plurality of sub-query requests; vectorizing the plurality of sub-query requests to obtain a query request vector; according to the vector, performing vector retrieval in a vector database to obtain a matched fragment; the vector database obtaining method comprises the steps that scientific and technical literatures in a query request are received, and text content of the scientific and technical literatures is extracted; performing enhancement processing on the text content to obtain an enhanced text; performing block processing on the enhanced text to obtain a plurality of block contents; carrying out vectorization processing on the plurality of block contents and then storing the block contents into a vector database; according to the matched fragments, the query request and the plurality of sub-queries, obtaining comprehensive prompt information; and inputting the comprehensive prompt information into the large language model to generate a retrieval result. According to the method, accurate and complete answer results can be provided, and the accuracy and the retrieval efficiency are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature enhanced retrieval method and system.

title: EXTRACTION AUTOMATISÉE ET SEMI-AUTOMATISÉE DE DONNÉES À PARTIR DE TABLEAUX ET DE GRAPHIQUES DANS UNE LITTÉRATURE SCIENTIFIQUE
abstract: A system and method for automatically extracting data from tables and graphs in scientific literature, particularly in life sciences and healthcare, is presented. The invention employs a hybrid approach combining computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), and a large language model (LLM)-based data extraction module. A neural network enhances accuracy by providing contextual information. The system performs table structure detection, optical character recognition (OCR), Vision Transformers (ViTs) for text recognition, and graph-to- table conversion. An LLM refines the extracted data using advanced prompt engineering. A user interface enables data review, validation, and iterative refinement. The system employs a novel two-stage approach: de-rendering tables and graphs into a machine-readable format, followed by interpretation and user-defined mapping. A knowledge graph enhances extraction by resolving ambiguities and inferring relationships. Designed for scalability and continuous improvement, the invention significantly enhances data extraction efficiency and accuracy, accelerating research and knowledge discovery.
claims: Method and apparatus for extraction automatisée et semi-automatisée de données à partir de tableaux et de graphiques dans une littérature scientifique.
assignee: EVIDENCE PRIME SP Z O O [PL]

title: Comparative learning-based chapter-level pre-training scientific literature representation and query method
abstract: The invention discloses a chapter-level pre-training scientific literature representation and query method based on comparative learning. The literature representation method comprises the following steps: 1) constructing a scientific literature pre-training model which comprises a semantic information representation learning module, a citation network representation learning module, an auxiliary learning sub-module and a semantic-citation information comparison learning module; 2) constructing a semantic information data set and a citation network about the scientific literature; 3) utilizing a semantic information representation learning module to generate semantic information corresponding to the scientific literature according to the semantic information data set of each scientific literature; 4) acquiring deep citation network information of the scientific literature from the citation network by using a citation network representation learning module; 5) minimizing the difference between semantic information and deep quotation network information in the same literature, and optimizing the scientific literature pre-training model through global comparative learning; and 6) inputting the scientific literature a to be processed into the optimized scientific literature pre-training model to obtain the representation of the scientific literature a.
claims: Method and apparatus for comparative learning-based chapter-level pre-training scientific literature representation and query method.

title: Knowledge grading extraction method for scientific and technical literature in coal industry
abstract: The invention provides a coal industry scientific and technical literature-oriented knowledge grading extraction method, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing, the coal industry scientific and technical literature in a PDF format is subjected to plain text MD format conversion, and then a non-text identifier of a line head is deleted to obtain a target coal industry document; defining a language identifier of each level title and an identifier rule base established by level identifiers; training a title grading model; the title grading model identifies a plurality of target-level titles and respective corresponding texts in the target coal industry document; performing identifier addition on the plurality of target-level titles through an identifier rule base, and generating an MD text file in combination with the text; and performing directional knowledge grading extraction on the MD text file by the regularized matching identifier to obtain an extracted text. Therefore, through PDF document processing, the title grading model and the title-oriented identifier rule base, the accuracy and efficiency of coal industry scientific and technical literature-oriented knowledge grading extraction are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for knowledge grading extraction method for scientific and technical literature in coal industry.

title: Policy text and scientific and technical literature collaborative analysis method and device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a policy text and scientific and technical literature collaborative analysis method and device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps that policy texts and scientific and technical literatures in the same field are obtained; performing time sequence division on the policy text and the scientific and technical literature to obtain policy text data and scientific and technical literature data of different time sequence stages; constructing a first topic feature vector and a first semantic information vector of the policy text data in different time sequence stages, and constructing a second topic feature vector and a second semantic information vector of the scientific and technical literature data in different time sequence stages; and according to the first topic feature vector, the first semantic information vector, the second topic feature vector and the second semantic information vector, determining the topic similarity of the policy text data and the scientific and technical literature data in different time sequence stages. According to the scheme, the problem that in the prior art, only from the single content of the policy text, the key information of the policy text is identified or the knowledge graph of the policy information is constructed, and fusion analysis with external scientific and technical literature data is lacked can be solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for policy text and scientific and technical literature collaborative analysis method and device, equipment and medium.
assignee: RES INST CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS CORP

title: Scientific and technical literature theme mining method based on multi-strategy fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature topic mining method fusing multiple strategies, which comprises five steps of generating training data through negative sampling, constructing a deep citation analysis topic model, training the model, extracting a scientific research topic and predicting citation. A deep citation analysis topic model is provided by fusing a deep neural network, a graph embedding algorithm, literature citation relation analysis, a topic modeling technology, a Transform architecture and sparsity constraints, and hidden scientific research topics and knowledge structures in scientific and technical literatures are mined; complex reference relations and deep semantic association among literatures are fully considered, the limitation that a traditional method only pays attention to local connection is overcome, accurate quotation prediction and scientific research theme mining are achieved, deep structures and relations in the literatures can be accurately revealed, and the scientific research theme mining efficiency is improved. And powerful support is provided for application scenes such as scientific research trend analysis, knowledge graph construction and literature recommendation.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature theme mining method based on multi-strategy fusion.

title: Scientific literature data extraction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific literature data extraction method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target literature from a preset literature database; extracting experimental data from the target literature through the trained machine learning model; analyzing the experiment data through a regression algorithm to obtain a prediction experiment result; performing data cleaning and verification on the experimental data to obtain effective data; and outputting the effective data and the prediction experiment result in a preset format to obtain a target file. By adopting the method, experimental data can be efficiently and accurately extracted, and future experimental results can be predicted.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature data extraction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium.
assignee: GUANGDONG SHUIMU QINGYU TECH CO LTD

title: Medical scientific research index recommendation method based on large model literature learning and related device
abstract: The invention provides a medical scientific research index recommendation method based on large model literature learning and a related device, and is applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The medical scientific research index recommendation method based on large model literature learning comprises the steps of obtaining prompt information related to medical scientific research; according to the prompt information and a pre-constructed index database, determining a target medical scientific research index, the index database including a plurality of first medical scientific research indexes, and the plurality of first medical scientific research indexes being obtained by performing medical scientific research index identification on multi-field scientific research literature data through a large language model; and outputting recommendation information, wherein the recommendation information indicates the target medical scientific research index. Therefore, multi-field medical scientific research index recommendation is realized through large models and multi-field scientific research literature data.
claims: Method and apparatus for medical scientific research index recommendation method based on large model literature learning and related device.
assignee: PEKING UNION MEDICAL COLLEGE HOSPITAL CAMS

title: Method and system for analyzing and predicting theme trend of scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature theme trend analysis and prediction method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing scientific and technical literature text data; then obtaining a document semantic vector by using a pre-trained semantic analysis model; performing topic clustering according to the document semantic vector, and extracting a plurality of topics and representations thereof; performing hierarchical clustering on the themes to form a hierarchical structure; dividing the text data according to a time window, and analyzing theme change characteristics to construct an evolution time sequence; and finally predicting the theme intensity change trend. According to the method, the deep semantics of the literature can be accurately understood, the focus field of literature attention is effectively identified, the future evolution trend of the literature is predicted, and prospective guidance is provided for science and technology decision making.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and system for analyzing and predicting theme trend of scientific and technical literature.

title: Scientific and technical literature viewpoint sentence recognition method and system based on emotion enhancement
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature viewpoint sentence recognition method and system based on emotion enhancement, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target literature to be subjected to viewpoint sentence recognition; a viewpoint sentence recognition model is constructed, and the viewpoint sentence recognition model comprises a context feature extraction component, a local text feature extraction component and a weighted emotion feature fusion enhancement component; and inputting the target literature into the viewpoint sentence recognition model, and outputting and obtaining a viewpoint sentence recognition result. The technical problems that in the prior art, a viewpoint sentence recognition model mainly focuses on viewpoint sentence mining in the fields of social media, product comments and the like, depends on dominant sentiment words for analysis, viewpoint sentences which are generally lack of dominant sentiment words in the scientific and technical literatures are generally hard to migrate directly, and adaptability to the scientific and technical literatures is insufficient are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature viewpoint sentence recognition method and system based on emotion enhancement.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature knowledge graph construction method, device and equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a scientific and technical literature knowledge graph construction method, device and equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining scientific and technical literature index data, and splitting the data to obtain a plurality of metadata fragments; performing entity and relation extraction on each metadata fragment; for metadata fragments corresponding to the abstract entities, extraction of research background, method, result and conclusion entities and relationships is carried out based on an abstract analysis model; constructing a knowledge graph based on the extracted entities and relationships; the abstract analysis model training method comprises the steps that an abstract training data set is obtained, for each abstract, a literature to which the abstract belongs serves as a center node, each sentence serves as a node, a side relation is obtained according to a context sequence, and abstract graph data of the literature is obtained; and training an abstract analysis model according to the abstract graph data. According to the method, more accurate and fine-grained knowledge extraction of literature content is realized, and the content of the scientific and technical literature knowledge graph is enriched.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature knowledge graph construction method, device and equipment and medium.

title: Scientific literature experimental data extraction method and device based on large language model
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific literature experimental data extraction method and device based on a large language model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring related literatures in a target field according to a preset keyword through a script code; analyzing the related literature according to a preset cue word through the trained large language model, and extracting experimental data in the related literature; performing data cleaning and verification on the extracted experimental data to obtain cleaned data; and exporting the cleaned data in a preset export format. By adopting the method, the experimental data can be automatically, efficiently and accurately extracted from scientific literatures.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature experimental data extraction method and device based on large language model.
assignee: GUANGDONG SHUIMU QINGYU TECH CO LTD

title: Intelligent scientific research literature analysis system based on AI large model
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent scientific research literature analysis system based on an AI large model, and the system comprises an information input module which is used for obtaining literature analysis demand information of a user; the literature analysis module is used for screening a plurality of finance literatures in corresponding fields according to the literature analysis demand information, inputting a single literature into a pre-trained AI large model to obtain a single analysis result, summarizing all the single analysis results, and performing secondary analysis to obtain a preliminary analysis result; the result feedback module is used for acquiring evaluation feedback of the user on the preliminary analysis result; and the data storage module is used for storing the analysis result output by the literature analysis module and the evaluation feedback corresponding to the analysis result. Compared with the prior art, the problem that scientific research literature analysis efficiency is low in a traditional research mode in the specific finance subdivision field is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent scientific research literature analysis system based on ai large model.

title: Domain concept map construction method, device and equipment based on scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention discloses a field concept atlas construction method, device and equipment based on scientific and technical literatures, and relates to the technical field of natural language process.The method comprises the steps that firstly, on the basis of the scientific and technical literatures, a field seed concept set and a field concept set are constructed through keywords and vocabularies in the scientific and technical literatures; in the process, all domain concept knowledge comes from scientific and technical literatures, expert knowledge does not need to be introduced, and the accuracy of domain concept extraction is guaranteed; according to the method, existing keywords in domain literatures are taken as seed concepts, and similarity calculation methods with different granularities are adopted to respectively measure synonymy, homogeneity and hyponymy between concepts so as to construct a domain concept synonymy relation set, a domain concept homogeneity relation set and a domain concept hyponymy relation set; according to the process, the knowledge boundary between the entities and the concepts in the domain concept set can be clearly determined, and the synonymous relationship, the similar relationship and the hyponymy relationship are constructed, so that the domain concept map is constructed, and the accuracy of the constructed domain concept map is greatly improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for domain concept map construction method, device and equipment based on scientific and technical literature.

title: Self-adaptive knowledge extraction method and system for scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature-oriented adaptive knowledge extraction method and system, and relates to the technical field of knowledge extraction, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a task request and target literature content inputted by a user; performing key information extraction on the task request to obtain a semantic analysis result; performing task type mapping of the semantic analysis result to obtain a plurality of knowledge extraction tasks; performing model weight matching according to the plurality of knowledge extraction tasks to obtain a plurality of task model weights; task model weights are dynamically loaded for the general basic model, and initialization of a task special model is completed; and performing knowledge extraction on the target literature content, outputting a plurality of original extraction results, performing formatting processing to obtain a plurality of formatted results, and outputting and displaying the formatted results to a user. The technical problems of poor adaptation capability and low knowledge extraction result accuracy in a multi-task scene in the prior art are solved, and the technical effects of improving the adaptation capability to the multi-task scene and improving the knowledge extraction result accuracy are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for self-adaptive knowledge extraction method and system for scientific and technical literature.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific literature review generation method and device based on large language model
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific literature review generation method and device based on a large language model. The method comprises the following steps: giving a literature subject and a reference, and sequentially generating a title, a chapter title and an abstract of a literature review by utilizing a large language model; and selecting a reference subset for each chapter by using a large language model, and generating a section title and section content according to the generated title, chapter title, abstract and the selected reference subset. According to the method, the scientific literature review meeting the requirements can be gradually generated on the basis of the given literature subject and the reference literature, the continuity and correlation of the generated scientific literature review can be improved, meanwhile, the efficiency of scientific research is greatly improved, and the use cost of a large language model API is remarkably reduced.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature review generation method and device based on large language model.

title: Aluminum alloy scientific literature automatic knowledge extraction method based on natural language processing
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to an aluminum alloy scientific literature automatic knowledge extraction method based on natural language processing. The method comprises the steps that aluminum alloy material literature data are collected and preprocessed; labeling the preprocessed literature data by adopting a data annotation tool according to a set entity relationship type to obtain an aluminum alloy material literature corpus; constructing an entity naming recognition model based on a bidirectional encoder and a long and short memory network in combination with an attention mechanism and a random vector field; and inputting the aluminum alloy material literature corpus into the entity naming recognition model for training, and extracting aluminum alloy material literature data according to the trained entity naming recognition model. The brand-new named entity recognition model is provided, and information in aluminum alloy material scientific literatures can be accurately and efficiently processed through all built-in functional structures of the brand-new named entity recognition model.
claims: Method and apparatus for aluminum alloy scientific literature automatic knowledge extraction method based on natural language processing.

title: Patent CN220085315
abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and claims in CN220085315.
claims: Method and apparatus for patent cn220085315.

title: Scientific literature-oriented complex table structure identification method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature-oriented complex table structure identification method. The method comprises the following steps of (1) firstly, positioning and cutting table areas in scientific literatures; (2) inputting the cut table picture into an LGPMA network model to perform feature extraction of a text region; (3) the local branch obtains information of the text region through a texture perceptron; (4) the global branch is used for obtaining space information such as distance between text blocks in the global; (5) obtaining initial text block position information by using a mask re-scoring strategy and fully utilizing local and global feature information; and (6) providing a method for dividing vertical parting lines to solve the adhesion condition between the cells. And (7) grouping according to the text blocks to obtain the positions of the text blocks in the table, using a post algorithm to solve the problem of merging the cells, and storing the table in an html format. And the adjacent position relationship between the cells is effectively reserved by using the text region detection based on the network model, so that the recovered table structure is more accurate.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature-oriented complex table structure identification method.

title: Scientific researcher literature information retrieval and evaluation method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a scientific researcher literature information retrieval and evaluation method and device and a storage medium. An association database of a target scientific researcher is obtained based on personnel information of the target scientific researcher, wherein the association database comprises first literature information of at least one piece of cited literature and second literature information of cited literature corresponding to each piece of cited literature; obtaining reference information of each cited document in the corresponding cited document on the basis of the associated database; inputting the reference information into a preset big language model, so that the big language model evaluates the reference condition of the cited literature based on the reference information to obtain reference condition information; based on the citation condition information, generating an evaluation result of the citated literature; therefore, the user can obtain the evaluation result of each cited document corresponding to the personnel information only by inputting the personnel information, and the problem of low manual statistical efficiency can be avoided; and the literature evaluation efficiency of scientific researchers is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific researcher literature information retrieval and evaluation method and device and storage medium.

title: Scientific literature field extraction method and system based on large model
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature field extraction method and a scientific literature field extraction system based on a large model. The scientific literature field extraction method comprises the following steps: segmenting a scientific literature into a plurality of chunks; iteratively generating answers of the to-be-extracted fields, and excluding fragments which do not contain the to-be-extracted fields in chunks; then candidate answers are generated while redundant answer information in different chunks is eliminated and wrong answer information output due to illusion is eliminated in a difference comparison mode, and chunks containing correct answers are fused in an iteration process, so that the problem that answers for different segments are scattered and are not easy to integrate is solved; according to the method and the system, under the condition of limited computing resources, the extraction performance of the generated large model on the scientific literature can be exerted to the greatest extent.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature field extraction method and system based on large model.

title: Scientific and technical literature metadata acquisition method and system based on Internet and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature metadata obtaining method and system based on the Internet and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps that network connection of scientific and technical literature webpages opened by the Internet is established; analyzing the metadata tag based on the scientific and technical literature webpage to identify a target webpage element; triggering a task management mechanism based on the metadata label in combination with a target programming language, the task management mechanism being used for performing data processing on the metadata label; and performing data extraction on a task output result of the task management mechanism to obtain target metadata. The scientific and technological literature metadata acquired in an open manner can be automatically acquired after configuration according to requirements, and can be automatically stored in computer equipment and a medium according to rules, the acquired scientific and technological literature metadata can enrich scientific and technological information resources for scientific and technological personnel to read and learn, and the scientific and technological literature metadata can be automatically stored on the basis of the scientific and technological literature metadata. Literature measurement analysis is carried out, a knowledge graph is drawn, and literature knowledge value mining application is carried out.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature metadata acquisition method and system based on internet and electronic equipment.

title: Scientific and technical literature flow chart entity and relation extraction method based on retrieval enhancement
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature flow chart entity and relation extraction method based on retrieval enhancement, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. A visual encoder is supervised and trained, a vector knowledge base is constructed for the literature database, the target flow chart is received, vector conversion and similarity retrieval matching are carried out, and an image-text matching result is determined; and supervising and training the multi-modal large model, transmitting an image-text matching result to the multi-modal large model, executing identification interpretation and relation extraction, and performing structure conversion to generate a target knowledge graph. The technical problems that a traditional method depends on manual data labeling, time and labor are wasted, the processing requirements of a large number of scientific and technical literatures are difficult to meet, automatic and intelligent extraction means are lacked, and the efficiency is low when large-scale literatures are processed are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature flow chart entity and relation extraction method based on retrieval enhancement.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature recommendation method fusing metadata multi-dimensional features
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature recommendation method fusing metadata multi-dimensional features, which comprises the following steps of: obtaining literature interaction record data and literature metadata, and preprocessing the literature interaction record data and the literature metadata; based on the preprocessed literature metadata, constructing a knowledge graph, and linking the preprocessed literature interaction record data with entities in the knowledge graph to obtain a final knowledge graph; outputting a first embedding vector of each document in the document interaction record data through a knowledge graph embedding model; outputting a second embedded vector of each document in the document interaction record data through the language model; fusing the first embedded vector and the second embedded vector to obtain a final embedded vector of each document in the document interaction record data; according to the final embedded vector, obtaining a user research intention representation vector; and obtaining a recommended literature set according to the user research intention representation vector and the recommended literature list. According to the invention, the accuracy of literature recommendation can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recommendation method fusing metadata multi-dimensional features.
assignee: INSTITUTE OF TIBETAN PLATEAU RES CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature topic classification method based on graph diffusion enhanced hyperedge
abstract: The invention relates to the field of graph deep learning, in particular to a scientific and technical literature topic classification method based on graph diffusion enhanced hyperedge, which comprises the following steps: collecting scientific and technical literature data; extracting text features from the scientific and technical literature by using one-hot coding to obtain a literature feature matrix; constructing a graph data structure by using the obtained scientific and technical literature data; inputting the graph data structure into an original graph-hyperedge generator to relieve unbalance of the number of nodes; inputting the graph data structure into a two-channel hyperedge enhancer based on graph diffusion to relieve node topology imbalance; and training an unbiased classifier based on the enhanced hypergraph and the hypergraph neural network, inputting the enhanced hypergraph into the unbiased classifier to obtain a final classification result, and performing topic classification on the scientific and technical literature. The technical problem that in the prior art, a graph neural network method is adopted, and due to unbalanced scientific and technical literature subject category distribution, scientific and technical literature subject classification is inaccurate is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature topic classification method based on graph diffusion enhanced hyperedge.

title: Scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on large language model
abstract: According to the scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on the large language model, due to the fact that the large language model is based on mass corpus learning on the Internet, a more powerful and accurate semantic understanding effect is achieved, and the precision of scientific and technical literature recommendation can be improved. An existing recommendation technology based on a large language model cannot be applied to the field of scientific and technical literature recommendation, and due to the fact that massive candidate scientific and technical literatures exist, the large language model limits the length of cue words. In order to overcome the defect, the invention provides a thought of'traditional model coarse arrangement-large language model fine arrangement ', and the size of a candidate literature set input by the large language model is remarkably reduced; and meanwhile, a large model fine tuning technology oriented to scientific and technical literatures is introduced, so that the recommendation accuracy is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on large language model.

title: Scientific and technological literature retrieval method and device with definite semantic elements
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technological literature retrieval method and device with definite semantic elements, and relates to the technical field of data processing.The method comprises the steps that a semantic element table and a literature element database are pre-constructed; obtaining a retrieval statement input by a user, and analyzing the retrieval statement to obtain at least one retrieval word; based on the semantic element table, performing semantic element attribution probability prediction on the at least one search word to obtain at least one attribution semantic element set and at least one semantic element attribution probability set; according to the at least one retrieval word, the at least one attribution semantic element set and the at least one semantic element attribution probability set, retrieval matching is carried out in a literature element database to obtain a literature retrieval result, and the literature retrieval result comprises at least one retrieval word and at least one semantic element attribution probability set; the occurrence proportion of the at least one attribution semantic element set of the at least one search word is consistent with the at least one semantic element attribution probability set. According to the method and the device, the technical effect of improving the document retrieval matching definition and the retrieval accuracy is achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature retrieval method and device with definite semantic elements.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Pre-training and fine tuning method and device for scientific and technical literature language model and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a pre-training and fine tuning method and device for a scientific and technical literature language model and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. The method comprises the following steps: processing scientific and technological literature data through a word segmentation model to obtain a scientific and technological literature corpus, taking the scientific and technological literature corpus as a training set to obtain a pre-training language model through knowledge embedding training, pre-designing a training task according to the scientific and technological literature corpus, and obtaining a task instruction set according to the training task; according to the task instruction set, combining a scientific and technical literature corpus to obtain a fine-tuning data set, performing data labeling on the fine-tuning data set to obtain fine-tuning training data, inputting the fine-tuning training data into a pre-training language model, and adjusting the pre-training language model according to the fine-tuning training data to obtain a model head; and summarizing according to the model head to obtain the scientific and technical literature language model. According to the method, unsupervised learning is realized, labels are not needed when the pre-training language model is trained, the labor cost is saved, and the accuracy of model operation is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for pre-training and fine tuning method and device for scientific and technical literature language model and medium.
assignee: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Analysis method of multi-source scientific and technical literature
abstract: The invention provides a multi-source scientific and technical literature analysis method, and relates to the technical field of text data processing. According to the method, text attributes of different types of scientific and technical literatures are spliced, and after stop words are set according to characteristics of the scientific and technical literatures, text data of the scientific and technical literatures are processed; comprising the following steps: converting text attributes into a file form which can be identified by spark-nlp, obtaining tokens, performing text regularization, performing part-of-speech reduction on the tokens, obtaining an IDF list, obtaining a TF-IDF list, clustering the TF-IDF list, obtaining a keyword number list of each cluster, and obtaining weight distribution of each file on K clusters; the method has the beneficial effects that the method is suitable for analysis of scientific and technical literature text attributes of different data sources and various file types.
claims: Method and apparatus for analysis method of multi-source scientific and technical literature.
assignee: SHENZHEN SHIJI CHUANGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title: Performance evaluation method for scientific and technical literature large language model
abstract: The invention relates to a performance evaluation method for a scientific and technical literature large language model, and belongs to the technical field of natural languages. The method comprises the steps that model parameters of a language model are obtained, a test set is preset, and the language model is operated to obtain a model output result; extracting semantic features of a model output result, obtaining standard structure data based on model output according to model parameters, and establishing a mapping relation set through the standard structure data; performing structural integrity test on the mapping relation set to obtain an information integrity evaluation factor; based on the semantic features of the reply information data and the interpretation information data, performing enhancement processing on the semantic features, and inputting enhanced semantic feature vectors into a regression model to obtain content evaluation scores; and performing comprehensive evaluation on the model performance through the information integrity evaluation factor and the content evaluation score. The adaptability of model performance evaluation is improved, and the test technology of model performance verification is perfected.
claims: Method and apparatus for performance evaluation method for scientific and technical literature large language model.
assignee: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Scientific and technical literature review automatic generation method and device
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature review automatic generation method and device, and relates to the technical field of literature review. The method comprises the following steps: dividing to-be-analyzed literatures into a plurality of to-be-analyzed literature sets; the to-be-analyzed literature is obtained based on a preset retrieval formula; performing speech step recognition on the plurality of to-be-analyzed literature sets to obtain a speech step recognition result; sorting the speech step recognition results based on literature importance to obtain speech step sentence sorting results; the literature importance degree is determined based on the literature annual average quoted quantity, literature source periodical influence factors, literature relevancy and literature publication time influence degree of the literature to be analyzed; and determining a scientific and technical literature review text based on the step sentence sorting result. According to the scientific and technical literature review automatic generation method and device provided by the invention, the accuracy of scientific and technical literature review automatic generation can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature review automatic generation method and device.

title: Scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on hypergraph attention and enhanced contrast learning
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on hypergraph attention and enhanced contrast learning, and the method comprises the steps: collecting interaction behaviors between a user and scientific and technical literature from a scientific and technical literature system, and obtaining an unstructured data set; constructing a user scientific and technical literature interaction bipartite graph; a hypergraph attention mechanism is introduced, attention score calculation is carried out on each node and the clustered centroid, feature representation of the user and the scientific and technical literature is updated through the attention scores, and a scientific and technical literature recommendation main model is established; a comparison pair is constructed through a clustering method, node feature representation of the user scientific and technical literature interaction bipartite graph is updated through a comparison learning method, and a comparison learning auxiliary model is established; and performing joint training on the scientific and technical literature recommendation main model and the comparative learning auxiliary model by using an overall loss function to obtain a trained scientific and technical literature recommendation model, and recommending scientific and technical literatures to a user. The method can solve the problem of data sparseness, meet individual requirements and improve the accuracy of scientific and technical literature recommendation.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on hypergraph attention and enhanced contrast learning.

title: Method and device for acquiring key information of scientific and technical literature in earth environment field
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for acquiring key information of scientific and technical literatures in the field of earth environment. The key information acquisition method for the science and technology literature in the earth environment field comprises the following steps: acquiring a text corpus, wherein the text corpus comprises at least one piece of science and technology literature text information in the earth environment field; obtaining a trained language model oriented to the earth environment field; inputting each piece of scientific and technical literature text information of the earth environment field into the language model oriented to the earth environment field so as to obtain knowledge information; and normalizing the knowledge information to obtain normalized knowledge information. According to the key information acquisition method of the scientific and technical literature in the earth environment field, a set of intelligent knowledge acquisition method flow of the scientific and technical literature in the earth environment field is established, and the knowledge extraction efficiency and precision are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and device for acquiring key information of scientific and technical literature in earth environment field.
assignee: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title: Scientific research literature recommendation system based on keyword and graph attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific research literature recommendation system based on keywords and a graph attention mechanism, which fuses the newest graph neural network, natural language processing and multi-view modeling technology, explores representation learning and recommendation of associated information among entities, covers multiple aspects of recommendation, information retrieval, representation learning and the like, and improves the recommendation efficiency. By utilizing the incidence relation between the entities, the method has the characteristics of high adaptability, modularization and high efficiency, and can cope with cold start; an internal algorithm can be replaced according to conditions to achieve the purposes of adaptation and migration; according to the method, global co-occurrence and/or local structure information integration of keywords is realized, the information is transmitted to the user and the article end to enrich respective representation learning, and finally, the accuracy of user and article matching is improved; the method has high adaptability and efficiency, which means that the method can be quickly inserted into other recommendation or information retrieval frames without adjustment and provides various efficient and effective supports, such as recommendation, search/retrieval and word scribing.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific research literature recommendation system based on keyword and graph attention mechanism.
assignee: ZHONGTU KEXIN DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title: Scientific and technical literature research problem sentence identification method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature research question sentence recognition method and system, and relates to the technical field of question sentence recognition, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining Q research question sentences and P non-research question sentences; obtaining a target initial classification recognition model; performing iterative recognition on the scientific and technical literature database to obtain a research question sentence corpus; performing aggregation analysis to obtain a target part of speech and a target structure position; extracting feature words at the position of the target structure to obtain a feature word set; performing word frequency analysis on the feature word set, and constructing a feature weight vector mapping layer; and connecting the feature weight vector mapping layer with an output layer of the target initial classification and recognition model to obtain a target classification and recognition model. The technical problems that in the prior art, a problem sentence recognition model is low in classification precision, and the importance degrees of different feature words cannot be differentiated are solved, and the technical effects that the feature words of the problem sentences and the importance degrees of the feature words are researched in a fusion mode, and the classification accuracy is improved are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature research problem sentence identification method and system.
assignee: NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature-oriented text abstract and simplification joint task method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for combining text summarization and simplification of scientific and technical literatures, which can simplify complex terminologies and increase the readability of articles, so that the terminologies are understood by wide audiences, and the text simplification effect is improved. The method comprises the following steps: (1) taking each part of an Eureka Alert data set as an independent document, and using lt; carrying out doc-sepgt; the PRIMERA model is used as a special input mark, the text input length is set to be 1024, the output text length is set to be 256, and a PLOS data set is used as an intermediate pre-trained PRIMERA model; (2) expanding a data set through data enhancement and introducing extra change and complexity, and introducing semantic diversity and substitution expression of the same content by applying English and deer back translation; (3) exploring additional valuable data as supplement by adopting intermediate pre-training; and (4) introducing a penalty mechanism when training the generative model by using non-likelihood loss, so that the model carefully selects the generated content.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature-oriented text abstract and simplification joint task method and device.

title: Scientific and technological literature recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technological literature recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that text content of multiple scientific and technological literatures is acquired, information extraction is conducted based on the text content of each scientific and technological literature, and multi-type data is obtained; constructing a heterogeneous graph based on the multi-type data; inputting the heterogeneous graph into a target heterogeneous graph learning model to obtain a plurality of author embedding vectors and a plurality of first literature embedding vectors output by the target heterogeneous graph learning model; and based on each author embedding vector and each first literature embedding vector, carrying out scientific and technological literature recommendation to obtain a scientific and technological literature recommendation result corresponding to each author of the scientific and technological literature. According to the scientific and technical literature recommendation method provided by the invention, the research direction data and the traditional metadata are combined into the heterogeneous graph with refined data, so that more refined description data is taken as a hub to mine deep knowledge association between literature and authors, and the accuracy of scientific and technical literature recommendation is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium.
assignee: INSTITUTE OF SCIENT AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION OF CHINA

title: Scientific and technical literature category automatic mapping model training and predicting method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature category automatic mapping model training and predicting method. The training method comprises the following steps: constructing an IPC category and high-association CLC category data set as a training set; inputting the samples in the training set into a pre-training language model to obtain a semantic representation vector; calculating a semantic representation vector by using dot product attention to obtain an interactive representation vector; fusing the semantic representation vector and the interactive representation vector to output an enhanced representation vector; pooling the enhanced representation vector, inputting the pooled enhanced representation vector into a feedforward neural network to calculate the probability, and taking the category of the maximum probability as a prediction category; and the cross entropy loss on the training set is minimized to obtain a trained automatic mapping model of the IPC category and the high-association CLC category. The method has the advantages that the problem that mapping between the IPC category and the high-association CLC category is difficult to establish accurately in an actual application scene is solved through the established training set and the IPC category and high-association CLC category automatic mapping model.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature category automatic mapping model training and predicting method.

title: Scientific literature information extraction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific literature information extraction method and device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps that reference scientific literatures are obtained, an information extraction mode is determined based on attributes of the reference scientific literatures, an information extraction instruction set is constructed based on the reference scientific literatures and the information extraction mode, and the information extraction instruction set comprises information extraction instructions corresponding to different information. Marking the reference scientific literature based on the information extraction instruction set to obtain an information extraction dataset, training an initial information extraction model based on the reference scientific literature and the information extraction dataset to obtain a target information extraction model, and inputting a to-be-processed scientific literature and a user information extraction instruction into the target information extraction model to obtain a target information extraction result. According to the method, the information is extracted from the multivariate and heterogeneous scientific literature, and the accuracy and expandability of information extraction are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature information extraction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium.

title: Scientific and technical literature drawing generation method and system based on diffusion model
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature drawing generation method and system based on a diffusion model, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a picture text description and a corresponding picture in a target literature, and forming a training data pair; training the diffusion model by using the training data; and finally, each component in the picture descriptive text in the training data and the direct relation of each component are extracted, and the extracted components and the relation are fused into the picture generation process. According to the method, the description content of the attached drawings can be understood, the matched attached drawings can be generated, the efficiency of searching, reading and analyzing literatures by researchers can be improved, and the researchers can be helped to better express and present research results.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature drawing generation method and system based on diffusion model.
assignee: ZHIGUAGUA TIANJIN BIG DATA TECH CO LTD

title: Scientific literature clustering method and system based on unsupervised keyword extraction
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific literature clustering method and system based on unsupervised keyword extraction, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, carrying out the effective extraction of the keywords of scientific literatures through comprehensively considering the appearance conditions of words in the abstract and title of the literatures, the semantic similarity of the words and literatures, the characteristics of field keywords, and other aspects; then, according to the characteristics of Chinese and English, the extracted Chinese document keywords and English document keywords are clustered in different embedding modes, and therefore effective clustering of Chinese scientific documents and English scientific documents is achieved. According to the method, the importance degree of the word is considered from multiple aspects, the occurrence condition of the word in the document abstract and title is comprehensively considered, the keyword score is calculated in a mode of automatically adjusting the length of the preset keyword according to the domain characteristics, and more characteristics of the word are concentrated. Compared with an existing unsupervised keyword extraction algorithm, the method has the advantage that the effect is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature clustering method and system based on unsupervised keyword extraction.

title: Multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract generation method and system fusing rhetorical structure
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract generation method and system fused with a rhetorical structure. The method comprises the following steps: determining a rhetorical structure system, marking related work chapters of a thesis sample to construct a training data set, and training a rhetorical structure classifier to establish a mapping relationship between the related work chapters and rhetorical functions; using the trained rhetorical structure classifier to mark a rhetorical function for related work sections of the target literature; and utilizing a related work generation model based on Transform, fusing the rhetorical structure information, and outputting related work chapters of the target literature based on the input abstract chapters of the target literature and abstract chapters of reference literature cited by the target literature. The multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract generation method aims at solving the problems that an existing multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract model is prone to being disordered in rhetorical structure and unclear in precedent and subsequent logic, a specific scene of a multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract is automatically generated through related work sections, and a more accurate and coherent abstract is generated.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-document scientific and technical literature abstract generation method and system fusing rhetorical structure.
assignee: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY
