title: Keyword-based scientific and technical literature labeling method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature labeling method based on keywords, which comprises the following steps of: automatically archiving and uniformly managing the labeling information of the keywords after the labeling information of the keywords is input for the first time; and in addition to keyword source information, keyword application information in related scientific and technical literatures is also added in the keyword annotation information, and the practical application of the keywords is referred. The method comprises the following steps: S1, automatic extraction; s2, automatic integration is carried out; s3, adding a label; s4, unified management is carried out; and step S5: cancelling the label. According to the method, by setting the steps of automatic integration and unified management, the efficiency of labeling the keywords with the scientific and technical literature is improved, the steps are simplified, diversified application and management of the keywords are achieved, and different paraphrasing effects of the same keyword applied in different scenes are achieved, so that the method has a more accurate and effective labeling effect; by setting keyword application information, the purposes of flexibly labeling scientific and technical literatures, referring to and understanding practical application of keywords and the like are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for keyword-based scientific and technical literature labeling method.

title: Language large model-based scientific research literature interpretation method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific research literature interpretation method and device based on a language large model, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining scientific research literature data of a designated field, carrying out the cleaning, labeling and structural processing of the literature data, obtaining a data set, and carrying out the recognition of each piece of sample data in the data set, the triad is composed of a given question, a literature and an answer to the question; a pre-trained GLM language model is utilized, a data set is used for model fine tuning and training, a large language model is obtained so as to adapt to the specific field and semantics of scientific research literatures, and the method comprises the model fine tuning step and the model training step; and when the large language model obtains the to-be-interpreted literature input by the user, inputting the obtained user question or the preset general question into the large language model, and outputting the interpretation result of the large language model. Based on fine tuning and training of the large language model, in combination with the structure and content characteristics of the literature, automatic interpretation and knowledge extraction of the scientific research literature are realized, and the interpretation and understanding accuracy is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for language large model-based scientific research literature interpretation method and device.
assignee: FUJIAN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INFORMATION FUJIAN PRODUCTIVITY PROMOTION CENTER

title: Method and device for automatically generating scientific and technical literature through data combination, storage medium and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a method and device for automatically generating scientific and technical literature through data combination, a storage medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: responding to an interaction operation of a front-end interface, configuring a scientific and technical literature template rule which comprises a content segment definition and a structure definition of the scientific and technical literature, the content segment definition comprises defining the type, the data source, the data item and the segmentation attribute of each content segment; when the obtained data is structured data, arranging the structured data to generate a first class layout file; when the acquired data is non-structural data, generating a standardized second-class layout file from content segments of the non-structural data; and based on a scientific and technical literature template rule, combining the first type of layout file and the second type of layout file into a combined file, and performing format management. According to the method and the device, the problem of automatic generation of complex scientific and technical literatures is solved, different segmented contents are formed according to structured and non-structured classification, and integrated management of documents is realized according to the segmented contents.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and device for automatically generating scientific and technical literature through data combination, storage medium and equipment.

title: Scientific and technical literature semantic feature extraction model training method, feature extraction method and device
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature semantic feature extraction model training method and device, and a feature extraction method and device. Features of scientific and technical literatures are enriched through self-adaptive feature processing in combination with global information and local information; by introducing a multi-head attention mechanism, the relationship between scientific and technical literature characteristics is concerned; by constructing a positive sample and a negative sample, comparing and calculating mutual information between semantic representation of the positive and negative samples in a potential space and a global graph-level summary vector, and constructing loss to update parameters of a graph attention mechanism encoder, the semantic representation learning ability is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature semantic feature extraction model training method, feature extraction method and device.

title: Multivariate relation extraction method for logic perception of scientific literature in material field
abstract: The invention relates to a logic perception multivariate relation extraction method for scientific literature in the material field, and belongs to the field of natural language processing. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, performing named entity recognition on texts such as material components, performance and performance values in material literatures by using dynamic keywords instead of a predefined static mode, and dividing the texts into a material entity group, a performance entity group and a performance value entity group according to the types of entities; and then, dividing clauses by using the number logical relationship and the position logical relationship among the entities, and establishing a mapping relationship between a plurality of material component entities and specific performance value entities by using the logical relationship among the entities in the clauses to complete data extraction. According to the method, material components and specific performance data can be extracted from literatures, data support is provided for subsequent scientific analysis, data does not need to be labeled in advance, complex regular expressions do not need to be written, the use threshold is low, and meanwhile high accuracy and recall rate are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for multivariate relation extraction method for logic perception of scientific literature in material field.

title: Geographic science data demand analysis method and device based on scientific and technical literature resources
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technological literature resource-based geographic science data demand analysis method and device. The method mainly comprises a literature resource database construction step, a data name identification and standardization step, a data resource demand calculation and analysis step and a scientific knowledge graph construction step. According to the method, the close relation between scientific data and scientific and technological literatures is utilized, a large number of scientific and technological literature resources are subjected to carding, statistical analysis and visual expression, the scientific data condition adopted by the actual research of scientific researchers is clarified, the requirements of geographic scientific research on geographic scientific data are systematically, scientifically and objectively summarized, and the scientific and technological data research efficiency is improved. And more scientific and targeted guidance and support are provided for data acquisition, data convergence and data mining.
claims: Method and apparatus for geographic science data demand analysis method and device based on scientific and technical literature resources.
assignee: GUANGDONG INST OF LAND AND RESOURCES SURVEYING AND MAPPING

title: Scientific literature knowledge entity-oriented unsupervised identification method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge entity recognition, and discloses a scientific literature knowledge entity-oriented unsupervised recognition method and system, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the pre-training of a full-word covering model through unlabeled scientific literature text data, and carrying out the recognition of a full-word covering model; a set of knowledge entity representative words and categories thereof is constructed as an evaluation basis by combining comparative learning and clustering methods, and then words in a scientific literature text are predicted by using a pre-trained full-word covering model. And judging whether the word in the scientific literature text is a knowledge entity or not by calculating the similarity between the predicted word and the representative word, and determining the category of the word in the scientific literature text. According to the method, the problem that science and technology text data resources lacking a public data set are difficult to recognize when knowledge entities are recognized in the prior art is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature knowledge entity-oriented unsupervised identification method and system.

title: Scientific and technical literature block function identification method and device based on multi-level semantics
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature block function identification method and device based on multi-level semantics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a block title and a block text of a scientific and technical literature block to be tested; respectively calculating embedding vectors of the block title and the block text; respectively encoding the embedding vectors of the block title and the block body to obtain a block title hidden state description and a block body hidden state description; fusing the block title hidden state description and the block text hidden state description based on an HSAF activation function and an ReLU activation function; and classifying the fusion result to obtain a function identification result of the scientific and technical literature block to be tested. According to the method, the block category labels and functions are automatically extracted, and the working efficiency of scientific and technical literature research is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature block function identification method and device based on multi-level semantics.

title: Scientific and technical literature table extraction method based on XML
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature table extraction method based on XML, and belongs to the field of PDF file information extraction.The method comprises the steps that PDF is converted into DOCX, the DOCX is decompressed to obtain an XML file, text word size nodes and keywords in an XML tree structure are used for filtering interference characters, table title keywords are reserved, table headers are obtained through attribute nodes of cells and are ranked, and the table headers are extracted; and correcting columns of other table rows except the header by taking the column of the header as a reference, extracting data from the previous column of the table row with column missing according to a rule, inserting the data, restoring the structure of the table row, and finally extracting table column data by utilizing an ontology model and storing the table column data. The method is not constrained by the form frame line type of the scientific and technical literature, the associated form data is accurately extracted through the semantic model, the logical relationship of the form is restored, the accuracy and the automation degree of form extraction are improved, and the method is suitable for the scientific and technical literature in different fields.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature table extraction method based on xml.

title: Scientific and technical literature vectorization method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature vectorization method based on deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: generating a sample data set needed by training from scientific and technical literature data through a negative sampling algorithm; secondly, constructing a scientific and technical literature vectorization deep learning network model; then training a scientific and technical literature vectorization deep learning network model by using the generated data, solving model parameters, and obtaining an optimization model; and finally, on the basis of embedded layer parameters in the optimization model, taking the embedded layer parameters as vector representation of scientific and technical literatures. In order to solve the problem that scientific and technical literatures are difficult to effectively characterize in scientific and technical literature data based on a reference relationship, a deep learning network based on an attention model is adopted to realize vectorization feature representation of the scientific and technical literatures. The scientific and technical literature vectorization feature representation obtained by the method can be used for various downstream tasks, such as scientific and technical literature clustering, classification tasks, scientific and technical literature quotation recommendation, graph neural network learning and the like.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature vectorization method based on deep learning.

title: Scientific and technical literature recommendation method
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technical literature recommendation method. A scientific and technical literature knowledge graph is constructed by collecting scientific and technical literature related data, meanwhile, interaction data generated by a user in a system is collected and processed, and a recommendation model fusing user behavior characteristics and knowledge representation is designed. Compared with an existing recommendation model, on one hand, on the basis of natural language query proposed by a user for scientific and technical literature resources, semantic influences generated by user preferences on a scientific and technical literature knowledge graph are analyzed, relation semantic features implied in user information are extracted, and a knowledge representation learning model integrated with relation semantics is established; semantic representation of knowledge such as scientific and technical literatures is improved; on the other hand, based on historical behavior interaction data of the user, semantic influences of the relation and the entity on user preferences are deeply analyzed in combination with a knowledge representation learning model, and a multi-level preference perception recommendation model is established to improve semantic association between the user and scientific and technical literatures.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recommendation method.

title: Keyword extraction method based on long scientific literature
abstract: The invention provides a keyword extraction method based on long scientific literatures. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out statistics on words of the scientific literature, carrying out statistics on the word number length of 8000-40000 words and manual statistics time of 10-60 minutes, carrying out block processing on the long scientific literature, marking the document, and marking the document by using a lexical Part-Of-Speech (POS) tag. According to the keyword extraction method based on the long scientific literature, the concept of'blocking 'is introduced, the inherent limitation of the BERT model on the length of the input end is greatly improved, the Block-BERT model is provided for processing, global and local information is combined, comprehensive semantic information is reserved, keyword extraction is effectively carried out on the long scientific literature, and the keyword extraction efficiency is improved. Compared with an existing model, the performance is greatly improved, the deficiency of keyword semantic information is avoided as much as possible, a new node centrality calculation ranking method Block-Rank is provided, and local information adopts a graph structure-based model to measure the importance degree of nodes.
claims: Method and apparatus for keyword extraction method based on long scientific literature.

title: Scientific and technical literature difference generation method based on citation, graph and structure
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature difference generation method based on citation, graph and structure. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, performing function labeling on the citation of the scientific and technical literature; 2, collecting comparative citations and corresponding scientific and technical literatures; thirdly, sentence relation scores are calculated based on a comparison graph method; 4, calculating sentence structure scores in combination with a structure theory; and 5, sequencing the sentences, and extracting the sentences to form different contents. The method adopts a simple and efficient unsupervised method, does not depend on large-scale training data, and automatically generates the difference content of the scientific and technical literature.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature difference generation method based on citation, graph and structure.

title: Scientific and technical literature data classification method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature data classification method, and relates to the technical field of literature classification. In order to solve the problem that when a user does not have a definite keyword that the user wants to search or a knowledge base cannot detect related content after inputting the corresponding keyword, the knowledge base which only performs classification through the keyword cannot meet the user requirements. The method specifically comprises the following steps of transmitting scientific and technical literatures to be classified to a database specially used for storing the literatures through a network, and analyzing the scientific and technical literatures to obtain titles, literature authors, literature creation institutions, literature publishing dates and file word number information in the literatures. According to the method, when the user does not have a definite keyword which the user wants to search or the knowledge base cannot detect related content after the user inputs the corresponding keyword, the user can retrieve the literature through the related descriptive statement, and the literature library can better provide related retrieval services for the user after using the classification method.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature data classification method.
assignee: ZHANJIANG ZHIHUIKANG SPACE PLANNING CONSULTING CO LTD

title: Multi-feature fusion English scientific and technical literature keyword extraction method
abstract: According to the multi-feature fusion English scientific and technical literature keyword extraction method, alternative words are not selected any more, a keyword extraction process is taken as a keyword theme sequence marking process, a deep network learning model is adopted to carry out supervised sequence marking, and the model aims at scientific and technical literature features, so that the learning efficiency is improved. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out multi-feature word segmentation on a text in a corpus, segmenting the text into word sets, carrying out feature topic processing on all words, carrying out sequence marking processing on the words through marking a keyword position marking file, and splicing the words and features in a vector form as input. The marking result of the word is transmitted to the deep network learning model in a vector form for training, and the trained model is used for keyword extraction, so that the keyword extraction efficiency and precision of the English scientific and technical literature are greatly improved, the extraction result of the model is evaluated in real time, and the keyword extraction effect is better after continuous correction.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-feature fusion english scientific and technical literature keyword extraction method.

title: Intelligent indexing-oriented scientific and technical literature keyword indexing method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent indexing-oriented scientific and technical literature keyword indexing method. The method comprises the following steps of: auditing literatures; analyzing the logic structure of the literature theme; determining an indexing hierarchy according to the indexing depth; determining a final keyword of the literature according to the article description and the subject term table; and checking and recording the indexing result. According to the method, the objectivity, accuracy and consistency of manual keyword indexing are greatly improved, and the keyword indexing quality and efficiency are improved. The quality of scientific and technological literature retrieval is improved, and meanwhile, high-quality keyword indexing sample data can be provided for computer intelligent indexing.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent indexing-oriented scientific and technical literature keyword indexing method.
assignee: TONGFANG KNOWLEDGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD BEIJING

title: Scientific and technical literature professional knowledge candidate mining method and system based on man-machine cooperation
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technical literature professional knowledge candidate mining method and system based on man-machine cooperation. The method comprises the steps that a plurality of first training samples are decomposed into sentences; setting label information on minimum expression units in sentences in the first training sample, performing attribute classification on attribute information of the minimum expression units, setting regular expressions for the minimum expression units belonging to the same attribute, and establishing mapping rules from the minimum expression units to general concepts or general attributes; extracting a relation feature between two minimum expression units in the first training sample; setting a mining rule set according to a conventional combination mode of relation characteristics and attribute information; and mining the scientific and technical literature to be mined by utilizing the mining rule set and the mapping rule. According to the label and the regular expression, the relationship characteristics between the minimum expression unit and the extracted minimum expression unit are combined and matched, so that comprehensive mining of scientific and technical literature knowledge is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature professional knowledge candidate mining method and system based on man-machine cooperation.
assignee: HUNAN KEDE INFORMATION CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD

title: Keyword automatic extraction method based on scientific and technical literature graph network
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic keyword extraction method based on a scientific and technical literature graph network, which comprises the following steps of: establishing the scientific and technical literature graph network for a set scientific and technical literature set according to a literature reference relationship and common author information; establishing a data organization model based on a scientific and technical literature graph network; extracting self information of the scientific and technical literature to be tested, and combining the self information with scientific and technical literature map network information obtained based on the data organization model to complete keyword extraction; the self information comprises publishing time, questions, abstracts, texts, references and authors. According to the invention, a scientific and technical literature graph network is constructed based on common authors and reference relationships, an automatic extraction method based on the scientific and technical literature graph network is provided, and the automatic extraction effect of scientific and technical literature keywords is further improved; the invention further provides a scientific and technical literature graph network construction method and a scientific and technical literature graph network data organization model, scientific and technical literature graph network information can be fully utilized, and the problem of how to utilize graph network data is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for keyword automatic extraction method based on scientific and technical literature graph network.
assignee: MILITARY SCIENCE INFORMATION RES CENTER OF CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY AND MILITARY SCIENCE ACADE

title: Scientific and technical literature interest assessment method and device based on biodynamic model
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature interest assessment method and device based on a biodynamic model, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a biodynamic model of which the interestingness of literature changes with time according to the upper limit of literature reading capability, the interestingness of literature and the natural change rate of interest; according to the literature information amount model and the user knowledge level, calculating and determining a literature reading capability upper limit; tracking the literature reading time of the first preset time according to the timer, and determining the accumulated literature reading time in the second preset time based on the literature reading time of the first preset time; and presetting the value of the interest natural change rate, and calculating to obtain a user interest value at a preset time point according to the biodynamic model so as to track the interest of the user in the scientific and technical literature. According to the method, personalized recommendation results of scientific and technical literatures can be improved, and search results of keywords can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature interest assessment method and device based on biodynamic model.
assignee: BEIJING ZHENGSPECTRUM HUACHO SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title: Method and system for automatically extracting scientific and technical literature data based on text mining
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically extracting scientific and technical literature data based on text mining. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining a file (XML (Extensible Markup Language), HTML (Hypertext Markup Language) or plain text) of data to be extracted; extracting plain texts in the XML and HTML files and filtering out publication information and URL (Uniform Resource Locator) information in the plain texts to form a text corpus; screening sentences containing preset information in the text corpus as target sentences; carrying out table recognition and table analysis on the XML and HTML files, and screening a table containing preset information as a target table; performing named entity identification on the target sentence and the target table respectively, identifying target entities contained in the target sentence and the target table, and determining a relationship between the target entities; and splicing the mutually associated target entities in the same literature to form a complete structured data set. According to the scheme, the extraction precision is high, and the whole process is automatic and easy to implement.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and system for automatically extracting scientific and technical literature data based on text mining.

title: Research focus analysis method and device based on scientific and technical literature mining
abstract: The invention discloses a research focus analysis method and device based on scientific and technical literature mining, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining scientific and technical literature data, carrying out the preprocessing, and constructing a literature private database; performing word segmentation on the literature set by using a word segmentation algorithm, and performing classification and entity extraction on the literature set by using an improved text classification algorithm; traversing the literature entity set to construct a ternary relational expression, matching a tag set and storing a result to obtain an extracted relational expression set; calculating a word literature probability set, obtaining a support degree group corresponding to the keyword group according to the keyword group, performing duplicate removal processing on a result to obtain a hotspot set, and generating a hotspot analysis model; packaging the hotspot analysis model into an open interface, and displaying a result to a user in a knowledge graph form. According to the method, an improved text classification algorithm and an association rule mining technology are combined, hotspot extraction and analysis can be effectively carried out on scientific and technical literatures, a method is provided for currently obtaining research hotspots and mastering a research trend, and the use value of text analysis is increased.
claims: Method and apparatus for research focus analysis method and device based on scientific and technical literature mining.

title: Scientific and technical literature classification method based on knowledge graph
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technical literature classification method based on a knowledge graph. The method comprises a literature acquisition step: acquiring scientific and technical literatures to be classified; a text preprocessing step: performing lexical analysis on the scientific and technical literature to obtain part-of-speech tagging, and filtering according to the part-of-speech tagging; a feature extraction step: counting the occurrence frequency of each word in the scientific and technical literature, calculating a word vector in each scientific and technical literature according to the number of the scientific and technical literature containing the word, and performing text feature vectorization representation; and a literature classification step: carrying out literature classification according to the structure represented by the text feature vectorization. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that automatic document classification is achieved, calculation of word vectors can reflect the importance degree of words in a corpus, the reliability of subsequent document classification is improved, the words are screened in multiple aspects, and the classification efficiency and reliability are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature classification method based on knowledge graph.
assignee: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Scientific and technical literature quotation recommendation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature quotation recommendation method based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: sequentially performing information extraction, noise removal, word list index construction and vectorization processing on text data; firstly, performing semantic vectorization representation on a to-be-matched text through Bi-LSTM, then performing interactive coding on the text by adopting an Attention mechanism, and performing feature extraction on interactive information of the text through a multilayer CNN network so as to obtain final matching degree information of the text; in the first stage, forming a related quotation recommendation set through vector space similarity of texts, and in the second stage, using a text reasoning matching method for carrying out language understanding on candidate sets so as to obtain an accurate relevancy ranking list. According to the method, the problems of semantic comprehension, content integrity and accuracy in existing text reasoning matching can be solved, high-quality semantic features and a digital text input form are provided, and feature extraction is performed on interactive information of the text, so that final matching degree information of the text is obtained.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature quotation recommendation method based on deep learning.

title: Scientific and technological literature bibliographic data extraction method
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technological literature bibliographic data extraction method. The method comprises the following steps of S1, uploading a scientific and technological literature PDF to a storage module; S2, performing bibliographic data analysis on the science and technology literature PDF through a built-in OCR module, and determining data position marking information; S3, automatically matching the data position marking information with standard paragraph module information in the storage module, and submitting matching result parameter data to auditors if a matchingresult conforms to the standard paragraph module information; if not, returning the data position marking information to S2 for re-analysis and matching; and S4, if the auditing personnel does not pass the auditing, requiring the auditing personnel to perform auditing again after the manual modification of the uploader until the auditing personnel passes the auditing. According to the method, bibliographic data in scientific and technological literatures can be automatically extracted for archiving and viewing files, parameter data in the scientific and technological literatures can be deeplymined for scientific research, high availability of the scientific research literatures is achieved, and the maximum value of the literatures is exerted.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature bibliographic data extraction method.

title: Scientific and technological literature parameter data extraction method
abstract: The invention provides a scientific and technological literature parameter data extraction method. The method comprises the following steps: S1, uploading a scientific and technological literature PDFformat file; S2, automatically extracting parameters in the scientific and technological literature PDF through a parameter analysis module to obtain parameter data, matching the parameter data witha target database field, simultaneously displaying position information of the parameter data, and displaying a matching result; S3, establishing a new document for the obtained parameter data, and simultaneously displaying the new document and the corresponding part of the science and technology literature PDF original text; and S4, an uploader manually modifying and perfecting the input of the parameter data part corresponding to a new document, and then storing the parameter data part into a database. Valuable contents in scientific research literatures can be extracted according to use requirements, valuable and practical parameter data contents are extracted, and pictures, tables, scientific research parameter data and the like are accurately extracted by using a parameter analysis module. Scientific researchers are helped to easily establish a parameter data database belonging to themselves by using PDF scientific files.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature parameter data extraction method.

title: METHOD FOR ASSISTING DETERMINATION OF NOVELTY OF TECHNOLOGY DESCRIBED IN SCIENTIFIC LITERATURE, PROGRAM, AND SYSTEM
abstract: To provide a method for assisting determination of novelty of the technology described in scientific literature.SOLUTION: The present disclosure provides a method for assisting determination of novelty of a technology described in scientific literature, and the method includes the steps of: obtaining at least a part of a sentence in the scientific literature (step S401); on the basis of at least a part of the sentence, searching for a prior document describing the same or similar technology as a technology described in the scientific literature (step S402); and presenting presence or absence of the prior document (step S403).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
claims: Method and apparatus for method for assisting determination of novelty of technology described in scientific literature, program, and system.

title: GNN-based COVID-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification method
abstract: The invention discloses a GNN-based COVID-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification method. The method comprises the following steps: a) constructing a COVID-19 scientific literature knowledge graph; a1) dividing knowledge categories; a2) designing entities in scientific literatures; a3) designing a relationship in scientific literature; a4), constructing a COVID-19 scientific literature knowledge graph; b) constructing a western medicine treatment knowledge graph; c) constructing a traditional Chinese medicine treatment knowledge graph; d) constructing a graph neural network model;and e) carrying out text classification. According to the GNN-based COVID-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification method, an effective screening and classification method is provided formedical workers to quickly find needed knowledge class literatures in massive (usually more than ten thousand) related COVID-19 scientific literatures, the beneficial effects are remarkable, and themethod is suitable for application and popularization.
claims: Method and apparatus for gnn-based covid-19 scientific literature fine-grained classification method.
assignee: SHANDONG COMPUTER SCIENCE CT NAT SUPERCOMPUTER CT JINAN

title: Scientific literature key content potential association mining method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific literature key content potential association mining method based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining scientificliterature data related to a certain specific event, and carrying out the data cleaning and preprocessing; s2, extracting a literature content keyword by utilizing a TF-IDF method; s3, constructing aword co-occurrence network for the extracted keywords and references to which the keywords belong by taking sentences as units; s4, learning vector representation of the keywords by using a graph convolutional neural network; and S5, obtaining the relevancy between different keywords by utilizing a similarity calculation function, and mining the potential incidence relation of the different keywords. According to the method, modeling is carried out on the keyword relationship extracted from the article content, and the potential association of the main keywords of the literature is mined by utilizing the graph convolutional neural network technology, so that the analysis requirement on the scientific literature content is met, and the correlation of the scientific literature in different fields is analyzed; and an effective method is provided for systematic analysis of scientific literatures.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific literature key content potential association mining method based on graph neural network.

title: Specific field situation analysis system based on scientific and technological literature data
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of specific field development situation analysis, and particularly discloses a specific field situation analysis system based on scientific and technological literature data, which comprises a data acquisition module, a task management module, a situation analysis engine module, a visual output module and a data resource library, wherein the data acquisition module is used for receiving keywords provided by a user, generating a retrieval formula, and retrieving from a data resource library or an external platform resource library according to the retrieval formula to obtain related scientific and technological literature data; the task management module is used for selecting required situation analysis task types and analysis dimensions; the situation analysis engine module is used for analyzing related scientific and technological literature data according to the selected situation analysis task type and analysis dimension; and the visual output module is used for visually displaying the analysis result and generating a situation analysis report. The current overall situation of the specific field is analyzed by utilizing scientific and technological literature data, so that the defect that the situation of the specific field is analyzed by only depending on expert knowledge traditionally is overcome.
claims: Method and apparatus for specific field situation analysis system based on scientific and technological literature data.

title: Scientific and technological literature content depth revealing method based on content map
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technological literature content deep revealing method based on a content map. The method comprises the steps of performing knowledge object and semantic relation extraction on text data; constructing a content map of a plurality of scientific and technological literatures; and deeply aggregating science and technology literature content knowledge. According to the method of the invention, the organization mode of the scientific and technological literature content knowledge can be deepened from literature external features to internal features; implicit knowledge discovery among literatures and reasoning among knowledge can be carried out; meanwhile, cross-literature knowledge clusters and knowledge chains can be generated in a plane space and a three-dimensional space, free-state knowledge among literatures is organized in series, effective cooperation and deep aggregation among the knowledge are achieved, and the problems that information islost when scientific and technological literatures are looked up and knowledge dissociation exists among the scientific and technological literatures are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature content depth revealing method based on content map.

title: Scientific and technological literature big data classification method
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technological literature big data classification method, and belongs to the technical field of big data text mining. The method comprises the steps that S1, atopological relation graph is constructed, wherein the graph is composed of nodes and edges, and the nodes are keywords in literatures, sentences and STKOS; wherein the edges are literatures and sentences, literatures and keywords, sentences and sentences, sentences and keywords and relationships between keywords; S2, converting the topological relation graph into a topological relation matrix; S3, training the classification model by using the training data and the topological relation matrix constructed by the training data; and S4, literature classification: inputting the batch of literatures to be classified into the trained classification model to obtain the probability that the literatures to be classified belong to different categories. Compared with the prior art, the topologicalrelation graph and sentences constructed by the method consider the factors of the word order, and the keywords are terms indexed by experts, so that the classification accuracy is improved; and the adopted classification model does not need repeated training, and sampling calculation is carried out on the input of each convolution layer, so that the classification efficiency is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature big data classification method.
assignee: INSTITUTE OF SCIENT AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION OF CHINA

title: Scientific and technological literature retrieval intention construction method
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technological literature retrieval intention construction method, which comprises the following steps of: visualizing literature theme clusters, and giving theme keywords for users to interact and select; querying the first five detailed similar concepts selected by the user through the word2vec vector, and providing the first five detailed similar conceptsto the user for interactive selection. According to the user retrieval intention judgment method based on the vocabulary model, intention information contained in user input is fully mined, and semantic association in the vocabulary model is utilized; the possible retrieval intention of a user is analyzed by analyzing semantic association between retrieval requests of the user, and a retrieval formula is constructed on the basis of the possible retrieval intention of the user for secondary accurate retrieval.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technological literature retrieval intention construction method.

title: High-value scientific literature library system for Chinese readers
abstract: The invention discloses a high-value scientific literature library system for Chinese readers. The system mainly comprises a scientific literature library and a network platform, wherein the scientific literature library comprises literature of which the source publication language is Chinese, and also comprises a Chinese translation version of the scientific literature of which the source publication language is foreign language; scientific literature recorded in the scientific literature library is considered to have high value by science and technology personnel in the field, the scientificliterature library is embedded in the network platform, and a user accesses the literature in the scientific literature library through the network platform. The invention mainly aims to solve the problem that a high-quality Chinese edition scientific literature library is lacked in China at present, and mainly relates to a scientific literature library and a system thereof.
claims: Method and apparatus for high-value scientific literature library system for chinese readers.
assignee: NANJING KEZHENXIN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR BUILDING, USING AND SHARING A CORPUS OF SCIENTIFIC LITERATURE FOR A LIFE SCIENCE COMPANY
abstract: A method and system for building, managing and using a corpus of scientific literature for a life science company. The system provides metadata and tools for interacting with, and sharing scientific literature in an efficient and compliant manner and customized to meet the unique and varied cross-functional needs of a life science company.
claims: Method and apparatus for system and method for building, using and sharing a corpus of scientific literature for a life science company.

title: Scientific and technical literature picture extraction method based on Faster-RCNN
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technological literature picture extraction method based on a Fast-RCNN. The method comprises the following steps of 1) acquiring the scientific and technological literature data by using a web crawler and preprocessing the scientific and technological literature data; 2) dividing a data set, making a label for the data in the training set, and not processing the data in the test set; 3) inputting the data in the training set into a convolution layer, and extracting the feature mapping of the pictures; (4) mapping and inputting the obtained features into an RPN module to obtain the proposal feature maps with fixed sizes; 5) classifying the specific categories by utilizing the softmax to obtain the accurate position of a target, calculating a loss function, and updating the parameters of the whole network to obtain a training model; 6) utilizing the training model to detect the data in the data set, and outputting the detected pictures. The scientific and technological literature picture extraction method is high in detection speed and high in accuracy, facilitates the further analysis and understanding of the scientific and technological literature pictures, and has the higher practical application value.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature picture extraction method based on faster-rcnn.

title: Classification method and system for link resources in scientific and technical literature, and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for classifying link resources in scientific and technical literature, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of: extracting a description text of resources to be classified; and inputting the description text into a pre-trained classification model to obtain a classification result based on a knowledge representation framework, thereby realizing classification of the to-be-classified resources. According to the method, the recognition model is constructed through the neural network method based on context information according to the semantic characteristics of the link resources in the scientific and technical literature, recognition of the resources can be effectively improved, and management, analysis and recommendation of the scientific and technical link resources are facilitated.
claims: Method and apparatus for classification method and system for link resources in scientific and technical literature, and equipment.

title: Knowledge graph construction method and system suitable for scientific and technological literature, terminal and medium
abstract: The invention provides a knowledge graph construction method and system suitable for scientific and technological literature, a terminal and a medium. The knowledge graph construction method and system are used for constructing a corresponding knowledge graph suitable for the scientific and technological literature according to specific source data. The technical scheme provided by the invention has extremely high integrating degree with unstructured text characteristics of scientific and technical documents; The word segmentation unit is improved by combining words and manual verification, extraction of professional coincidence words in scientific and technical literatures is facilitated, a seed knowledge base is automatically extracted through encyclopedia, and therefore a large amount of cost for manually maintaining the seed knowledge base at the initial stage is saved.
claims: Method and apparatus for knowledge graph construction method and system suitable for scientific and technological literature, terminal and medium.
assignee: SHANGHAI R&D PUBLIC SERVICE PLATFORM MAN CENTER

title: A method for predicting the evolution direction of manufacturing technology based on scientific and technological literature
abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting the evolution direction of manufacturing technology based on scientific and technological literature, which comprises the following steps: searching andstoring scientific and technological literature according to keywords; converting the scientific and technological literature into manufacture technology morphology matrix embodiments; sorting the same element in the embodiment library to generate attribute frequency tables before and after element change; calculating the ratio according to the attribute frequency table, and generating and displaying the change curves of time and element attributes according to the corresponding relationship of time and ratio of references corresponding to each element. In summary, the method for predicting the evolution direction of manufacturing technology based on scientific and technological literature provided by the embodiments of the present invention has the advantages that, based on a rule of technology route analysis, the evolution direction of manufacturing technology is analyzed by using morphological analysis method, and the evolution direction of manufacturing technology is predicted clearly in short term, which provides an auxiliary decision-making method for manufacturing technicians to determine the direction of manufacturing technology innovation, and avoids or reduces the loss or waste of human property caused by blind innovation.
claims: Method and apparatus for a method for predicting the evolution direction of manufacturing technology based on scientific and technological literature.

title: Oversea Chinese scientist recognizing method based on scientific research literature data mining
abstract: The invention discloses an oversea Chinese scientist recognizing method based on scientific research literature data mining. The method includes the steps of establishing a scientific research literature data set, recognizing Chinese authors, distributing unique author identification, establishing a Chinese scientific research literature data set, inspecting an address corresponding to the latestissuing time in an address-issuing time set for each Chinese scientific research literature datum in the Chinese scientific research literature data set, if the address is a Chinese address, deletingcorresponding Chinese scientific research literature data from the Chinese scientific research literature data set, and if an issuing periodical set does not contain a designated periodical or an author keyword set does not contain a designated keyword, deleting corresponding Chinese scientific research literature data from the Chinese scientific research literature data set. The method preciselyrecognizes the field needing to be researched and is high in efficiency and expandability.
claims: Method and apparatus for oversea chinese scientist recognizing method based on scientific research literature data mining.
assignee: WUHAN BRANCH OF THE NAT SCIENCE LIBRARY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Method and procedure of scientific and technical literature label simplified research conclusion based on combined feature weighting
abstract: The invention discloses a method and procedure of a scientific and technical literature label simplified research conclusion based on combined feature weighting. The method and procedure comprise a classified extraction procedure, wherein based on a training corpus, data prewashing is conducted; then a sentence is divided to obtain sentences and labels, and sentence characteristic selection is characterized; then a classifier is trained, and is evaluated, and the trained classifier is stored and serialized; in an application stage, an application text is obtained, and is also subjected to data washing, and sentence division is conducted; then characterization is conducted (in the application stage, a chi word feature is chi words utilized in a training stage), the classifier is loaded to conduct research conclusion prediction on the application text, afterwards a sentence prediction result manually reviewed, and post data washing processing is conducted; then the washing rules are added into an original program, and an iterative experiment is conducted. In actual application, the method and procedure of the scientific and technical literature label simplified research conclusion based on combined feature weighting are closer to the nature of a problem, and therefore has higher advantages.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and procedure of scientific and technical literature label simplified research conclusion based on combined feature weighting.
assignee: TONGFANG KNOWLEDGE NETWORK (BEIJING) TECH CO LTD

title: Unstructured integration analysis method of tumor-related scientific literature and scientific data
abstract: The present invention discloses an unstructured integration analysis method of tumor-related scientific literature and scientific data. The method comprises: obtaining tumor scientific data and tumor science literature from open platforms; carrying out structured storage and classification on the tumor scientific data and the tumor science literature, and establishing the index; processing the tumor science literature, extracting relevant information of the tumor type researched by the literature and the adopted tumor scientific data types; and carrying out statistical analysis on reuse condition of the tumor scientific data to obtain the associated tumor science literature, or carrying out statistical analysis on the tumor science literature to find out the associated tumor scientific data. The method disclosed by the present invention has the advantages that the tumor scientific data storage platform can be associated with scientific literature data that is available in an open manner, so that the user can query the existing tumor research trend; based on a specific scientific data set, the scientific literature associated with the data set can be retrieved; and based on the specific scientific literature, the data set associated with the literature can be retrieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for unstructured integration analysis method of tumor-related scientific literature and scientific data.
assignee: INST OF MEDICAL INFORMATION CHINESE ACAD OF MEDICAL SCIENCES

title: Scientific and technical literature fine grit relation mining method based on two-stage syntax analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the field of technical mining in scientific and technical literature, in particular to a scientific and technical literature fine grit relation mining method based on two-stage syntax analysis. A two-stage syntax analysis method is adopted, wherein according to first-stage syntax analysis, a phrase structure generated through analysis is utilized, and long and complicated sentences in the scientific and technical literature are simplified better; according to the second stage, simple sentences obtained after simplifying are subjected to syntax analysis again, and a syntactic structure generated through analysis is utilized for accurately extracting the subject, verb and object structures of statements. According to the technical scheme, the aim of mining of the bio-entity relation in the scientific and technical literature is mainly achieved, the direct fine grit relation between bio-entities can be obtained, and the indirect relation hidden in the bio-entities can also be obtained through derivation.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature fine grit relation mining method based on two-stage syntax analysis.

title: Screening method for personalized scientific research literature
abstract: The invention discloses a screening method for personalized scientific research literature. According to the screening method, an algorithm based on vector cosine value comparison is adopted in combination with literature content in a designated scientific research field and relevant scientific literature in the personal research field to obtain the scientific research literature meeting personalized demands finally. Compared with traditional manual literature search, through the screening method, a large amount of literature reading time is saved, scientific research efficiency is substantially improved, the scientific research literature is closer to the user research field compared with scientific research literature found through a manual search method traditionally, and resource waste caused by repeated research is avoided.
claims: Method and apparatus for screening method for personalized scientific research literature.
assignee: NANJING SHUANGYUN BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title: Cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval method and cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval system
abstract: The invention relates to a cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval method and a cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval system. The cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval method includes establishing a scientific and technical literature ontology library for storing homogeneous keywords, scientific and technical literature information ontology links corresponding to the homogeneous keywords as well as original scientific and technical literature indexes pointing to the scientific and technical literature information ontology links, wherein the homogeneous keywords refer to a set of synonymous or near-synonymous Chinese keywords and English keywords; reading an index word inputted by a user, and searching the scientific and technical literature information ontology link corresponding to the homogeneous keywords matching with the index word from the scientific and technical literature ontology library; searching relevant literature according to the scientific and technical literature information ontology link corresponding to the homogeneous keywords and the original scientific and technical literature index pointing to the scientific and technical literature information ontology link, and displaying the literature to the user according to a preset sequence. The cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval method is capable of improving scientific and technical literature retrieval precision.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval method and cross-language scientific and technical literature retrieval system.

title: Scientific and technical literature information retrieval system of maker venture capital investment space
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature information retrieval system of a maker venture capital investment space. The system comprises a data service module, a data push module, an information retrieval module, a literature transmission module and a client application module; the data push module communicates with the data service module through the Internet and comprises a plurality of data cloud service centers, and the data service module obtains scientific and technical information index data from these data cloud service centers; the information retrieval module receives a retrieval request of the client application module and returns a corresponding retrieval result and scientific and technical information supply means by retrieving the scientific and technical information index data stored in the data push module, and receives a scientific and technical literature or information subscription demand of the client application module; and the literature transmission module is used for pushing an access means of the subscribed scientific and technical literature or information to the client. The scientific and technical literature information retrieval system disclosed by the invention provides an academic resource support for maker spaces or business incubators and creates a convenient scientific and technical literature application environment.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature information retrieval system of maker venture capital investment space.

title: Analysis method and device for scientific research literature theme evolution
abstract: The invention discloses an analysis method for scientific research literature theme evolution. The method comprises the following steps of A1, downloading scientific research literature of a specific subject, and sorting literature metadata; A2, performing preprocessing on the literature metadata to form a literature data set; A3, performing calculation by using an LDA scientific research literature probability theme model to obtain scientific research keyword distribution and theme literature distribution; A4, dividing extracted themes on the timeline by using time information of the theme literature to form sub-themes in different time periods; A5, building a theme evolution diagram by using the correlation relationship measurement of the themes, and tracking the evolution condition of the scientific research themes. The analysis method and the device for scientific research literature theme evolution provided by the embodiment of the invention have the advantages that the goal of disclosing and mining the changing rule of the scientific research themes in the preset scientific research fields along with the time can be achieved; and the mastering of the evolution process of the scientific research themes can be facilitated.
claims: Method and apparatus for analysis method and device for scientific research literature theme evolution.

title: Multi-information fusion scientific research literature theme discovering and tracking method and system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-information fusion scientific research theme discovering and tracking method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: S1, downloading a scientific research literature of an appointed subject, and collating literature metadata; S2, pre-processing the literature metadata to form a literature data set; S3, establishing a multi-source-information fusion scientific research literature probability theme model by comprehensive utilization of a text and citation information, and discovering distribution of theme words and distribution of theme core literatures; and S4, on the basis of the obtained distribution of the theme core literatures and the obtained distribution of the theme words, in combination with time information of the literature, tracking the change condition of a scientific research theme by utilizing a theme tracking calculation formula. According to the scientific research theme discovering and tracking method and system provided in the embodiment of the invention, the scientific research theme in the field of pre-set scientific research can be mined; research interests of scientific researchers are changed along with time; and thus, the evolutionary context of the scientific research theme can be grasped easily.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-information fusion scientific research literature theme discovering and tracking method and system thereof.

title: Scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on author frequent pattern
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on an author frequent pattern. The scientific and technical literature recommendation method comprises the following steps: adding a function of processing literature ID (Identity) (the unique number of the literature) into a Fp-growth algorithm, constructing the author frequent pattern, a literature set corresponding to the author frequent pattern, literature published by the author and a literature set corresponding to a keyword, and removing the literature browsed by a user to construct a literature recommendation candidate set. The invention also constructs a scoring system which sorts the candidate sets according to the descending order of the scores to recommend ten literatures with the highest score to the user.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature recommendation method based on author frequent pattern.

title: Scientific and technical literature importance degree evaluation method based on PageRank and time decay
abstract: The invention discloses a scientific and technical literature importance degree evaluation method based on PageRank and time decay. Impact factors including a referenced scientific and technical literature, an author, a presentation meeting/periodical and the like jointly construct a link network of the scientific and technical literature, wherein the impact factors are associated with the scientific and technical literature. The scientific and technical literature importance degree evaluation method has the basic thought that a relational network, which is associated with the scientific and technical literature, of a meeting/ periodical-presentation year, presentation year-scientific and technical literature, scientific and technical literature-scientific and technical literature and scientific and technical literature-author is converted into a directed graph; then, the PageRank value of each node is calculated on the basis of the directed graph, the scientific and technical literature and a scientific and technical literature reference link are subjected to timed decay processing, wherein ''reference'' time and an authority score are in an inverse ratio; and finally, according to the obtained authority score, weighting processing is carried out to carry out authority value sorting on the scientific and technical literature so as to improve accuracy and reliability for calculating the authority value of the scientific and technical literature. When a user retrieves a target scientific and technical literature, the user can quickly find the most authoritative scientific and technical literature under a situation that an amount of search results is large.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature importance degree evaluation method based on pagerank and time decay.

title: Method for automatically evaluating scientific and technical literature novelty by utilizing computer
abstract: The invention provides a method for automatically evaluating scientific and technical literature novelty by utilizing a computer. The method comprises the following steps: A, detecting the novelty on the basis of document content ranking; B, detecting the novelty on the basis of document semantic comparison; C, detecting the novelty on the basis of key terms; E, detecting the novelty on the basis of numerical indexes; and E, respectively obtaining the novelty scores on the basis of the steps A to D, and calculating the total novelty score of the novelty search document by utilizing a regression model. By adopting the method provided by the invention, the automatic novelty search of scientific and technical literatures can be carried out on the basis of multi-dimensional novelty detection, so that the scientific and technical novelty search efficiency can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for method for automatically evaluating scientific and technical literature novelty by utilizing computer.
assignee: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO

title: Coauthor recommending method under scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network
abstract: The invention discloses a coauthor recommending method under a scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network. Probability that a pair of authors establish a cooperation relationship in the future is in direct proportion to willingness that two nodes establish the cooperation relationship with each other, so that the coauthor recommending based on cooperator willingness is provided, and cooperating authors are recommended to authors by calculating probability that two authors cooperate in the future. The coauthor recommending method includes defining attention degree of the nodes according to future influence increase degree and rate of the nodes and ages of the nodes; designing cooperation willingness of two authors due to different relationships on the basis of the attention degree; designing topological feature attributes under different relationships on the basis of the willingness of different relationships; taking the topological feature attributes as an independent variable of a logic regression model, utilizing parameters of a real data training model, and using an acquired function model to calculate probability that the two authors cooperate in the future. The coauthor recommending method takes willingness of two authors which cooperate into consideration, and the willingness is based on node influence and age, so that prediction results of cooperation relationships are improved, and recommending quality of coauthors of authors is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for coauthor recommending method under scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network.

title: Scientific and technical literature quoting number predicting method based on time sequence
abstract: The invention relates to a scientific and technical literature quoting number predicting method based on a time sequence. The predicting method includes the steps that statistics is carried out on scientific and technical literature quoting numbers, and then average literature quoting numbers of all the months are calculated; in combination with the average literature quoting numbers of all the months, the quoting numbers of the corresponding months are processed in a normalization mode to obtain the quoting time sequence; cluster analysis is carried out according to the time sequence, and a quoting number model with the optimal predicting performance is obtained through dividing training sets and verifying sets, building a regression model and performing error analysis; according to similarity analysis of literature to be predicted and time sequences of various kinds of literature, the class with the highest similarity is obtained, and the quoting number, in the next month, of the literature to be predicted is obtained through the model with the optimal predicting performance. The quoting conditions of each piece of published literature can be automatically analyzed, the average literature quoting numbers of all the months are obtained, different quoting modes of the literature are excavated through clustering, and then the future quoting number is predicted according to the existing time sequence of the literature to be predicted.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature quoting number predicting method based on time sequence.

title: Method and system for scientific and technical literature retrieval
abstract: The invention provides a determiner-based method for Chinese scientific and technical literature retrieval. The method comprises the following steps that firstly, the semantic relevancy between feature vectors of retrieved entries and feature vectors of all scientific and technical literature names in a data set is calculated; then based on the Chinese character 'de' namely 'of', the retrieved entries are subjected to description, so that the scientific and technical literature names with prefixes being the same as those of the retrieved entries are found out, the semantic relevancy corresponding to the scientific and technical literature names is corrected, and finally a plurality of scientific and technical literatures with high semantic relevancy corresponding to the names of the scientific and technical literatures are used as retrieval results. According to the method, the semantic relevancy between the retrieved entries and the names of the scientific and technical literatures is considered and combined with relevance between words in the Chinese grammar, and therefore the retrieval efficiency of Chinese scientific and technical literatures is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and system for scientific and technical literature retrieval.

title: Academic influence cooperative sequencing method of nodes in scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network
abstract: The invention discloses an academic influence cooperative sequencing method of nodes (papers, authors and periodicals/ conference) in a scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network. By aiming at the heterogeneity of the scientific and technical literature network, according to the method provided by the invention, two stages of random walk are adopted for calculating and sequencing the academic influence of the nodes in the scientific and technical literature, wherein the two stages of the random walk are respectively the random walk driven by the node network topology on the scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network and the random walk driven by the academic type in a minimum network mode of the scientific and technical literature network; the weight of each edge is calculated in the scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network for configuring the random walk driven by the node network topology; and according to the minimum network mode of the scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network, an average edge betweenness of various relation edges in different fields is counted, a propagation factor is calculated, and the rand walk driven by the node academic type is configured. The method provided by the invention solves the problems caused by the heterogeneity of the heterogeneous network and avoids phenomena of node influence and in-degree positive correlation, so that the sequencing result is relatively accurate.
claims: Method and apparatus for academic influence cooperative sequencing method of nodes in scientific and technical literature heterogeneous network.

title: Internet literature scientific research data collection system
