abstract: The invention discloses an Internet literature scientific research data collection system, which comprises a collection module, a link module, an acquisition module, an input module, a splitting and summarization module and an output module, wherein the collection module is used for rationally forming the metadata contents of data, and designing a standard metadata format according to the characteristics of attributes; the link module is used for establishing a link with a network system; the acquisition module is used for acquiring to-be-searched data, query conditions and website information submitted by a user; the input module is used for submitting acquired data to a website specified by the user, and encoding returned results; the splitting and summarization module intercepting data contents from the returned results, splitting the contents according to a set mode, and arranging the split contents into corresponding character string data sets for summarization; and the output module is used for saving summarization results to an Internet literature scientific research data collection platform, and outputting the summarization results. The Internet literature scientific research data collection system is maximally utilized by global Internet literature workers, and greatly promotes the development of Internet literature.
claims: Method and apparatus for internet literature scientific research data collection system.

title: Search Engine for Scientific Literature Providing Interface with Automatic Image Ranking
abstract: An information retrieval system for scientific literature provides a summary document for reviewing the results of a query that provides both a text-based summary and an image-based summary, the latter represented by a figure from the document that has a highest ranking indicating its centrality to the concept of the document. A ranking of figures may be done by an analysis of figure-associated text either by supervised machine learning or comparison of text similarities.
claims: Method and apparatus for search engine for scientific literature providing interface with automatic image ranking.

title: Scientific and technical literature entity integrated ranking method based on associating network
abstract: The invention discloses a method for comprehensively sorting scientific literature entities based on a connective network, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a literature correlation network according to relationship among the literature entities; (2) setting initial sorting values of nodes in the literature correlation network and expressing the initial sorting values of the nodes as vectors v; (3) constructing a correlation matrix A of the literature correlation network; (4) performing normalization of row vectors and normalization of column vectors to matrixes respectively and setting the obtained matrixes to a matrix B and a matrix C respectively; (5) calculating v' equal to B multiplied by (C plus H) multiplied by vT; (6) calculating v' equal to dv'a minus 1; then adding 1 minus d to each element in v' so as to obtain the vector v new, and expressing each component of the vector v new as the current sorting value; and (7) calculating an absolute value of difference between the current sorting value and the old sorting value of each node, and finding the maximum value thereof; if the maximum value is greater than a threshold value, transferring v equal to v new into 5 for continuous iteration; otherwise, expressing each component of the vector v new as a final sorting value of each node and finishing the operation. The comprehensive sorting method overcomes defects in the prior sorting method, sorts the entities in the literature field according to various relationships existing in the literature world; in addition, the experimental result in the literature indicates that the comprehensive sorting method in the literature is more accurate than the prior sorting method.
claims: Method and apparatus for scientific and technical literature entity integrated ranking method based on associating network.

title: Patent KR103022941
abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and claims in KR103022941.
claims: Method and apparatus for patent kr103022941.

title: ENHANCING SYSTEM-RELATED GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: [0000]    Methods, apparatus, and processor-readable storage media for enhancing system-related graph neural networks (GNNs) are provided herein. An example computer-implemented method includes decoupling, using a GNN model, a latent space of an input graph structure into a first latent space and a second latent space; generating a synthetic version of the input graph structure by implementing designated perturbations to the first and second latent spaces; detecting one or more anomalies associated with the synthetic version based on latent space deviations between the input graph structure and the synthetic version; performing a determination that the one or more anomalies are caused by the designated perturbations to the first latent space and/or to the second latent space; and performing one or more automated actions, based on the performing of the determination, in connection with modifying the input graph structure and/or the GNN model.
claims: Method and apparatus for enhancing system-related graph neural networks.

title: FEDERATED GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS WITH DIFFUSION PRIORS FOR SCALABLE AND SECURE INTERNET OF THINGS (IOT) SYSTEMS
abstract: [0000]    A method for generating a global graph neural network (GNN) model, the method includes collecting data from a node cluster, preparing the data for the global GNN model, where the preparing includes preprocessing the data to obtain preprocessed data, extracting node information from the preprocessed data to obtain nodes, edges, and node attributes, determining edge weights based on the edges, assigning each node to a subgraph based on the edge weights and the node attributes, and calculating, based on the assigning, diffusion scores for each node of the nodes based on the edge weights connecting the nodes and the node attributes associated with the nodes within respective subgraphs. Further, the method includes generating the global GNN model using the edge weights, the diffusion scores, and node attributes from each subgraph.
claims: Method and apparatus for federated graph neural networks with diffusion priors for scalable and secure internet of things (iot) systems.

title: FACE FORGERY DETECTION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON GRAPH CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: [0000]    The present application proposes a face forgery detection method based on a graph convolutional neural network, which includes: obtaining a to-be-detected face video; inputting the to-be-detected face video into a trained detection model to obtain a judgment result on whether the video is forged; wherein the detection model includes: an encoder, for generating features of each frame of the to-be-detected face video; a spatiotemporal composite graph construction module, for constructing a spatiotemporal composite graph composed of the spatial graph and the temporal graph based on the features of each frame of the input video; a spatiotemporal composite graph convolution module, for performing feature learning based on the spatiotemporal composite graph to obtain classification features; and a classifier, for predicting an authenticity result of the to-be-detected face video based on the classification features.
claims: Method and apparatus for face forgery detection method and system based on graph convolutional neural network.

title: MISSION PREDICTION SYSTEM FOR SIMULTANEOUS MISSION SUCCESS AND ENEMY INTENT PREDICTION USING GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: The mission prediction system models a wargaming scenario as a graph. Once the GNN graph is defined, multiple sets of AIGC data is used to train the GNN graph. The trained GNN graph can then be used to perform inference on novel wargaming scenarios to simultaneously predict mission success and enemy intent in real-time, even if the novel wargaming scenarios involve a much greater number of assets than were used in the AIGC data. A viewer can be used to review the predictions and to analyze the novel wargaming scenario at different timesteps.
claims: Method and apparatus for mission prediction system for simultaneous mission success and enemy intent prediction using graph neural networks.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PREDICTING GENERATED POWER OF NEW ENERGY STATION BASED ON RECURRENT GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: [0000]    Provided are a method and system for predicting the generated power of the new energy station based on the recurrent graph neural network. The method includes the following: A graph neural network model is pre-constructed, where the graph neural network model includes a graph neural network layer, a recurrent neural network layer, and a first full-connection layer; the historical weather forecast data of a target station, the actual power data of the target station, the historical weather forecast data of a source domain station, and the actual power data of the source domain station are acquired, and the graph neural network model is trained based on the historical weather forecast data of the source domain station and the actual power data of the source domain station to obtain a trained graph neural network model.
claims: Method and apparatus for method and system for predicting generated power of new energy station based on recurrent graph neural network.
assignee: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED [CN]

title: GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: A method comprising: generating subgraphs graph based on classification scores corresponding to nodes and obtained by inputting input graph into a graph neural network, GNN, wherein each node in each input graph comprises a plurality of values corresponding respectively to a plurality of features; determining statistical measures of each feature's values in the subgraphs to generate statistical measures for each subgraph, and obtaining for each subgraph classification probabilities corresponding respectively to a plurality of classes; performing k-means clustering on the subgraphs based on the statistical measures to generate a plurality of clusters of subgraphs; generating, for each cluster of subgraphs, a set of surrogate models to approximate the classification probabilities, respectively, of the subgraphs in the cluster, in terms of the statistical measures; and determining, based on the surrogate models of each set of surrogate models, feature importance scores.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural networks.

title: CADRE DE RÉSEAU NEURONAL DE GRAPHE EN DIRECT POUR DÉTECTION DE FRAUDE
abstract: System and method for providing a live graph neural network framework, the method comprises: providing, in response to a trigger event, a subgraph including a set of nodes connected together by a set of edges based on a first dataset, the set of nodes including a seed node associated with the trigger event, each node including one or more attributes representative of characteristics of the data of the first dataset; providing an input dataset based on transforming the set of nodes and the set of edges of the subgraph into the input dataset; providing a set of embeddings including node embeddings and edge embeddings representative of the subgraph inferenced from the input dataset; and applying a neural network model to the set of embeddings wherein the neural network model is configured to determine a likelihood of node connections in the subgraph.
claims: Method and apparatus for cadre de réseau neuronal de graphe en direct pour détection de fraude.

title: Verfahren zur Ermittlung von Informationen über Aktivitätszustände von Personen aus Radar-Rohdaten unter Verwendung eines Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Es werden ein Verfahren zur Ermittlung von Informationen über Aktivitäten wenigstens eines Objekts (20), insbesondere wenigstens eines Verkehrsteilnehmers, in einem Überwachungsbereich wenigstens eines Radarsystems, insbesondere wenigstens eines Fahrzeug-Radarsystems, aus mit dem wenigstens einen Radarsystem (14) ermittelten Radar-Rohdaten, ein Radarsystem, ein Fahrerassistenzsystem, ein Fahrzeug und ein Algorithmus beschrieben. Bei dem Verfahren wird auf Basis wenigstens eines Teils der Radar-Rohdaten wenigstens ein Graph (72) ermittelt. Der wenigstens eine Graph (72) wird wenigstens einem Graph Neural Network (GAT) zugeführt. Die Information über die Aktivität des wenigstens einen Objekts (20) wird ausgegeben. Informationen über einen Aktivitätszustand wenigstens eines Objekts (20) in Form einer Person (20) werden ermittelt. Mit dem wenigstens einen Graph Neural Network (GAT) wird wenigstens eine Kategorisierungsgröße (78) ausgegeben, welche den Aktivitätszustand der wenigstens einen Person (20) beschreibt.
claims: Method and apparatus for verfahren zur ermittlung von informationen über aktivitätszustände von personen aus radar-rohdaten unter verwendung eines graph neural networks.

title: DEEP DYNAMIC GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS FOR EXPLAINABLE INTENTION ESTIMATION
abstract: [0000]    A method for intention estimation in robot teleoperation tasks is provided. The method may generate dynamic graphs that show spatial relationships over time to predict user intentions for short-horizontal actions and long-horizon tasks.
claims: Method and apparatus for deep dynamic graph neural networks for explainable intention estimation.

title: AUTOMATED ANOMALY DETECTION AND ROOT CAUSE DETERMINATION USING MULTI DIMENSIONAL, MULTI LAYER, MULTI MODEL GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: [0000]    A system may identify a network failure associated with a first network device a first network layer of a network; identify a particular anomaly associated with a second network device of a second layer; identify a logical link between the first and second network devices; determine that the particular anomaly is a causal anomaly with respect to the network failure associated with the first network device; train one or more artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) models to associate one or more network anomalies, associated with the second layer, with one or more network failures associated with the first layer; monitor state information associated with the second network layer of the network system; and predict using the trained one or more AI/ML models, a future occurrence of a future network failure, associated with the first layer, based on monitoring the state information associated with the second network layer.
claims: Method and apparatus for automated anomaly detection and root cause determination using multi dimensional, multi layer, multi model graph neural networks.

title: Electricity stealing node identification method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an electricity stealing node identification method based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: taking a user as a node, taking physical connection and electricity similarity as edges, and constructing a graph attention network; designing a node feature learning model containing an attention mechanism, measuring the importance of neighbor nodes by calculating an attention coefficient, and improving the expression ability of the model by adopting a multi-head attention mechanism; inputting graph data into a multi-layer graph attention network, and extracting high-level node features through layer-by-layer feature aggregation and transformation; constructing a classifier based on the features, predicting the node electricity stealing probability, and judging the electricity stealing node through a threshold value; training the model in an end-to-end mode, updating parameters by means of an optimizer, and preventing over-fitting in combination with regularization and an early stop strategy; and performing forward reasoning on power system data acquired in real time by using the trained model, judging whether the nodes steal electricity or not, and outputting a detection result, thereby realizing efficient and accurate electricity stealing identification. According to the method, collaborative electricity stealing behaviors can be effectively captured, and the accuracy and robustness of electricity stealing identification are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for electricity stealing node identification method based on graph neural network.
assignee: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID GROUP CO LTD

title: Intelligent logistics scheduling method and system based on graph neural network and space-time graph convolution
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent logistics scheduling method and system based on a graph neural network and space-time graph convolution, and relates to the technical field of intelligent logistics scheduling. Comprising the steps of obtaining logistics scheduling basic data, constructing vehicle, goods source and road network node features, performing heterogeneous relationship modeling, and generating a vehicle-goods source-road network three-dimensional topological heterogeneous graph; performing multi-layer neighbor information aggregation on each node by adopting a graph neural network to generate a topology embedding vector; inputting the topological embedded vector into a space-time diagram convolutional network, synchronously extracting space-time coupling features along a time dimension and a space dimension, and obtaining transport capacity demand space-time distribution features; calculating matching priorities of vehicles and goods sources according to the transport capacity demand space-time distribution characteristics, and sorting the matching priorities to generate an initial scheduling scheme; and obtaining a new energy vehicle battery state sequence and a time-of-use electricity price sequence, inputting the sequence attention prediction model, and outputting a charging opportunity recommendation and a charging amount recommendation.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent logistics scheduling method and system based on graph neural network and space-time graph convolution.
assignee: CHUANGFENG SHUZHI TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title: Bridge monitoring data diagnosis method fused with improved graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a bridge monitoring data diagnosis method fusing an improved graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of data diagnosis, and the method comprises the steps: collecting segmented time sequence data corresponding to each sliding time window of a bridge; constructing a dynamic weighted graph topological structure based on the dynamic correlation coefficient of the monitoring data between the monitoring point positions in the sliding time window and the spatial connection relationship between the components of the bridge, and determining the node characteristics of each graph node in the dynamic weighted graph topological structure; constructing an improved graph neural network constrained by a damage propagation path, carrying out iterative updating on the dynamic weighted graph topological structure by a multi-layer graph convolution unit of the improved graph neural network, and outputting deep space correlation features; constructing a space-time cross attention fusion layer perceived by the damage propagation chain, and identifying a space-time fusion feature vector; and outputting a diagnosis result containing the damage propagation chain sequence based on the space-time fusion feature vector. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, efficient linkage diagnosis of the bridge monitoring data and the structure state can be realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for bridge monitoring data diagnosis method fused with improved graph neural network.
assignee: GUIZHOU COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on a graph neural network, and relates to the field of photovoltaic power prediction.The method comprises the steps that short-term power data of a target photovoltaic power station and meteorological data at the current moment are obtained, and whether the target photovoltaic power station is in a power climbing process or not is judged; if in the power climbing process, extracting a power climbing feature, and matching the power climbing feature with a cluster feature of each pre-constructed power climbing feature cluster to determine a target cluster; inputting the target cluster and the meteorological data into a pre-constructed graph neural network for association matching to obtain a historical power change mode and a corresponding historical power reference value; and predicting the photovoltaic power of the target photovoltaic power station at the current moment based on the power climbing characteristics, the historical power change mode and the historical power reference value. The accuracy of photovoltaic power prediction is improved, and the stability of power grid dispatching is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: DALI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title: Short video recommendation method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a short video recommendation method and system based on a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of Internet information retrieval, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a dynamic micrograph; s2, outputting a causal purification micrograph; s3, outputting an initial membrane potential; s4, outputting a charged causal micrograph; s5, outputting a pulse node vector; s6, inputting a pulse node vector into the improved GIN model, performing position locking reweighting and inverse mapping on the sparse order rate spectrum through pulse feature mapping in sequence, and performing graph aggregation and nonlinear mapping by taking a causal attenuation matrix as a weight to output an instantaneous semantic vector; and S7, outputting a final recommendation sorting list. According to the method, the limitation that a traditional method is large in confusion deviation, single in static graph semantics and neglect in non-stationary pulse evolution is overcome, and an efficient solution is provided for real-time personalized recommendation of the short video.
claims: Method and apparatus for short video recommendation method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: KOUSHI BEIJING CULTURE MEDIA CO LTD

title: Electronic component surface defect detection method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic component surface defect detection method based on a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of electronic component surface defect intelligent detection, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting a surface image, calibration data, a structure template and a good product contour, and generating a detection image; performing region calibration on the detection image to generate a structural region set; establishing a slot outline reference table, and generating surface node features; constructing a structural residual error mutual identification graph, and generating a residual error mutual identification edge weight; constructing an improved DGCNN model, and generating a node defect table; remapping according to the slot position contour reference table to generate a defect candidate area; and merging the candidate areas, calculating defect levels, and outputting a surface defect detection result. According to the method, the structural residual error mutual identification graph is introduced and the DGCNN model is improved, so that the structural expression of tiny defects, weak texture defects and slot position offset defects is enhanced, and the surface defects of the electronic component are stably identified.
claims: Method and apparatus for electronic component surface defect detection method based on graph neural network.

title: Adaptive multichannel graph neural network disease gene prediction model and prediction method
abstract: The invention discloses an adaptive multichannel graph neural network disease gene prediction model and prediction method, and the method comprises the steps: S1, building a candidate disease gene prediction input system for a low seed scene through the unified arrangement, standardized mapping and quality control of a PPI network, disease seed genes and GWAS prior information; s2, according to the candidate disease gene prediction input system of the low-seed scene, constructing a disease network representation and feature system oriented to the low-seed scene; s3, constructing a self-adaptive multi-channel graph neural network model AdaMC-GNN oriented to a low seed scene, updating model parameters and training the model; s4, inputting the disease network representation and features of the low-seed scene into a trained adaptive multi-channel graph neural network model AdaMC-GNN oriented to the low-seed scene to obtain a priority sequence of candidate diseases, and fusing local network propagation, cross-disease migration and GWAS prior evidence through a disease level gating mechanism to obtain a disease level gating mechanism; the whole genome exclusion of the candidate pathogenic genes of the sleep-related chronic diseases is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for adaptive multichannel graph neural network disease gene prediction model and prediction method.
assignee: NANJING UNIV OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Dynamic granular ball graph neural network working method for user and article recommendation
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic granular ball graph neural network working method for user and article recommendation, and belongs to the technical field of recommendation systems and graph neural networks. Comprising the following steps: S1, constructing user-side and object-side granular balls in a low-dimensional spectrum space, updating the granular balls according to node representation of each propagation layer, calculating membership degrees from nodes to the granular balls by using a radius normalization distance, and defining collaborative purity according to interactive distribution of the granular balls on opposite-side granular balls; s2, coupling fine-grained interactive modeling and coarse-grained collaborative abstraction, and performing message propagation along two complementary paths; s3, executing bilateral perception gating, and adaptively balancing contributions of two propagation paths for each node; and S4, aggregating the representation of each layer through weighted summation to obtain the final embedding of the user side and the article side, and finally optimizing the score of the candidate article by adopting Bayesian personalized sorting loss, thereby playing a very good recommendation role in sorting the user and the article.
claims: Method and apparatus for dynamic granular ball graph neural network working method for user and article recommendation.

title: Text annotation layout generation method based on graph neural network and diffusion model
abstract: The invention discloses a text annotation layout generation method based on a graph neural network and a diffusion model, and belongs to the technical field of information visualization and intelligent layout. Modeling a text annotation layout task into a condition generation task based on a heterogeneous graph, and constructing an undirected heterogeneous graph containing anchor nodes and annotation nodes to uniformly represent spatial constraints; a diffusion model is adopted to execute forward noise adding and reverse denoising processes, and progressive optimization of an annotation position is realized through multi-step iteration; performing node and edge feature initialization on the heterogeneous graph, and fusing an image saliency clue to guide an annotation to avoid a visual saliency region; node-level updating and pairwise-level updating are executed in sequence through a position sensing hierarchical feature module, and the anchor point-annotation fine-granularity relative position relation is enhanced; and predicting displacement distribution through a hybrid density network decoder, outputting a final layout, and jointly training the model through displacement loss and edge consistency loss. According to the method, the accuracy and readability of text annotation arrangement in a complex scene are effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for text annotation layout generation method based on graph neural network and diffusion model.

title: Dynamic network adaptive routing method based on graph neural network and group relative strategy
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of crossing of computer networks and artificial intelligence, and particularly provides a dynamic network adaptive routing method based on a graph neural network and a group relative strategy, which realizes adaptive sensing of network topologies of different scales and types through a graph neural network encoder. The dependence on a value network is eliminated through a group relative strategy optimization algorithm, so that the complexity of the model is reduced, and cross-topology generalization, energy perception and load balancing are realized on the basis of adaptive network dynamic change and effective avoidance of harmful nodes; compared with traditional shortest path routing, Q-Routing, PPO-MLP and other baseline methods, the method has significant advantages in key indexes such as average end-to-end delay, average queuing delay, data packet delivery rate and the like, the training convergence speed is higher, and the accumulated reward is promoted earlier to reach a higher level; in conclusion, the method has excellent routing performance and destroy resistance, and is particularly suitable for routing scenes in high-dynamic and multi-fault environments.
claims: Method and apparatus for dynamic network adaptive routing method based on graph neural network and group relative strategy.
assignee: UNIV OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title: Graph neural network driven power distribution network topology identification and anomaly detection system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution network topology identification and anomaly detection system and method fusing multi-source measurement and based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the multi-source electrical quantity of a power distribution network, constructing a network node-branch graph structure, and achieving the node state deduction, line connection relation identification and abnormal node positioning through the graph neural network. By introducing a graph attention network, a graph sampling and aggregation network and a graph converter architecture, the robustness of topology identification under the conditions of disturbance, noise and measurement deficiency is remarkably improved, and real-time online topology judgment and anomaly detection are realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network driven power distribution network topology identification and anomaly detection system and method.
assignee: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title: Deep ground space intelligent ventilation system design method based on multi-modal graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a deep space intelligent ventilation system design method and device based on a multi-modal graph neural network, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-source engineering data and standard text data; performing topology modeling based on the multi-source engineering data to obtain a multi-modal hypergraph; performing constraint rule modeling based on the standard text data to obtain a constraint rule; inputting the multi-modal hypergraph and the constraint rule into a pre-trained ventilation scheme hypergraph generation network, so that the ventilation scheme hypergraph generation network generates a ventilation scheme hypergraph under the constraint of the constraint rule; and performing engineering parameter analysis and construction process adaptation on the ventilation scheme hypergraph to generate a ventilation system construction scheme. By means of the technical scheme, the design efficiency can be improved, and data linkage of the design and construction full life cycle is achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for deep ground space intelligent ventilation system design method based on multi-modal graph neural network.
assignee: CHINA RAILWAY 18TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title: Communication system resource optimization method, system and equipment based on DBSCAN clustering algorithm and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a communication system resource optimization method, system and device based on a DBSCAN clustering algorithm and a graph neural network. Belongs to the technical field of communication system resource optimization. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, based on decentralized adaptive clustering of a DBSCAN clustering algorithm, mapping aggregated users to an IRS link, mapping dispersed users to a UAV link, then based on a communication process, calculating the sum of signal transmission rates of the aggregated users and the dispersed users, and then, according to the sum of the signal transmission rates, determining that the UAVs are in the communication process. Determining an optimization objective function of IRS-UAV double-link cooperative communication, and finally performing performance optimization on the optimization objective function through a graph neural network to obtain a resource optimization result; the system, the equipment and the equipment are used for implementing the method. According to the method, the communication cost is low, the design complexity is low, the design is comprehensive, the optimization scheme is simple and easy to implement, the optimization efficiency is high, the optimization adaptability and flexibility are high, and the calculation overhead is low.
claims: Method and apparatus for communication system resource optimization method, system and equipment based on dbscan clustering algorithm and graph neural network.

title: Null sub-chip integrated with physical information graph neural network acceleration core and potential field regulation and control method of null sub-chip
abstract: The invention discloses a void chip integrated with a physical information graph neural network acceleration core and a potential field regulation and control method of the void chip, and belongs to the technical field of quantum semiconductor integrated circuits and space field energy regulation and control. The null sub-chip comprises an electrode array layer, a quantum bit layer, a potential source topology mapping module, a GNN hardware acceleration core and a controller. The GNN hardware acceleration core is completely integrated in a chip, comprises a graph convolution operation unit, a physical constraint storage unit and a voltage mapping unit, and is used for converting GNN operation logic into hardware. The potential field regulation and control method comprises the steps that a potential source topological mapping module constructs a potential source space topological graph; a GNN hardware acceleration core calls rules in a physical constraint storage unit, and global optimal energy distribution is solved through hardware-level graph convolution operation iteration; and the voltage mapping unit converts the optimal energy value into a driving voltage and loads the driving voltage to the electrode array layer to construct a dynamic adjustable nonlinear potential well. The neural network algorithm is solidified into a hardware IP core, the risk of patent intellectual activity rule rejection is avoided, real-time adaptive closed-loop regulation and control of the space potential field are realized, the problem of energy taking instability caused by space potential energy fluctuation is solved, and the method is suitable for space passive energy taking and novel propulsion scenes.
claims: Method and apparatus for null sub-chip integrated with physical information graph neural network acceleration core and potential field regulation and control method of null sub-chip.

title: SYSTEM FOR PRIVACY-PRESERVING ZERO-DAY THREAT DETECTION IN ENCRYPTED TRAFFIC USING FEDERATED GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: [0000]    A system and method for privacy-preserving real-time zero-day threat detection in encrypted network traffic using federated temporal graph neural networks with integrated explainable artificial intelligence is disclosed. The system comprises a network interface controller configured to receive encrypted packet streams, a metadata extraction unit configured to derive non-payload attributes without decrypting packet contents, and a temporal graph construction unit configured to generate a dynamic graph representation of communication entities and their time-varying interactions. A plurality of distributed graph processing devices perform iterative message passing operations on the temporal graph, and a federated coordination processor aggregates locally computed model parameter updates using a secure aggregation unit without accessing raw data. An inference processor applies the aggregated model to detect anomalous communication patterns indicative of zero-day threats, while an explainability processor determines contribution scores of graph components to generate interpretable outputs.
claims: Method and apparatus for system for privacy-preserving zero-day threat detection in encrypted traffic using federated graph neural networks.

title: A REAL-TIME DEADLOCK DETECTION SYSTEM USING A HYBRID GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK AND LSTM FRAMEWORK
abstract: The present invention is related to a real-time deadlock detection system using a hybrid graph neural network and LSTM framework. It is an effective cost-effective system design to help in increasing the reliability and the system performance to the unknown computing condition. The current invention demonstrates one example of a mechanism and a way to predict and identify deadlocks of concurrent and distributed computing systems by using an artificial intelligence approach. It models process and resource states in the form of directed graph. The invention applies machine learning algorithms to labeled sets of combinations of process-resource allocation patterns to provide an approximation of the likelihood that a given system state will be safe or deadlocked. The invention can execute in real-time relative to the previous cycle-detection algorithms or trace-based monitoring. It achieves this by deriving structural graph information and performing light-weight AI inference with less computational and false alarm. The technology can be installed on databases or a cloud infrastructure or operating systems. It continues to keep track of allocation requests, anticipates potential deadlocks before the execution shutdown. The solution is a helpful cost-effective system design to assist in raising the reliability and the system performance to the unknown computing condition capable of actively intervening.
claims: Method and apparatus for a real-time deadlock detection system using a hybrid graph neural network and lstm framework.

title: Catalyst performance prediction method and device based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a catalyst performance prediction method and device based on a graph neural network, and relates to the field of catalyst performance analysis. Inputting the initialized directed graph into the trained performance prediction model, and updating atomic scalar and vector features based on a message passing mechanism; the Transformer layer generates a physical bias tensor through a track overlap key encoder and integrates the physical bias tensor into attention calculation; the active site broadcast layer identifies key atoms, aggregates features and broadcasts globally, and modulates through a gating mechanism; and pooling the final scalar feature mean value, splicing active site embedded vectors, and outputting an adsorption energy predicted value by a multi-layer sensor. Message passing is introduced to ensure three-dimensional symmetry capture, feature dilution is prevented through key atom broadcasting and mask pooling, and active site local electron disturbance dominates global energy prediction.
claims: Method and apparatus for catalyst performance prediction method and device based on graph neural network.
assignee: JIANGXI UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Structural damage identification method based on global conservation graph physical neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a structural damage identification method based on a global conservation graph physical neural network, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a structural dynamic response signal through a sensor array, converting the structural dynamic response signal into a high-dimensional time feature through Fourier feature mapping, and constructing a graph structure in combination with a structural physical topology; and inputting into a pre-constructed physical information graph neural network for spatial feature extraction and motion state prediction, thereby realizing intelligent identification of the structural damage position and damage degree. According to the method, the spatial topology modeling capability of the graph neural network is creatively fused with a physical partial differential equation, and a time integral-based macroscopic energy-momentum global conservation loss mechanism and a Huber truncation-based two-step alternating decoupling optimization strategy are introduced; the problems of physical baseline drift, high-frequency feature invisibility and gradient ill-conditioned coupling among physical parameters of a traditional physical information model in a strong noise environment are effectively solved. According to the method, accurate positioning and quantitative evaluation of the structural damage under the extreme noise working condition can be realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for structural damage identification method based on global conservation graph physical neural network.

title: Medical semantic image synthesis method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a medical semantic image synthesis method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining a continuous medical image semantic mask slice sequence, constructing a spatial adjacency graph through employing adjacent slices in the slice sequence, and generating an adjacency matrix; s2, aggregating multi-scale context features of adjacent slices through a graph neural network, and generating a slice feature graph fusing a spatial dependency relationship; s3, a three-dimensional space noise tensor aligned with physical coordinates of the volume data is injected, discontinuity between slices is eliminated through three-dimensional smoothing, and a fused feature map is generated; s4, inputting the fused feature map into a deconvolution decoder subjected to spatial adaptive normalization modulation to generate a synthetic medical image sequence; s5, discriminating the synthetic medical image sequence through a gray-texture combined classifier; according to the method, the three-dimensional graph neural network fused with the spatial context is constructed, and the three-dimensional space noise subjected to residual modulation and smoothing is injected, so that the synthetic medical image sequence is generated.
claims: Method and apparatus for medical semantic image synthesis method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: THE NINTH PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF CHONGQING

title: Grid-connected intelligent monitoring method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of grid-connected monitoring, and discloses a grid-connected intelligent monitoring method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, calculating a graph impedance distance; s2, calculating the reachable support density; s3, extracting a folding curvature; s4, calculating a spatial embedding vector; s5, calculating a global semantic vector; step S6, decoding the position density; and S7, calculating the distance to the grid-connected point. According to the method, a charged topological matrix and a graph impedance distance are constructed in real time, a fault propagation path is established on the basis of a current operation topology, a pre-fault reference vector, disturbance accumulation, a support coefficient and reachable support density are combined, a result for fault classification judgment is output, and meanwhile, a distance result capable of being mapped to an actual line section is output. Therefore, on-line monitoring of the multi-source grid-connected power distribution network is adapted.
claims: Method and apparatus for grid-connected intelligent monitoring method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: ZOUXIAN POWER PLANT OF HUADIAN POWER INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION LTD

title: Sparse calculation method and system of graph neural network, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a sparse calculation method and system of a graph neural network, a terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of graph neural network calculation acceleration, in the process of calculating a sparse adjacency matrix A and an output matrix C = AB of a dense feature matrix B of a node by the graph neural network, the sparse adjacency matrix A is coded in a compressed sparse row CSR format, and the sparse adjacency matrix A is coded in a compressed sparse row CSR format; a row of an output matrix C is distributed and calculated for each thread block on the GPU, and for each multiplication in the SpMM, the multiplication is ingeniously mapped into dense matrix operation which can be executed by the TCU once. In this way, the TCU can directly consume the data flow in the CSR format, and the zero filling and data format conversion preprocessing step which consumes time and memory in the prior art is thoroughly eliminated. According to the innovative calculation mapping mode, the sparse calculation problem is converted into a dense calculation task which the TCU is good at, the powerful calculation potential of the TCU is fully released, and the performance is remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for sparse calculation method and system of graph neural network, terminal and storage medium.
assignee: NATIONAL UNIV OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY OF PLA

title: Carbon footprint dynamic accounting method based on graph neural network and long-distance dependence
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic carbon footprint accounting method based on a graph neural network and long-distance dependence. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-level carbon footprint accounting heterogeneous graph; performing local aggregation on the subdivided links by using a relational graph convolutional neural network model RGCN to generate enhanced total link features; inputting the total link feature sequence into a Transform encoder, capturing long-distance dependence through a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and outputting overall link features of global optimization; carrying out joint training on a multi-level path prediction model (RGCN + transformer encoder + link prediction decoder), and capturing a potential inter-link relationship for amplifying a multi-level carbon footprint accounting heterogeneous graph; and carrying out model dynamic adaptation by adopting incremental learning of local parameter adjustment or accompanying graph structure updating. The invention provides a method capable of automatically reasoning and amplifying a carbon footprint accounting path. The method is used for optimizing the carbon footprint accounting precision.
claims: Method and apparatus for carbon footprint dynamic accounting method based on graph neural network and long-distance dependence.

title: Enterprise ever name link generation method and system based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides an enterprise ever name link generation method and system based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-source heterogeneous enterprise data, taking enterprise names as nodes, taking the confidence coefficient, investment relation, legal person association and document co-occurrence relation of the names belonging to the same entity as various types of edges, and carrying out the multi-source heterogeneous enterprise data; constructing an enterprise heterogeneous graph, and endowing each edge with a weight; constructing comprehensive feature representation for each enterprise name based on the multi-source heterogeneous enterprise data and the enterprise heterogeneous graph; jointly inputting the comprehensive feature representation of each node and the enterprise heterogeneous graph with the weight into a graph neural network model, performing weighted aggregation on neighbor node features by taking an edge weight as a contribution coefficient, and outputting a low-dimensional feature representation of each node; clustering the low-dimensional feature representations, and merging the name nodes belonging to the same cluster into the same enterprise entity; and according to the duration time interval, performing time sequence consistency verification on the names in the same entity after merging, and generating an enterprise name evolution link.
claims: Method and apparatus for enterprise ever name link generation method and system based on heterogeneous graph neural network.
assignee: BEIJING AODETA DATA TECH CO LTD

title: Ethereum MEV transaction real-time detection method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides an Ethereum MEV transaction real-time detection method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the real-time monitoring of a to-be-packaged transaction in an Ethereum memory pool, and synchronously obtaining the uplink historical transaction data; constructing a to-be-processed transaction block based on the to-be-packaged transaction, and executing under-chain simulation in a state consistent with the current main network to obtain an under-chain simulation result; constructing a transaction sub-graph according to the historical transaction data and the under-chain simulation result; performing structured processing on the transaction sub-graph, inputting the transaction sub-graph into a pre-constructed optimized layout neural network model for classification and identification, and outputting a transaction category; when the transaction category is a normal transaction, only the real-time detection result is archived; when the transaction type is MEV transaction, triggering risk early warning and sending early warning information to the outside; wherein the MEV transaction comprises a front run transaction, a rear run transaction, an arbitrage transaction and a clearing transaction; and bringing a real-time detection result into a training set for periodically updating and optimizing the layout neural network model.
claims: Method and apparatus for ethereum mev transaction real-time detection method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Self-supervised ablation process grid deformation method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a self-supervision ablation process grid deformation method and system based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of computational mechanics and numerical simulation. The method comprises the following steps: representing a volume grid in numerical simulation of the ablation thermal protection system as a directed attribute graph, and constructing micro-mapping from an ablation state to a vertex displacement field by taking grid geometric information and vertex-by-vertex ablation coefficients as input characteristics; under the condition that no supervised displacement label is needed, graph neural network parameters are jointly optimized through three self-supervised constraints including normal backward consistency loss, unit effectiveness loss and displacement field smoothness loss, and therefore a grid deformation result meeting the ablation motion requirement is obtained. According to the method, a network structure does not need to be adjusted according to different unit types, the effectiveness of the grid units can be kept while the given ablation retreat amount is accurately approached, the stability and robustness are kept, and a self-supervised, differentiable and unit type-independent implementation mode is provided for moving grid motion in ablation numerical simulation.
claims: Method and apparatus for self-supervised ablation process grid deformation method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Intelligent conference recommendation method and system based on graph neural network and joint constraint optimization
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent conference recommendation method and system based on a graph neural network and joint constraint optimization, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. Comprising the following steps: constructing a heterogeneous graph structure of users and conferences, and extracting an entity node set; performing deep semantic coding and numerical feature splicing on the conference nodes to generate a conference node feature matrix; optimizing edge index construction of the heterogeneous graph by adopting a dictionary mapping algorithm; the node feature matrix and the optimized edge index are input into a heterogeneous graph convolutional network, and deep embedding representation is output in combination with contrast learning; and calculating a matching score according to the embedded representation, and introducing conflict detection, diversity reordering and interpretability path generation to obtain a recommendation result and a recommendation reason. According to the method, heterogeneous information, semantic understanding and enhancement strategies are fused, and the accuracy, diversity and interpretability of conference recommendation can be effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent conference recommendation method and system based on graph neural network and joint constraint optimization.

title: Parkinson's disease auxiliary diagnosis system and method based on dynamic graph neural network model
abstract: The invention relates to the field of precision medicine and artificial intelligence, in particular to a Parkinson's disease auxiliary diagnosis system and method based on a dynamic graph neural network model. The system comprises a micro-service architecture platform constructed based on Springboot, and the micro-service architecture platform serves as a unified API gateway and at least comprises a graph neural network model micro-service, a gene graph analysis micro-service and a gene screening micro-service. According to the method, the gene plane filter network is constructed through a multi-scale embedded gene co-expression network analysis technology, Parkinson's disease prediction is performed in combination with the dynamic graph neural network model, and rapid and efficient auxiliary diagnosis is realized. The invention also provides an interactive gene network map, which supports visual analysis of 1000 gene nodes and nearly 3000 gene regulation edges, and is helpful for deeply understanding disease mechanisms and formulating personalized treatment schemes. According to the invention, the problems of long period, poor accuracy, large patient burden and the like of the traditional Parkinson's disease diagnosis method are solved, and an innovative solution is provided for early screening and accurate diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
claims: Method and apparatus for parkinson's disease auxiliary diagnosis system and method based on dynamic graph neural network model.

title: NAND flash memory unit aging state evolution prediction method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an NAND flash memory unit aging state evolution prediction method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, obtaining the state attribute and physical adjacency relation of each storage unit in an NAND flash memory array, mapping the flash memory array into a graph data structure, enabling the storage units to be nodes, enabling the physical adjacency relation to be edges, and enabling the graph data structure to be a graph data structure; the state attribute is a node feature; then, the graph data structure is input into a pre-trained spatio-temporal evolution graph neural network model, a spatial information aggregation module and a time state updating module are arranged in the model, and the model is used for learning and reasoning to obtain aging state prediction results of the storage units at future time points; finally, the storage controller performs a prospective reliability management operation according to the prediction result. The method overcomes the defect that a traditional method cannot accurately model a spatio-temporal evolution rule, unit-level and high-precision aging state prediction can be achieved, and therefore the service life of the flash memory is effectively prolonged.
claims: Method and apparatus for nand flash memory unit aging state evolution prediction method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Intelligent analysis method and system for distribution network dispatching operation ticket based on neural algorithm and topological graph
abstract: The invention discloses a distribution network scheduling operation ticket intelligent analysis method and system based on a neural algorithm and a topological graph, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a scheduling operation rule base based on a distribution network scheduling operation management rule and a historical compliance operation ticket; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a distribution network dispatching operation ticket, preprocessing an operation ticket text, and extracting key information; constructing a dynamically updated topological graph by combining real-time data of the distribution network, combining key information, real-time state characteristics of the topological graph and rule characteristics in a scheduling operation rule base, inputting a bidirectional long-short-term memory network model, and generating an operation sequence scheme; and performing multi-stage intelligent verification on the operation sequence scheme to identify and correct abnormal items, performing parameter iterative optimization on the bidirectional long-short-term memory network model in combination with manual feedback data, and outputting a standardized result. The problems that a traditional analysis method is insufficient in semantic understanding, lack of sequence logic verification and poor in adaptability can be solved, and the method is high in analysis accuracy, high in generalization ability, safe, reliable and outstanding in efficiency.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent analysis method and system for distribution network dispatching operation ticket based on neural algorithm and topological graph.

title: SCR denitration all-working-condition ammonia injection control method based on graph neural network and double-Q learning
abstract: The invention provides an SCR denitration all-working-condition ammonia injection control method based on a graph neural network and double-Q learning. The method comprises the steps that the section of an SCR denitration reactor is divided into a plurality of nodes according to all ammonia spraying partitions, initial feature vectors composed of denitration inlet NOx concentration, inlet smoke temperature, ammonia escape concentration, ammonia spraying control valve opening and pressure difference signals are configured for all the nodes, space adjacent edges and flow field correlation edges are added between all the nodes, and a heterogeneous graph is constructed; the space adjacent edges are arranged between the adjacent nodes and represent the influence of the flow field diffusion effect on ammonia escape of the adjacent ammonia spraying partitions; the flow field correlation edge is arranged between non-adjacent nodes and represents a remote flow field coupling effect caused by flue gas bias flow between non-adjacent ammonia spraying partitions; and updating the heterogeneous graph in real time, extracting global flow field features by using a graph neural network model, solving an optimal control action through a double-Q learning model, outputting and executing ammonia injection control valve actions of all ammonia injection partitions, and realizing SCR denitration all-working-condition accurate ammonia injection control.
claims: Method and apparatus for scr denitration all-working-condition ammonia injection control method based on graph neural network and double-q learning.
assignee: GUONENG SICHUAN TIANMING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title: RAG document recall method based on graph neural network and knowledge graph
abstract: The invention provides an RAG document recall method based on a graph neural network and a knowledge graph. The RAG document recall method comprises the following steps: constructing a basic node set containing sentence nodes and article nodes; performing named entity recognition on the sentence texts in the basic node set; performing normalization processing on the entity mention fragment, and performing vector coding on the entity name; edges are constructed according to the incidence relation between the nodes; obtaining question-sentence matching data to construct training data; performing graph aggregation on the knowledge graph; normalizing the graph enhanced embedding of the sentence nodes, and calculating the score of the inner product of the problem vector and the normalized graph enhanced embedding of the sentence nodes; taking a preset number of non-positive example sentence nodes with higher scores as negative examples; training the graph neural network; and outputting a recall result corresponding to the problem vector by using the trained graph neural network. According to the scheme, the integrity and accuracy of document recall in a multi-hop reasoning scene are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for rag document recall method based on graph neural network and knowledge graph.
assignee: SHANGHAI WISDOM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: SOC estimation method based on battery feature extraction and graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electric vehicle power batteries, and discloses an SOC estimation method based on battery feature extraction and a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining the feature data of a to-be-detected battery, and carrying out the data preprocessing of the feature data; s2, performing feature extraction on the feature data subjected to data preprocessing by adopting an auto-encoder to obtain a plurality of feature vectors; s3, dynamically constructing a graph structure based on each feature vector, wherein each original graph node of the graph structure is each feature vector; s4, modeling based on the graph structure by adopting a pre-trained graph neural network, and updating each original graph node of the graph structure to obtain each updated graph node; and S5, estimating the SOC of the to-be-tested battery based on each updated graph node by using a pre-trained regression network. According to the method, the graph structure is dynamically constructed by taking each feature vector as the original graph node, so that the graph structure can update the original graph node according to the battery state, and the accuracy of an estimation result is further improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for soc estimation method based on battery feature extraction and graph neural network.
assignee: CHINA AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title: Power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of power electronics. The method comprises the following steps: collecting fundamental wave monitoring data of each disturbance source; constructing an incidence relation between fundamental wave disturbance and harmonic wave disturbance of the disturbance source, and inputting fundamental wave monitoring data to obtain a harmonic current injection value of the disturbance source; based on the harmonic current injection value, determining a harmonic current value of each node of the power distribution network under each working condition combination of the disturbance source; constructing a training data set based on the fundamental wave monitoring data of each disturbance source and the harmonic current value of each node; constructing a GNN harmonic state estimation model, and training based on the training data set; and inputting fundamental wave monitoring data to be estimated into the GNN harmonic state estimation model, and outputting a harmonic current estimation value of each node in the power distribution network. The method can effectively solve the technical problem of lack of harmonic monitoring data, can support the real-time estimation of the harmonic state of the power distribution network, and can guarantee the precision and physical rationality of the harmonic state estimation of the power distribution network.
claims: Method and apparatus for power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on graph neural network.
assignee: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title: Equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on graph pulse neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment fault diagnosis, in particular to an equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on a graph spiking neural network, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the data preprocessing of an original time sequence signal collected by an equipment sensor, and obtaining an input feature matrix; performing graph neural network modeling based on the input feature matrix, mapping each graph node into a corresponding spiking neuron, and generating a time sequence pulse feature sequence by taking the spatial structure feature as an input current or a bias item of the spiking neuron; triple neural gating information fidelity pooling processing is carried out on the spatial structure features and the time sequence pulse feature sequence, and fusion feature representation is output; the graph pulse neural network model is trained and optimized based on the fusion feature representation, the fusion feature representation is classified and decoded according to optimized model parameters, the fault type of the equipment component is determined, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis is remarkably improved through cooperative extraction of equipment space structure information and time sequence dynamic features.
claims: Method and apparatus for equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on graph pulse neural network.

title: Photovoltaic power probability prediction method based on deep learning and graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a photovoltaic power probability prediction method based on deep learning and a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, generating a steady-state power sequence and a high-frequency fluctuation residual sequence; s2, constructing a fluctuation intensity vector; s3, constructing a dual-channel spatial-temporal feature extraction model; s4, generating a final photovoltaic power probability prediction result; a high-frequency fluctuation residual error sequence is reserved, a fluctuation intensity vector is constructed, a two-channel graph neural network architecture is utilized to decouple and model meteorological trend and wave disturbance, and then expectation, variance and skewness of probability prediction are dynamically adjusted according to wind wave intensity through parametric calibration. Therefore, the problems of information loss and too narrow prediction interval caused by filtering high-frequency information in the prior art are solved, accurate description of power one-way drop and variance expansion under the heavy storm working condition is realized, and the reliability of probability prediction and the safety of power grid dispatching are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for photovoltaic power probability prediction method based on deep learning and graph neural network.
assignee: DALI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title: Marine sound velocity field reconstruction method based on graph constraint matrix decomposition neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean sound velocity field reconstruction method based on a graph constraint matrix decomposition neural network. Firstly, sound velocity field historical data of a target sea area is obtained and preprocessed, and sound velocity field preprocessed data and a sound velocity field mean value are obtained; thirdly, constructing a graph Laplacian matrix reflecting the spatial correlation of the sound velocity field; then, the matrix decomposition neural network model is trained until training is completed, the trained matrix decomposition neural network model is obtained, a total loss function in the model training process is constructed based on a graph Laplacian matrix and multi-source observation data, and then a reconstructed sound velocity field of the target sea area is generated. According to the method, multi-source heterogeneous observation data are effectively fused, high-precision sound velocity field reconstruction is achieved under the sparse sampling condition, the problems that an existing method is insufficient in expressive power, high in parameter uncertainty and difficult to effectively fuse multi-source heterogeneous data under sparse observation are effectively solved, and the method has high engineering application value in underwater acoustic detection and marine environment monitoring.
claims: Method and apparatus for marine sound velocity field reconstruction method based on graph constraint matrix decomposition neural network.

title: Energy consumption acceleration prediction method and system based on graph neural network building component expression
abstract: The invention discloses an energy consumption acceleration prediction method and system based on graph neural network building component expression, and relates to the field of building energy consumption prediction, and the method comprises the steps: generating building samples with different spatial features based on a parameterized design platform; building component data and component adjacency relation data are obtained; component node feature vectors are extracted, an adjacent matrix is constructed, and a graph structure is formed; constructing a GAT model fusing attention; obtaining accurate energy consumption label data through a physical simulation engine; carrying out iterative training on the GAT model and adjusting hyper-parameters; performing multi-scale disturbance on the component node feature vector, and calculating a feature sensitivity weight; performing structural disturbance on the adjacent matrix, and calculating a structural weight; and inputting the component node feature vector of the building model to be predicted into the pre-training model, and outputting a total energy consumption predicted value and an influence matrix. According to the method, rapid and accurate prediction of the building energy consumption is realized, and the influence degree of each component and the relationship thereof on the energy consumption can be analyzed.
claims: Method and apparatus for energy consumption acceleration prediction method and system based on graph neural network building component expression.
assignee: SHANGHAI DUOYUAN YONGXIAN TECH CO LTD

title: Student roll file security query method, system and equipment based on graph neural network and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a school roll file security query method, system and device based on a graph neural network and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a natural language query of a user, and converting the natural language query of the user into a graph query description to obtain a graph query request; based on an access control strategy and user permission information, recombining the graph query request to obtain a security query statement; performing graph neural network enhanced query in the student status relationship graph to obtain a preliminary query sub-graph; performing privacy protection processing on the preliminary query sub-graph to obtain a privacy query sub-graph, and generating a query result description based on the privacy query sub-graph; and converting the privacy query subgraph into a visual form to obtain a visual query result, and inputting the query result description and the visual query result into corresponding positions of a query report template to obtain a query result report. By adopting the method, the graph neural model can be introduced to identify the abnormal association, and the query reliability is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for student roll file security query method, system and equipment based on graph neural network and medium.

title: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for economic operation based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an economic operation intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: collecting multi-dimensional economic operation core parameters through a global economic network intelligent perception early warning platform, constructing a dynamic data set, and building index association mapping; a multi-scale economic risk graph neural network embedding model is adopted to extract depth features, a dynamic association network is constructed through a cross-regional economic node association degree dynamic game algorithm, deep semantic features are aggregated through a multi-dimensional macroeconomic heterogeneous graph convolution model, and high-dimensional feature representation is generated; and real-time risk identification and grade determination are realized in combination with a dynamic early warning threshold, and targeted early warning information is output. According to the method, feature mining, correlation analysis and risk assessment processes are carried out through a model parameter and threshold adjustment mechanism, an intelligent monitoring and early warning scheme is formed, the accuracy, dynamism and timeliness of economic operation monitoring are improved, and reliable technical support is provided for economic risk prevention and control.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent monitoring and early warning method and system for economic operation based on graph neural network.

title: Knowledge graph-BOM bidirectional navigation and dynamic maintenance method and system based on graph neural network and knowledge association local update, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a knowledge graph-BOM bidirectional navigation and dynamic maintenance method and system based on a graph neural network and knowledge association local update, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of knowledge graph-BOM bidirectional navigation and dynamic maintenance. The problems of dynamic association maintenance and efficient bidirectional retrieval between the BOM and the knowledge graph in the existing intelligent manufacturing field are solved. The method comprises the steps of performing deep semantic embedding on a BOM graph and a knowledge graph based on a graph neural network, and constructing a unified vector space; monitoring attribute changes of the BOM nodes, updating node embedding vectors of the BOM nodes, and performing associated local updating on the changed BOM nodes and the knowledge entity nodes and the BOM nodes associated with the changed BOM nodes; and carrying out bidirectional navigation and dynamic maintenance of the knowledge graph-BOM by adopting a bidirectional navigation index mode based on dynamic threshold adjustment.
claims: Method and apparatus for knowledge graph-bom bidirectional navigation and dynamic maintenance method and system based on graph neural network and knowledge association local update, computer equipment and storage medium.

title: Space-time dynamic OD prediction method based on fusion of graph neural network and real-time traffic state
abstract: The invention provides a spatial-temporal dynamic OD prediction method based on graph neural network fusion with a real-time traffic state, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first traffic OD information, predicted through a graph neural network in a current time step, in a first time period in the future; according to an individual behavior constraint condition, performing constraint processing on an individual behavior in the first traffic OD information to obtain second traffic OD information; performing weighted fusion according to the first traffic OD information, the second traffic OD information and corresponding first weight values to obtain target traffic OD information; loading the target traffic OD information to a cellular-based lane traffic simulation network for observation to obtain simulation observation traffic information; and correcting parameters in the lane traffic simulation network and/or the individual behavior constraint condition according to the simulation observation traffic information and the traffic information actually measured on site. The predicted traffic OD information has interpretability, a physical consistency closed loop is realized, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for space-time dynamic od prediction method based on fusion of graph neural network and real-time traffic state.
