title: Power grid equipment probabilistic residual life prediction method and system based on maintenance event driven graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment monitoring and maintenance, in particular to a power grid equipment probabilistic residual life prediction method and system based on a maintenance event driven graph neural network. The method aims to solve the problems that the prediction technology neglects coupling between devices, the maintenance influence cannot be quantified, and the prediction result lacks risk measurement. Comprising the steps that a dynamic equipment relation graph fusing static topology, real-time operation coupling and maintenance event impact is constructed, and a maintenance event is modeled as an edge weight impulse response which is exponentially decayed along with time; performing multi-scale time sequence feature coding on the equipment monitoring data; neighbor information is aggregated through an event-enhanced graph attention network, and fusion context node representation is generated; and adopting a parameterized deep survival analysis model to directly regress residual life probability distribution parameters so as to output a failure probability and a confidence interval. According to the method, the prediction precision and the risk sorting capability are remarkably improved, the influence of key maintenance events can be traced, and a reliable tool is provided for risk-based power grid operation and maintenance decisions.
claims: Method and apparatus for power grid equipment probabilistic residual life prediction method and system based on maintenance event driven graph neural network.
assignee: HEZE POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Intelligent electric meter anomaly judgment method based on power grid measurement knowledge graph, manifold complex value neural network and adversarial generation enhancement
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent electric meter abnormity judgment method based on a power grid measurement knowledge graph, a manifold complex value neural network and adversarial generation enhancement. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ammeter reading data and context information of a to-be-detected intelligent ammeter, inputting a pre-trained ammeter anomaly detection model, and mapping the ammeter reading data and the context information into a to-be-detected reading sample; obtaining a normal reading sample and a target map embedding feature of the intelligent electric meter to be detected, and constructing a target condition manifold taking context information as a condition; determining a manifold deviation distance and a tangent space residual error of the target condition manifold; target map embedding features are obtained, ammeter reading data are converted into complex value input, the complex value input is input into a pre-trained complex value space-time diagram neural network, and the abnormal probability of the to-be-detected intelligent ammeter is output; and according to the manifold deviation distance, the tangent space residual error and the anomaly probability, outputting an anomaly detection result of the to-be-detected intelligent electric meter. By adopting the method, the fault detection accuracy and robustness of the intelligent electric meter can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent electric meter anomaly judgment method based on power grid measurement knowledge graph, manifold complex value neural network and adversarial generation enhancement.
assignee: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title: GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK AND TRANSFORMER-BASED TASK PLANNER
abstract: Disclosed is a graph neural network (GNN) and transformer-based task planner. A task planning method performed by a task planning system may include constructing a task planner model based on a graph neural network and a transformer; and generating a task plan from a goal instruction of a task and history information of a scene graph through the constructed task planner model.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network and transformer-based task planner.

title: PREDICTING ANIMAL EMOTIONS USING ANIMAL EMOTION KNOWLEDGE GRAPH AND GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: [0000]    This disclosure relates generally to a method and system for predicting animal emotions using animal emotion knowledge graph and graph neural network. Current available methods focus only on visual and language data captured from animals, and lacks real time adaptability. The method disclosed generates an animal emotion knowledge graph (AEKG) that combines human and animal neurobiological data, behavioral studies, and the human wheel of emotions. Further real time graphs are generated from multimodal input data captured from the animal. These real time graphs are used for predicting primary, secondary, and tertiary emotions of the animals using a trained graph neural network-Transformer model. This model is trained using the AEKG. Using temporal graph analysis, the method predicts future emotions and generates real-time recommendations based on generative artificial intelligence techniques. Predicting the emotions of animals in real time helps to grasp their emotional well-being to improve their care and management effectively.
claims: Method and apparatus for predicting animal emotions using animal emotion knowledge graph and graph neural network.

title: Network attack tracing method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the field of network security and deep learning, and discloses a network attack traceability method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a full-time-domain heterogeneous traceability graph; performing long-period attack-oriented time-varying graph feature evolution analysis, performing time sequence fusion on a cache memory vector and a local space feature vector through an entity global unique identifier and a cross-window anchor point mechanism, and maintaining high-dimensional time sequence continuity of hidden features of graph nodes; executing deep heterogeneous semantic coding and causal weight deduction; local feature sensitive path restoration and sub-graph reconstruction are realized; and executing root cause positioning and threat range evaluation. According to the invention, the traceability integrity and accuracy of the long-period advanced persistent threats are improved. The technical problems that according to an existing network attack tracing method based on a graph neural network, cross-window sequential logic breakage is caused by fixed time slicing, and local key attack features are diluted by normal service background noise due to global graph compression are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for network attack tracing method and system based on graph neural network.

title: New media marketing industry fusion degree evaluation method based on graph neural network and industrial knowledge graph
abstract: The invention discloses a new media marketing industry fusion degree evaluation method based on a graph neural network and an industry knowledge graph, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and new media data processing, and is suitable for marketing evaluation scenes of agricultural products, text travelers, non-enthusiasm and regional brands. The problem to be solved is to solve the problems that existing new media evaluation emphasizes flow indexes and is difficult to associate transactions, supply chains, offline undertaking and brand gains. According to the technical scheme, a marketing event account book is established, an industrial knowledge graph is constructed for content, user groups, commodities, industrial links, areas and risk events, node representation is updated by adopting a relation gating graph neural network, and the industrial fusion degree is calculated in combination with reference period correction. The method is mainly used for identifying contribution paths of new media marketing to transaction conversion, industrial collaboration and regional brand propagation, and assisting putting and redisk and industrial resource scheduling.
claims: Method and apparatus for new media marketing industry fusion degree evaluation method based on graph neural network and industrial knowledge graph.

title: Training method of graph neural network for atomic array rearrangement, atomic array rearrangement method using graph neural network, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a training method of a graph neural network for atomic array rearrangement, an atomic array rearrangement method using the graph neural network, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. According to the graph neural network training method for atomic array rearrangement, the minimum cost and the maximum flow are solved on a time extension graph, the optimal frame number is determined through binary search, and the optimal atom-target pairing number and the optimal frame execution number of each atom are extracted from the optimal flow solution to form a joint structured training label. And training a triple-head graph neural network comprising a matching head, a frame allocation head and a compatible head. Therefore, when the atomic array rearrangement method based on the graph neural network is used for atomic array rearrangement, the matching head outputs a pairing result in a micro-pairing decoding mode, and the frame distribution head directly outputs frames to execute numbering by taking argmax for each atom so as to eliminate greedy graph coloring post-processing. Therefore, the path-conflict-free rearrangement of the atomic array with low reasoning delay time and low frame number is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for training method of graph neural network for atomic array rearrangement, atomic array rearrangement method using graph neural network, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium.
assignee: TAIYI LIANGSHENG SHANGHAI QUANTUM TECH CO LTD

title: Sparse heterogeneous graph neural network classification method, system and device and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of graph neural networks, and discloses a sparse heterogeneous graph neural network classification method, system and device and a medium. The classification method comprises the steps of performing semantic decomposition on a sparse heterogeneous graph to obtain a plurality of sub-graphs with different semantic dimensions, constructing sparse hypergraphs according to the sub-graphs, and splicing the sparse hypergraphs to generate a hypergraph incidence matrix; performing feature propagation on the matrix to obtain an original feature matrix, splitting the original feature matrix into enhanced hypergraphs of the nodes according to feature similarity among the nodes, splicing to generate an enhanced incidence matrix, and performing propagation to obtain an enhanced feature matrix; and inputting the original feature matrix and the enhanced feature matrix into hypergraph volume integral branch channels respectively for message passing and feature updating, and performing weighted fusion on normalized prediction results to output a classification result. Semantic heterogeneity is effectively coped with through semantic decomposition and multi-hypergraph construction, neighborhood information under a sparse structure is supplemented by using an enhanced hypergraph, and a double-branch fusion mechanism gives consideration to original topology and enhanced semantics, so that the accuracy and robustness of sparse heterogeneous graph node classification are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for sparse heterogeneous graph neural network classification method, system and device and medium.

title: Graph neural network classification method and system for network storm user classification
abstract: The invention provides a network storm user classification-oriented graph neural network classification method and system. The method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a network storm user classification model; s2, obtaining multi-source fusion node attribute features through a fusion processing method based on the multi-modal information; s3, based on the attribute features of the multi-source fusion nodes and the topological information of the users in the social network, carrying out network storm user classification by utilizing the constructed network storm user classification model; the network storm user classification model integrates a GAT graph neural network model and a GIN graph neural network model, and extracts convolutional layers in the GAT graph neural network model and the GIN graph neural network model to construct a network structure information extraction module and a node embedding and updating module; joint modeling is performed on node features and graph structure information of an input graph through a constructed network structure information extraction module and a node embedding and updating module, deep semantic features of nodes in a network are extracted step by step, and the network nodes are classified based on the extracted deep semantic features of the nodes in the network.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network classification method and system for network storm user classification.

title: Graph neural network hydrodynamic force rapid deduction method based on physical topology prior
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower engineering hydrodynamic simulation, discloses a graph neural network hydrodynamic rapid deduction method based on physical topology prior, and aims to solve the problems that traditional hydrodynamic simulation is insufficient in real-time performance, a deep learning model lacks physical constraints, prediction reliability and interpretability are poor and the like. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining a water network node topology and a water level flow sequence, executing global normalization, and enumerating reasonable combination working conditions to generate a total spatial domain data set; and training a plurality of groups of network models, and screening an optimal deduction model according to a cross-working-condition prediction error. A flow distribution matrix is constructed in model training to generate a global dynamic hydrodynamic response potential field, and initial joint features are generated through two-way coding fusion; a dynamic coupling adjacency matrix guided by physical prior is constructed, global space context features are extracted through graph convolution, and then a water level time sequence is deduced through LSTM autoregression and model parameters are optimized; and deploying the optimal deduction model to an engineering scene, and inputting real-time data to execute hydrodynamic rapid deduction.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network hydrodynamic force rapid deduction method based on physical topology prior.

title: Emergency networking method fusing pre-disaster prior and edge condition graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an emergency networking method fusing pre-disaster prior and an edge condition graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: S1, pre-disaster preparation: pre-disaster state quantification and computing power space-time redistribution; s2, after-disaster instantaneous survival verification and prior activation are carried out; s3, post-disaster perception: carrying out high-dimensional topology state perception based on an edge condition graph neural network EC-GNN; s4, performing post-disaster decision making: performing strategy dynamic evolution based on an anti-fact differential reward mechanism; according to the invention, through prior solidification of a daily state, the distributed nodes carry tendentiousness at the moment of a disaster to directly enter a game state, and a long random trial-and-error period with extremely high power consumption is eliminated. An EC-GNN edge feature modulation mechanism is innovatively provided, abrasion of spatial fading to information entropy is realistically restored, and the situation that all agents output homogeneous error instructions in a congestion scene is avoided. And through an anti-fact differential reward mechanism, the improvement of a single node on local congestion is accurately evaluated.
claims: Method and apparatus for emergency networking method fusing pre-disaster prior and edge condition graph neural network.

title: Supply chain full-process risk control method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain risk control, in particular to a supply chain full-process risk control method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a supply chain heterogeneous graph, and carrying out the channel splitting of a multi-dimensional supply chain sequence, and obtaining a standardized feature sequence of each feature channel; determining a precursor neighbor set of each feature channel of any center node in the supply chain heterogeneous graph; calculating the conduction weight of each neighbor node in the precursor neighbor set to the center node on each feature channel; performing channel-by-channel asynchronous aggregation on each neighbor node in the precursor neighbor set by using a conduction weight to obtain a risk state vector of each feature channel; and splicing the risk state vectors of the feature channels, and mapping through a trained classifier to obtain a risk score of each enterprise node. Through the technical scheme of the invention, the accuracy and traceability of an enterprise risk evaluation result can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for supply chain full-process risk control method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: VTEAM FINANCIAL TECH SERVICE WUHAN CO LTD

title: Battery pack sensor data fusion and collaborative alarm method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of battery management, and discloses a battery pack sensor data fusion and collaborative alarm method based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: taking each physical sensor in a battery pack as a graph node to construct a battery pack topological graph structure; introducing a sliding time window mechanism, position coding and one-dimensional convolution to obtain a high-order time sequence representation of each node of the battery pack, and obtaining a time embedding representation and a channel-time joint representation of the node in a current time window through an attention mechanism; inputting the time embedded representation and the topological graph structure into a graph neural network, and adaptively adjusting an edge weight by adopting a graph attention mechanism to obtain a graph structure feature vector of each node at the current moment; fusing the channel-time joint representation and the graph structure feature vector to obtain the space-time joint representation of each node; and constructing a reconstruction network and a prediction network, calculating a reconstruction error and a prediction error, and introducing a dual-task loss function to carry out anomaly detection alarm. According to the invention, the accuracy and reliability of battery pack safety monitoring are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for battery pack sensor data fusion and collaborative alarm method based on graph neural network.
assignee: CHINA AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title: Network traffic abnormal data intelligent screening method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a network traffic abnormal data intelligent screening method and system based on a graph neural network, relates to the technical field of deep learning, and solves the technical problem of poor generalization ability for unknown attacks in encrypted traffic in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a static network diagram based on historical information and encoding to obtain static node embedding; atomic events are extracted from the real-time flow according to a sliding window, and dynamic potential nodes and initial edge weights are generated through a differentiable graph structure learning device; static embedding and dynamic characteristics are aligned and fused, and regularization constraint is applied to dynamic edge weights by using a static adjacency relation to obtain an optimized dynamic graph; and performing graph convolution operation on the optimized dynamic graph to extract depth features, calculating an abnormal score based on the depth features, and outputting a detection result. The method is used in a real-time traffic anomaly detection process in an encrypted network environment, a graph structure can be automatically learned, priori knowledge is fused, and the detection robustness and generalization ability are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for network traffic abnormal data intelligent screening method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Communication network abnormal flow detection and root cause positioning method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a communication network abnormal flow detection and root cause positioning method based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the unified constraint of a network level, a port position and a forwarding adjacency relation of communication network equipment through a hierarchical port index, and merging a communication session feature, a forwarding adjacency feature and a communication connection state feature, forming a port session matrix, so that the abnormal analysis object is expanded from single traffic statistics to session state expression under a port undertaking relation; the abrupt change positions of the ports are compared in an upstream and downstream order, an abnormal propagation phase matrix is generated, and the propagation sequence of abnormal traffic between the ports can be identified; overlapped phase fragments caused by routing path switching are eliminated through a scheduling phase matrix, and false alarms caused by normal scheduling disturbance are reduced; root cause positioning is carried out by combining the physical pre-sending matrix with the candidate propagation matrix, and a communication connection physical root cause and a flow behavior root cause are distinguished, so that the anomaly detection accuracy and the root cause positioning precision are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for communication network abnormal flow detection and root cause positioning method based on graph neural network.
assignee: GUANGZHOU ARK CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title: Derivative risk measuring and calculating method and system based on RAG and graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a derivative risk measuring and calculating method based on RAG and a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of financial risk analysis. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a directed weighted position topological graph between institutions; generating a pressure scene by using a retrieval enhancement generation large model in combination with KL divergence interception and GARCH constraint; carrying out risk propagation deduction by adopting a GraphSAGE graph neural network in which InfoNCE loss and local adversarial perturbation are introduced; and performing dynamic verification on the hedging operator based on a multi-agent game and high-order Greek letters. The invention also relates to a corresponding system. By adopting the derivative risk measuring and calculating method and system based on the RAG and the graph neural network, the problems of scene generation distortion, evaluation linearization, graph network feature smoothness and hedging simulation deficiency in the prior art are solved, and high-confidence and end-to-end systematic risk quantification and defense verification are realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for derivative risk measuring and calculating method and system based on rag and graph neural network.

title: Bridge structure modal parameter prediction method based on graph neural network and attribute-topology transfer learning
abstract: The invention provides a bridge structure modal parameter prediction method based on a graph neural network and attribute-topology transfer learning. According to the method, a similarity matrix of a bridge group is constructed by introducing a graph kernel method, and a bridge with a high similarity degree is taken as a source domain in combination with an established graph neural network agent model for predicting modal parameters of a health state bridge structure; and predicting the modal parameters of the target bridge in the damaged state by using the structural modal parameter changes of the source domain bridge in different damage degrees. According to the method, the modal parameters of the bridge structure in the damaged state are efficiently and accurately predicted under the condition of target bridge data scarcity.
claims: Method and apparatus for bridge structure modal parameter prediction method based on graph neural network and attribute-topology transfer learning.

title: Multi-scale Transform non-invasive blood pressure prediction method and system based on enhanced graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical monitoring and physiological signal processing, in particular to a multi-scale Transform non-invasive blood pressure prediction method and system based on an enhanced graph neural network. After the photoelectric volume pulse wave signals are subjected to preprocessing and quality screening, local details and cross-period features are extracted through multi-scale parallel convolution; modeling long-term dependence through a Transform encoder fusing rotation position coding, relative position offset and a gating feedforward network; a channel enhancement module activated based on GELU is adopted to enhance blood pressure related features; three prediction tasks of systolic pressure, diastolic pressure and average arterial pressure are constructed into a task graph, continuous arterial blood pressure waveforms and three blood pressure parameters are output after multi-head graph attention interaction aggregation, and end-to-end training is carried out through a composite loss function containing consistency constraints. The precision, stability and physiological consistency of PPG non-invasive blood pressure prediction are improved, and the method is suitable for wearable and bedside continuous monitoring.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-scale transform non-invasive blood pressure prediction method and system based on enhanced graph neural network.

title: Physical constraint graph neural network-based evapotranspiration and soil water collaborative prediction method under climatic change scene
abstract: The invention discloses a physical constraint graph neural network-based evapotranspiration and soil water collaborative prediction method in a climate change scene, and the method comprises the steps: collecting and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a physical constraint graph neural network, implementing a dual reverse feedback mechanism, constructing a composite loss function, and carrying out staged dynamic weight training. And verifying and predicting the model. According to the invention, by constructing a multilayer graph neural network architecture based on physical constraints, the physical consistency and simulation reliability under the force of complex climate in the future are significantly improved. By deeply embedding water balance and variable range constraints in a loss function, the model is forced to still strictly follow the law of conservation of physics when processing a future non-stationary climate mode.
claims: Method and apparatus for physical constraint graph neural network-based evapotranspiration and soil water collaborative prediction method under climatic change scene.

title: Lithium battery energy storage self-circulation generator set energy closed-loop management system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy storage system control, and discloses a lithium battery energy storage self-circulation generator set energy closed-loop management system based on a graph neural network. Comprising an energy storage unit state acquisition module, a battery health feature extraction module, a graph neural network energy flow prediction module, a closed-loop energy optimization decision module, a self-circulation control execution module and a system performance monitoring and adaptive adjustment module. Iterative message passing and neighbor information aggregation are performed on the topological structures and health features of the energy storage units by using the graph neural network, so that the energy flow distribution of each energy storage unit can be accurately predicted; through a closed-loop optimization objective function, predicted energy distribution, a target energy state, an energy storage unit health score and neighbor coordination constraints are considered in a unified manner, a scientific and reasonable charging and discharging control strategy can be generated, and a self-circulation control execution module and a system performance monitoring and self-adaptive adjustment module are utilized to realize self-adaptive control of the energy storage unit. And actually converting the closed-loop optimization strategy into an energy storage unit execution action.
claims: Method and apparatus for lithium battery energy storage self-circulation generator set energy closed-loop management system based on graph neural network.
assignee: ZHEJIANG SHUYUAN NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle formation fault tolerance distributed nonlinear predictive control method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle formation fault tolerance distributed nonlinear predictive control method and system based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a fault dynamic model containing a time-varying thrust loss coefficient and external disturbance, and constructing a formation topological graph based on a communication distance; performing graph structure modeling and neighbor feature aggregation on the formation state by using a graph neural network, estimating a thrust loss coefficient on line, and updating a network output layer weight based on a speed prediction error; the estimated fault coefficient is introduced into a distributed nonlinear model prediction controller, a fault compensation prediction model is constructed, a stage cost function is fused with trajectory tracking, formation keeping, energy consumption control and obstacle avoidance soft constraint based on a high-order control obstacle function, and terminal cost and a constraint set are added to form finite time domain optimal control; independently solving and optimizing each unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the invention, stable flight, accurate trajectory tracking and safe obstacle avoidance of the formation can be ensured in the environments of actuator thrust loss, external disturbance and obstacles.
claims: Method and apparatus for unmanned aerial vehicle formation fault tolerance distributed nonlinear predictive control method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Automatic extraction method and system for water and soil loss precise treatment pattern spots based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a graph neural network-based automatic extraction method and system for water and soil loss precise treatment pattern spots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source remote sensing data; carrying out superpixel segmentation; constructing a region adjacency graph; coding node features; performing graph neural network reasoning; according to the method, the overall precision of water and soil loss treatment measure classification is improved, particularly, the recognition capability for a small number of categories is improved, the generated pattern spot boundary is smooth, the actual engineering planning requirement is met, the post-processing workload is reduced, end-to-end integration of multi-source heterogeneous data is achieved, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. According to the method, the adaptability of the model to complex terrains and vegetation conditions is enhanced, the method is suitable for realizing intelligent planning and automatic drawing of water and soil conservation measures by using a multi-source remote sensing technology and deep learning, the automation degree is high, the manufacturing period of treatment planning can be greatly shortened, and the precision and the automation level of treatment pattern spot extraction are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for automatic extraction method and system for water and soil loss precise treatment pattern spots based on graph neural network.

title: Power amplifier multi-objective optimization method and system based on hybrid graph neural network and trust domain Bayesian optimization algorithm, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: A power amplifier multi-objective optimization method based on a hybrid graph neural network and a trust domain Bayesian optimization algorithm relates to the technical field of power amplifier circuit optimization, and comprises the following steps: determining design variables in a power amplifier matching network, and taking parameter combinations of the design variables as sampling points, taking the parameter range of the design variable as an exploration area; obtaining a plurality of sampling points in the exploration area, inputting the sampling points into a pre-trained agent model for prediction to obtain a performance index prediction value, and constructing a comprehensive fitness function; the trust domain is updated based on the comprehensive fitness function, new sampling points are searched in the updated trust domain, iteration processing is carried out, and when a preset convergence condition is met, a parameter combination of design variables corresponding to the maximum comprehensive fitness score is output; according to the method, the parameter optimization process needing several hours of manual adjustment and optimization in the traditional power amplifier design is shortened to be within the minute level, and the design optimization efficiency of the power amplifier is greatly improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for power amplifier multi-objective optimization method and system based on hybrid graph neural network and trust domain bayesian optimization algorithm, computer equipment and storage medium.
assignee: HENAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: LDPC decoder based on graph neural network and attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an LDPC decoder based on a graph neural network and an attention mechanism. The LDPC decoder comprises a data receiving module, an updating module, an aggregation module, a data sending module and a layer control module. According to the method, a Tanner graph of an LDPC code is mapped into a graph neural network, an attention mechanism is introduced to adaptively calculate weight coefficients of different code word nodes, and meanwhile, the quantity of model parameters is reduced through parameter sharing and undirected edge attribute unification; in terms of hardware implementation, INT8 fixed-point quantization and DSP packaging technologies are adopted to enable a single DSP to complete two groups of 8-bit multiplication at the same time, and a sparse matrix vector multiplication acceleration unit and a parallel PE array are combined. Compared with the prior art, the LDPC decoding method has the advantages that the signal-to-noise ratio gain of 0.3 dB to 0.4 dB is obtained when the bit error rate is 10 <-4 >, the performance superior to that of 20 times of iteration of a traditional BP algorithm can be achieved only through 5 times of iteration, DSP resource consumption is remarkably reduced, and LDPC decoding with high performance and low time delay is achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for ldpc decoder based on graph neural network and attention mechanism.
assignee: NANJING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Dual robust adaptive graph neural network-based quotation classification method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a citation classification method and system based on a dual robust adaptive graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a clean graph according to a paper and a citation relation thereof, and coding the clean graph into an adjacent matrix; extracting attributes of the papers as features and constructing a node feature matrix; scrambling the adjacent matrix and the node feature matrix to obtain a disturbance graph formed by the scrambled adjacent matrix and the scrambled node feature matrix; inputting the perturbation graph into a dual robust adaptive graph neural network, performing structural learning and topological purification on a scrambled adjacent matrix in the perturbation graph through a structural learning module to obtain an optimized adjacent matrix, and performing layer-by-layer propagation on the optimized adjacent matrix and a scrambled node feature matrix through the graph neural network to obtain a final node feature matrix. And quotation classification of the nodes is realized. The invention aims to improve the effectiveness and robustness under dual-mode disturbance which simultaneously occurs in structure and characteristic disturbance in a quotation classification process based on graph structure data.
claims: Method and apparatus for dual robust adaptive graph neural network-based quotation classification method and system.
assignee: NATIONAL UNIV OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY OF PLA

title: Nickel-based superalloy component reverse design method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a nickel-based superalloy component reverse design method based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data such as alloy components and tensile properties to construct a training set; converting the components into graph structure data taking elements as nodes and fusing global features such as heat treatment and the like; a graph neural network tensile performance prediction model is constructed and trained, and collaborative prediction of the tensile strength and the ductility is achieved; under the constraint of target performance, directionally generating a plurality of groups of candidate alloy components by using a conditional variation automatic encoder; inputting the candidate components into a prediction model to obtain a performance prediction value, and combining thermodynamics calculation to obtain phase content data; and a multi-objective optimization algorithm is adopted to comprehensively screen out the optimal alloy components meeting the requirements. According to the method, the multi-factor coupling effect is effectively considered, the target performance-oriented efficient reverse design is realized, the prediction reliability is remarkably improved, and the experiment trial and error cost is reduced.
claims: Method and apparatus for nickel-based superalloy component reverse design method based on graph neural network.

title: Geometric graph neural network class case recommendation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of data information processing, and particularly provides a geometric graph neural network class case recommendation method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: constructing an original node text data set and an original node type data set; the logic representation comprises a node text list, a node type list, a normalized node original feature matrix, a node quality list and an edge weight matrix; sparse modeling of the legal heterogeneous graph; carrying out gravity-oriented distribution geometric space modeling; constructing a geometric operator to drive forward propagation and feature evolution of the graph neural network to obtain a node geometric feature matrix; and performing similarity matching and class case recommendation to obtain a class case recommendation list. According to the method, by introducing a feature transfer method of geometric space modeling and geometric operator driving graph neural network, the perception ability of a class case recommendation algorithm to a case element association structure can be enhanced, the over-smoothing problem of the graph neural network can be relieved, and the recommendation effect is integrally improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for geometric graph neural network class case recommendation method, system, equipment and medium.

title: Test dependency relationship analysis method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a test dependency relationship analysis method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a test dependency graph, representing test cases as nodes, and representing the dependency relationship between the test cases as directed edges; modeling the test dependency graph by using a graph neural network, and transmitting dependency information between adjacent nodes through a message transmission mechanism to obtain multi-dimensional dependency feature representation of each test case node; calculating the priority of each test case based on the multi-dimensional dependency feature representation; according to the priority and the dependency constraint, generating a sorting and parallelization execution scheme of the test cases by adopting an optimization scheduling algorithm; and executing the test task based on the execution scheme, and dynamically updating the test dependency graph and the graph neural network model according to execution feedback information. According to the method, the test execution time is remarkably shortened, and the test efficiency of a large-scale software system is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for test dependency relationship analysis method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Graph neural network prediction method for light transmittance of organic silicon coating
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of material characterization, and particularly discloses a graph neural network prediction method for the light transmittance of an organosilicon coating, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the feature initialization of atomic nodes and chemical bond edges in a molecular structure according to the type and bond level of organic atoms in the molecular structure data of the organosilicon coating, and obtaining a graph neural network; obtaining a node feature vector and an edge feature vector; constructing a heterograph structure of the organic silicon coating based on the two types of vectors; inputting the heterogeneous graph into a pre-trained graph neural network model, and performing context coding on a target node to obtain an updated feature vector; performing modal decomposition on the updated feature vector according to the node type of the heterogeneous graph to obtain a plurality of types of feature vectors; carrying out multi-source polymerization on the feature vector and a molecular overall feature vector to obtain a full-graph representation vector; and finally, carrying out linear transformation on the whole image representation vector, and outputting a light transmittance prediction value as a final result. According to the method, the prediction accuracy of the light transmittance of the organic silicon coating can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network prediction method for light transmittance of organic silicon coating.
assignee: FUJIAN SANMING RUNXIANG NEW MAT CO LTD

title: Graph neural network multi-group fairness coordination method based on Pareto optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a graph neural network multi-group fairness coordination method based on Pareto optimization. The existing method mostly depends on single agent loss, has insufficient attention on prediction equal indexes, needs to manually set a fixed weight, and is difficult to consider effectiveness and a plurality of fairness targets. The method comprises the following steps: respectively calculating an embedded mean value of two sensitive groups according to a real label, performing singular value decomposition on a difference vector to obtain a low-dimensional sensitive subspace, and deducting a projection component of a node embedded in the subspace; reversely transmitting the debiased signal back to the encoder through the KL divergence between the original embedding and the debiased embedding; further, the prediction distribution is aligned on the positive class sample and the negative class sample by adopting a square 2-Wasserstein distance respectively; and solving a minimum norm solution in each loss gradient convex hull as a combined weight, so that the model adaptively compromises between effectiveness and fairness. According to the method, the difference among three indexes including statistical parity, opportunity equalization and prediction equalization can be remarkably reduced at the same time, and the prediction effectiveness is kept basically unchanged.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network multi-group fairness coordination method based on pareto optimization.

title: Unmanned cross-camera target tracking method and system fused with graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned cross-camera target tracking method and system fused with a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: generating a local track fragment corresponding to each camera according to target observation data, and determining a track quality representation and a view field boundary event of the local track fragment; constructing a dynamic topology transfer relationship between the cameras, and generating candidate cross-camera associated edges; constructing a heterogeneous spatio-temporal trajectory diagram by taking the local trajectory fragments as trajectory nodes and the candidate cross-camera associated edges as diagram edges; inputting the heterogeneous spatio-temporal trajectory graph into an edge enhanced graph neural network, performing iterative feature updating on trajectory nodes and graph edges, and generating identity association confidence of candidate cross-camera association edges; and performing cross-camera connection on the local trajectory fragments based on identity association confidence and trajectory mutual exclusion constraints, and generating a global tracking trajectory of the unmanned vehicle or the target around the unmanned ship. The cross-camera association accuracy can be improved, the identity switching rate can be reduced, and the track continuity can be enhanced.
claims: Method and apparatus for unmanned cross-camera target tracking method and system fused with graph neural network.
assignee: BEIJING VANLINK ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CO LTD

title: Dam slope abnormal deformation self-adaptive identification method based on dynamic graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a dam slope abnormal deformation self-adaptive identification method based on a dynamic graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring deformation monitoring data of a plurality of monitoring points of a dam slope, performing time alignment and preprocessing on multi-source monitoring data, and constructing multi-time step features reflecting deformation evolution features of the monitoring points; modeling the monitoring points into graph nodes, and constructing a monitoring dynamic graph which can be dynamically updated according to the spatial relationship, the geological partition relationship and the deformation correlation among the monitoring points; and performing joint learning on the spatial-temporal characteristics of the monitoring data by using a dynamic graph neural network, constructing a normal deformation characteristic space, calculating the deviation degree of the current monitoring state relative to the normal state, and realizing abnormal deformation discrimination by combining an adaptive abnormal recognition threshold. The method can adapt to the change of a monitoring network structure, improves the continuity and reliability of abnormal deformation recognition, and is suitable for long-term safety monitoring and early warning of a dam slope.
claims: Method and apparatus for dam slope abnormal deformation self-adaptive identification method based on dynamic graph neural network.

title: Cross-domain recommendation method and system based on adversarial learning and graph neural architecture search
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of cross-domain recommendation, and discloses a cross-domain recommendation method and system based on adversarial learning and graph neural architecture search, according to the method, a cross-domain heterogeneous graph is finely constructed, and the interaction information expression ability is improved; designing a cross-domain customized super network, automatically generating an optimal GNN structure for each domain based on graph neural architecture search, and realizing end-to-end non-retraining optimization; in combination with a behavior importance perceptron and adversarial learning, negative migration is relieved from two aspects of instance screening and distribution alignment, and cross-domain recommendation performance is improved while user preference heterogeneity is reserved. Experimental results show that evaluation indexes such as AUC, LogLoss, Recall and RelaImpr of the Amazon data set and the Douban data set are all improved to a certain extent.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-domain recommendation method and system based on adversarial learning and graph neural architecture search.

title: Business process document generation method of big language model based on graph neural network enhancement
abstract: The invention provides a business process document generation method of a big language model based on graph neural network enhancement, and relates to the technical field of enterprise business process management (BPM) and informatization modeling, the business process document generation method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a business process model into a process tree, carrying out serialized representation, and constructing a graph structure network based on serialized text character strings; performing structured representation learning based on the graph neural network to obtain a structured feature embedding matrix; and multi-modal fusion is carried out based on semantic representation of a structured feature embedding matrix and a large language model. Generating a guide text; and based on the fused features and the guide text, adopting a controlled generation strategy and using a large language model to obtain a final business process document. Through fusion of the graph neural network and the large language model, accurate analysis and natural language generation of the business process model are realized, a logic structure is effectively reserved, the accuracy, specialty and readability of a document are improved, and the process management efficiency and the cross-department cooperation effect are remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for business process document generation method of big language model based on graph neural network enhancement.

title: Heterogeneous graph neural network multi-node reasoning method and device and multi-node acceleration system
abstract: The invention provides a semantic parallel heterogeneous graph neural network multi-node reasoning method, which comprises the following steps that: a reasoning layer calculation task of a heterogeneous graph neural network is divided into a plurality of semantic sub-calculation tasks according to a relationship type, each semantic sub-calculation task corresponds to a semantic sub-graph, and each semantic sub-graph is allocated with a unique semantic ID (Identity); mapping each semantic sub-calculation task to a semantic sub-network; independently completing neighbor aggregation calculation of all target vertexes under the distributed semantic sub-graphs by each semantic sub-network, and generating intermediate aggregation vectors of corresponding semantics; the hub node sends the intermediate aggregation vector generated by each semantic subnet to at least one fusion node; and the at least one fusion node receives the intermediate aggregation vectors sent by all the semantic subnets, executes cross-semantic fusion calculation, and generates final output embedding of the reasoning layer. According to the method, the hybrid communication bottleneck in multi-node heterogeneous graph neural network reasoning is solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for heterogeneous graph neural network multi-node reasoning method and device and multi-node acceleration system.
assignee: INST OF COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Power distribution network dynamic region division and distributed optimization method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic region division and distributed optimization method for a power distribution network based on a graph neural network, so as to cope with the challenge of high-permeability distributed energy access. According to the method, firstly, a weighted adjacency matrix and a node feature matrix are constructed based on power distribution network topological parameters and source load prediction data, and a partition scheme considering electrical coupling and power self-balancing is generated by using a partition model based on a graph neural network; secondly, evaluating a candidate partition and a current implementation partition in rolling operation, and dynamically triggering partition updating when the comprehensive income exceeds a preset threshold value; and finally, establishing a multi-region decoupling coordination optimization model, performing consistency coordination on boundary variables by adopting a synchronous alternating direction multiplier method of variable penalty parameters, and outputting a scheduling result. According to the method, the requirements of inter-region coupling and tie line power exchange are effectively reduced, the region supply and demand self-balancing capability and the distributed solution efficiency are improved, and the method has certain engineering use value.
claims: Method and apparatus for power distribution network dynamic region division and distributed optimization method based on graph neural network.

title: Heterogeneous graph neural network-based warehouse-in and warehouse-out combined scheduling method for elevated warehouse
abstract: The invention, which relates to the technical field of intelligent warehousing optimization scheduling, discloses a heterogeneous graph neural network-based warehouse-in and warehouse-out combined scheduling method for an elevated warehouse, and the method is characterized in that a mathematical model for warehouse-in and warehouse-out combined scheduling of the elevated warehouse is established; respectively mapping warehouse-in and warehouse-out tasks, stackers and goods locations in the mathematical model into task nodes, stacker nodes and goods location nodes in the heterogeneous graph; then feature extraction is carried out on the heterogeneous graph through a heterogeneous graph neural network, node-level embedding representations of task nodes, stacking machine nodes and goods location nodes are obtained, then the node-level embedding representations are aggregated, and a graph-level state embedding vector and a state value function used for representing the overall operation state of the elevated warehouse are obtained; and finally, inputting the graph-level state embedded vector and the state value function into a trained Actor-Critic network in a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, and generating a complete warehouse-in and warehouse-out joint scheduling scheme of the high-rack warehouse. The method has the advantages that the scheduling efficiency and the self-adaptive decision-making capability of the elevated warehouse in a complex operation scene can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for heterogeneous graph neural network-based warehouse-in and warehouse-out combined scheduling method for elevated warehouse.

title: Graph neural network differential privacy protection method and system based on community perception singular value disturbance
abstract: The invention provides a graph neural network differential privacy protection method and system based on community perception singular value disturbance, and belongs to the technical field of data privacy protection and machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out community division on original graph structure data, and decomposing a whole graph into a plurality of sub-graphs of which the interiors are tightly connected; singular value decomposition is carried out on the adjacent matrix of each sub-graph, and random noise meeting differential privacy constraint is injected into a singular value space; and finally, using the disturbed singular value to reconstruct a sub-graph adjacency matrix and synthesizing the sub-graph adjacency matrix into a global graph structure for training a graph neural network. According to the method, the privacy noise is transferred from the edge space to the spectral domain, and the local processing of community perception is combined, so that the damage of the noise to the graph structure is effectively reduced while the edge-level differential privacy is met, the calculation efficiency and the expandability are remarkably improved, and the better privacy utility balance is realized; the method is suitable for privacy sensitive scenes such as social networks, financial transactions and medical knowledge maps.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network differential privacy protection method and system based on community perception singular value disturbance.

title: Water supply network node water demand collaborative checking method fusing graph neural network and mechanism model
abstract: The invention discloses a water supply network node water demand collaborative checking method fusing a graph neural network and a mechanism model, and the method can automatically construct node pressure prior information covering a whole network through a water supply network topological structure and multi-working-condition data under the condition of not depending on a large amount of manual research and experience setting. A traditional process of obtaining pressure prior depending on a manual mode is replaced, and the engineering implementation cost is remarkably reduced; meanwhile, the constructed pressure prior information can serve as a constraint condition to be introduced into a node water demand checking process, and stable background constraint is provided for inversion calculation, so that the stability of the checking process is improved, and the reliability of a node water demand estimation result is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for water supply network node water demand collaborative checking method fusing graph neural network and mechanism model.

title: Urban development boundary reconstruction method and system based on Pareto optimization and scale invariant graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an urban development boundary reconstruction method and system based on Pareto optimization and a scale invariant graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of land space planning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source heterogeneous spatio-temporal data of a target area and constructing a directed multi-scale attribute graph; inputting the spatial topology heterogeneity representation into a pre-trained scale invariant graph neural network, and extracting the spatial topology heterogeneity representation with scale invariance; constructing a Markov decision process and a multi-target fitness function based on the representation; constructing a dynamic compliance mask according to preset space geometry and expansion capacity hard constraint; and finally, calling the mask in real time in heuristic search to perform branch pruning by applying a Pareto space-time multi-criterion decision analysis algorithm, and outputting a non-dominated boundary vector scheme of a Pareto first leading edge. According to the method, the interference of a variable surface element problem is eliminated from a mathematical bottom layer, the computing power overhead is remarkably reduced through early pruning, and efficient, automatic and compliant reconstruction of a complex space boundary is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for urban development boundary reconstruction method and system based on pareto optimization and scale invariant graph neural network.
assignee: INST OF GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES AND NATURAL RESOURCES RESEARCH CAS

title: Urban public space multi-modal pedestrian trajectory prediction method and system based on multi-relational graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides an urban public space multi-modal pedestrian trajectory prediction method and system based on a multi-relational graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical trajectory sequence of a target pedestrian in an urban public space, and extracting a relative motion feature code to eliminate dependence on absolute space coordinates; based on the spatial distance and the relative speed, the interaction edges are classified into different relation types, and a multi-relation interaction graph is constructed; carrying out feature aggregation on different types of interaction edges by adopting non-shared weights through a multi-relational graph neural network; generating a multi-modal candidate trajectory by combined decoding in combination with the discrete target anchor point probability and the continuous space offset; physical collision risks are assessed, and asymmetric displacement adjustments are applied to pedestrian trajectories based on dynamic avoidance priorities to eliminate overlap. The method can adapt to urban public space scene characteristics, the cross-scene generalization ability of the model is improved, the trajectory collision rate of a high-density people stream scene is reduced, and the precision, safety and physical rationality of trajectory prediction are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for urban public space multi-modal pedestrian trajectory prediction method and system based on multi-relational graph neural network.

title: Network intrusion detection system and method based on time sequence attention and graph neural network communication metadata fusion
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of network security, and discloses a network intrusion detection system and method based on time sequence attention and graph neural network communication metadata fusion, and the method comprises the steps: extracting a communication event sequence from encrypted network flow data, and dynamically constructing a node structure role; a hidden state is maintained for the nodes, an intensity value is calculated based on a graph attention network, and an attention weight is jointly modulated by a structure role similarity and a time attenuation coefficient; updating a node hiding state through a role gating mechanism, and spreading state change along the edge of the dynamic graph; predicting flow attributes based on the role conditional parameters and calculating prediction errors; and carrying out cross modulation on the intensity log-likelihood and the prediction error to obtain an abnormal score, judging network intrusion and giving an alarm. According to the method, the node structure role is deeply embedded into the whole time sequence attention and state evolution process, so that the collaborative anomaly perception of the graph topology and the behavior time sequence is realized, and the problems of short-time camouflage missing report and role confusion false report in an encrypted traffic scene are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for network intrusion detection system and method based on time sequence attention and graph neural network communication metadata fusion.
assignee: SHANDONG MUQING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: Dangerous electric appliance grading identification and management method, system and device based on bipartite graph neural network and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a dangerous electric appliance classification identification and management method, system and device based on a bipartite graph neural network, and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power utilization safety management, and the method comprises the steps: collecting single-cycle voltage and current data to construct a database; a bipartite graph sample is constructed after preprocessing, time domain sampling point nodes and feature nodes are defined, and association strength is assigned to edges; training a bipartite graph neural network to output a recognition result and confidence; mapping a danger level and generating a management strategy to be issued and executed, thereby realizing accurate identification and hierarchical closed-loop management of dangerous electric appliances; according to the method, the consistency and the stability of dangerous electric appliance identification are improved, unified output of identification results and confidence is realized, danger levels correspond to management strategies one by one, and continuous identification and closed-loop management are ensured.
claims: Method and apparatus for dangerous electric appliance grading identification and management method, system and device based on bipartite graph neural network and storage medium.

title: Topology awareness power system dynamic modeling method, system and device based on physical information graph neural network and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a topology perception power system dynamic modeling method, system and device based on a physical information graph neural network and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power system frequency dynamic characteristic modeling and safety evaluation. Self-adaptively deducing equivalent inertia and damping of the system through the heterogeneous graph neural network; establishing a physical structured ordinary differential equation, and dynamically decomposing the frequency into a swing equation physical component and a characteristic linear modulation residual component; designing a micro-frequency response mechanism containing energy storage charge state hard constraint; and end-to-end training is realized by adopting a multi-stage physical constraint and adjoint sensitivity method. According to the method, the frequency trajectory, the frequency change rate and the energy storage state under different topologies and working conditions can be accurately predicted, and support is provided for frequency safety evaluation of the low-inertia power system.
claims: Method and apparatus for topology awareness power system dynamic modeling method, system and device based on physical information graph neural network and storage medium.

title: EXPLAINABLE GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: An explainable graph neural network is disclosed. A recommendation system generates a recommendation by using a trained heterogenous graph neural network. A recommendation explainer may generate an explanation for the recommendation. To do so, the recommendation explainer may perturb features of a node of a heterogenous interaction graph. Further, the recommendation explainer may perturb a structure of the heterogenous interaction graph.
claims: Method and apparatus for explainable graph neural network.

title: Short video recommendation method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a short video recommendation method based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing multi-source recommendation data of a short video platform; dividing short video interest clusters and determining continuous stimulation intensity of the user to each short video interest cluster; constructing an interest fatigue propagation graph; configuring an edge state parameter for a target image edge in the interest fatigue propagation image and generating image propagation data; inputting the graph propagation data into a two-channel propagation model, and performing graph information aggregation according to different relation types; determining a recommendation net income of each candidate short video in the candidate short video set; and sorting the candidate short video set, generating a short video recommendation list, and pushing the short video recommendation list to a user terminal. According to the method, interest fatigue is described by using the graph neural network and multi-source feedback data, short video dynamic accurate recommendation is realized, and the method has the advantages of high adaptability and less homogeneous pushing.
claims: Method and apparatus for short video recommendation method based on graph neural network.
assignee: XIAMEN SHANGYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: Port berth utilization rate optimization system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a port berth utilization rate optimization system based on a graph neural network. The port berth utilization rate optimization system comprises a data processing module, a graph construction module, a graph modeling module, a scheduling optimization module and a feedback adjustment module. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical berth data, dividing scheduling time periods, constructing a dual-channel graph structure formed by berth nodes and time nodes, calculating load intensity values, inputting the load intensity values as edge weights into an improved R-GCN model, and generating scheduling vectors of berths in the time periods; bottleneck combinations are screened based on the scheduling vectors, peak shifting scheduling is carried out, a three-layer relation graph is constructed, a matching degree value is calculated, and feasible combinations are formed through screening; scheduling feedback information is recorded, a migration negative feedback index is calculated, a scheduling scheme is dynamically adjusted, and finally a parking space utilization rate optimization result is output. The method has the capabilities of dynamically identifying the bottleneck, finely executing scheduling and optimizing closed-loop feedback, and effectively improves the utilization efficiency of port resources.
claims: Method and apparatus for port berth utilization rate optimization system based on graph neural network.
assignee: SHANDONG PORT YANTAI PORT GROUP CO LTD

title: Logic circuit modeling and analysis method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a logic circuit modeling and analysis method based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of electronic design automation, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining logic circuit data, and constructing a corresponding NAND inverse diagram structure; s2, performing logic feature initialization embedding on nodes in the AIG, and mapping different types of nodes to a positive logic semantic space and a negative logic semantic space; s3, constructing a feature learning model based on a heterogeneous graph convolutional neural network, modeling different relation types, and updating node representation; s4, designing a node information aggregation mechanism based on logic gate semantics, and realizing dynamic information propagation and fusion of node features; and S5, inputting the updated node representation into a downstream task model, and outputting a circuit analysis result. According to the method, the expression capability and the analysis precision of logic circuit modeling can be effectively improved, and the combined modeling capability of circuit structure characteristics and logic function characteristics is enhanced.
claims: Method and apparatus for logic circuit modeling and analysis method based on graph neural network.

title: Zero-load transportation flow prediction method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning, in particular to a zero-load transportation flow prediction method based on a graph neural network. Comprising the following steps: acquiring sensing node load data, environment disturbance and carrier constraint, and constructing an initial topological graph; extracting a passing time window factor and outputting a congestion matrix through kernel density estimation; the environment quantity and the congestion matrix are fused into a space-time influence factor, an impedance matrix is generated in combination with the constraint vector, and a road network topological graph is updated; inputting the time window and the topological graph into an evolution model, and outputting a node access probability matrix; and a closed-loop routing sequence is generated according to optimization, and finally a navigation instruction is issued. According to the invention, through the architecture series design of a full link, a complete mathematical mapping channel from macroscopic physical perception, carrier attribute coupling to vehicle end control execution is opened, and a basic decision architecture with highly collaborative multi-source physical state quantity and graph neural network topology operation is formed.
claims: Method and apparatus for zero-load transportation flow prediction method based on graph neural network.
assignee: ZHEJIANG TANGSHI SUPPLY CHAIN MAN CO LTD

title: Polymer characterization method and system based on graph neural network-Transformer
abstract: The invention provides a polymer characterization method and system based on a graph neural network-Transform, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence driven high polymer material informatics. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a polymer repetitive unit structure and constructing a polymer virtual graph comprising atomic nodes, common edges and virtual edges; extracting atoms and fusing edge features to obtain initial molecular features; performing high-dimensional structure simulation by using a space matrix formed by splicing a plurality of two-dimensional rotation matrixes to obtain transformed molecular features; carrying out message passing and neighborhood polymerization based on a graph attention mechanism to obtain polymer molecular characterization; inputting the molecular representation into a Transform decoder to generate an SMILES sequence, a connected matrix and an atomic number sequence; and training the model based on the reconstruction error and performing polymer property prediction. According to the method, the periodic structure and the spatial conformation of the polymer are effectively described, and the property prediction precision and the generalization ability are improved. The technical problems of low polymer property prediction precision and poor generalization performance in the prior art are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for polymer characterization method and system based on graph neural network-transformer.
assignee: UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title: Complex node mode-oriented graph neural network robustness enhancement method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a complex node mode-oriented graph neural network robustness enhancement method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining to-be-classified graph data, inputting the to-be-classified graph data into a graph neural network to obtain a fusion prediction result of each node, the graph neural network is composed of a structure learning module, a hybrid expert model and a gating network, the gating network is used for carrying out sub-graph sampling and local mode construction according to input graph data to obtain local node modes, and carrying out local-global mode coding alignment on all the local node modes to obtain a global node mode; and constructing the weight of each expert model according to the local node mode and the global node mode, fusing the extracted features of each expert model according to the weight, and carrying out classification by using a classifier to obtain a fusion prediction result of each node. The method aims at relieving propagation deviation caused by structure attack, and more stable and refined representation learning is achieved in the environment where a complex node mode and dual-mode disturbance coexist.
claims: Method and apparatus for complex node mode-oriented graph neural network robustness enhancement method and system.
assignee: NATIONAL UNIV OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY OF PLA

title: Insulation aging early warning method based on odor sensing graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electrical equipment state monitoring and fault diagnosis, and discloses an insulation aging early warning method based on a smell sensing graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: comparing a convection dominant index of electrical equipment with a critical threshold value, determining an internal gas transmission mode, and carrying out the early warning of the insulation aging in the thermal convection dominant mode; calculating physical time lag of the characteristic gas transmitted to each node and mapping the physical time lag as an addressing index to extract historical odor concentration data to realize space-time alignment, constructing a directed pneumatic adjacency matrix based on node space relative height, splicing the historical odor data and dynamic temperature rise characteristics, substituting the spliced historical odor data and dynamic temperature rise characteristics into a directed graph convolutional neural network, and outputting a diagnosis result.
