And in a natural diffusion dominant mode, extracting real-time odor concentration data, constructing a static undirected adjacency matrix based on a spatial Euclidean distance, and substituting the static undirected adjacency matrix into the undirected graph convolutional neural network to output a result. According to the method, the problem of data space-time mismatching is effectively solved, the fluid asymmetric migration rule is truly represented, and the accuracy of electrical equipment insulation aging diagnosis is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for insulation aging early warning method based on odor sensing graph neural network.
assignee: XINJIANG MEITE INTELLIGENT SECURITY ENG CO LTD

title: Electrical main wiring diagram complete equipment classification method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides an electrical main wiring diagram complete equipment classification method based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of electrical design drawing identification, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the primitive information and wiring connection relation of the input data of an electrical main wiring diagram; primitive nodes are constructed based on the primitive information, primitive node features are extracted, and the primitive node features comprise equipment category features, geometric features, semantic features and connection features; constructing a wiring connection matrix according to the wiring connection relation; and combining the primitive node features and the wiring connection matrix to form a graph structure, inputting the graph structure into a graph neural network, and training the electrical main wiring diagram complete equipment classification prediction model to obtain a complete equipment prediction result. According to the method, the complete electrical equipment topological relation is established by analyzing the primitive information and the wiring connection relation, and the classification accuracy is improved through graph neural network training.
claims: Method and apparatus for electrical main wiring diagram complete equipment classification method based on graph neural network.
assignee: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Electric power system reactive power optimization method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of circuit devices or systems for power supply or power distribution, in particular to a reactive power optimization method for a power system based on a heterogeneous graph neural network. Comprising the following steps: 1) inputting an adjacent matrix of a power system, reference power of a new energy power station at a to-be-optimized moment and reference power of an electricity load into a trained multi-target reactive power optimization model based on a heterogeneous graph neural network to obtain a reactive power optimization strategy set; the objective function of the multi-objective reactive power optimization model comprises the sum of the minimum active power loss and the minimum voltage deviation of each node of the power system; and 2) setting subjective weight and objective weight of each objective function of the multi-objective reactive power optimization model to obtain comprehensive weight of each objective function, and selecting an optimal reactive power optimization strategy according to the comprehensive weight of each objective function, so that multi-objective reactive power optimization can be performed on the power system from subjective and objective aspects.
claims: Method and apparatus for electric power system reactive power optimization method based on heterogeneous graph neural network.
assignee: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title: Heterogeneous graph neural network-based material mixed variable optimization type selection method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a material mixed variable optimization type selection method and device based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, relates to the technical field of computers, and can realize low-cost and high-reliability entity material selection through mixed optimization and global optimization of discrete type material type selection variables and continuous type matching variables. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring material configuration schemes of an entity and test results of each material configuration scheme in performance indexes, wherein any material configuration scheme comprises an identifier of at least one selected material and ratio data of each selected material; the material configuration scheme and the test result are used for training a material scheme performance evaluation model, the material scheme performance evaluation model comprises a graph neural network and a performance prediction model, and the graph neural network comprises a plurality of heterogeneous graph models; and taking the trained material scheme performance evaluation model as a fitness function of the genetic algorithm model, and determining a target material configuration scheme based on the performance indexes according to the genetic algorithm model.
claims: Method and apparatus for heterogeneous graph neural network-based material mixed variable optimization type selection method and device.

title: Intelligent calculation cluster traffic engineering scheduling method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent calculation cluster traffic engineering scheduling method and system based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: dynamically extracting and constructing a sparse calculation sub-graph only containing candidate paths of active flows and passing links of the candidate paths according to an instantaneous network flow request matrix so as to decouple the calculation complexity of a graph neural network from being related to a physical topology scale to being only related to an actual data transmission task scale; a self-supervised physical driving training system is adopted, and self-supervised loss is determined according to microphysical evaluation indexes so as to train the graph neural network, so that the strong dependence limitation of a reinforcement learning or deep learning technology on a static theoretical label can be avoided; and a physical perception message passing mechanism and an attention-based intra-flow strategy interaction mechanism are introduced for the graph neural network to fully consider the underlying physical logic of the network topology, so that the traffic engineering scheduling can keep higher stability and error-tolerant rate in a complex production environment.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent calculation cluster traffic engineering scheduling method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: BEIJING UNIV OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Robot vision occlusion target continuous identification method and system based on dynamic graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a robot vision occlusion target continuous identification method and system based on a dynamic graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining continuous video frames, constructing a target relation graph of each frame, and arranging the continuous multiple frames of target relation graphs according to a time sequence to form a dynamic graph sequence; calculating attention weights of neighbor nodes of each target node in each frame of target relation graph, performing weighted aggregation on features of each neighbor node, and generating aggregation feature representation of each target node; generating a prediction feature of each target node in the current frame based on the aggregation feature representation of each target node in the preorder frame, taking the aggregation feature representation generated by the current frame as an observation feature, correcting the prediction feature by using the observation feature, and generating a fusion feature representation of each target node; and inputting the fusion feature representation of each target node into a classifier to obtain an image recognition result of each target in the current frame. According to the invention, continuous, stable and accurate output of target image recognition in a shielding scene is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for robot vision occlusion target continuous identification method and system based on dynamic graph neural network.

title: Airport group cooperative operation quality evaluation method based on graph neural network and meta learning
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an airport group cooperative operation quality evaluation method based on a graph neural network and meta learning. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a knowledge graph of airport group collaborative operation; generating a dynamic heterogeneous graph and real-time graph snapshot data thereof; carrying out representation learning by adopting a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network to obtain a graph embedding vector, and inputting the graph embedding vector into a meta-learning framework to realize adaptive evaluation of the operation quality of the airport group; and constructing an interpretable reasoning framework, and analyzing an evaluation result in combination with a knowledge graph. The method has the advantages that the meta-learning framework is introduced, so that the generalization ability of the evaluation model under the condition of scarcity of annotation data is improved; nodes and calculation relations are newly added, a dynamic heterogeneous graph is generated, and multi-body and multi-level complex association structured modeling is achieved; and an interpretable reasoning framework is constructed, so that the understandability and traceability of the evaluation result are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for airport group cooperative operation quality evaluation method based on graph neural network and meta learning.
assignee: CHENGDU CIVIL AVIATION AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title: Local power grid low-frequency load shedding intelligent optimization method based on reinforcement learning and graph neural network
abstract: A local power grid low-frequency load shedding intelligent optimization method based on reinforcement learning and a graph neural network belongs to the technical field of power system frequency control and intelligent load shedding, and comprises the steps of evaluation index definition, index weight determination through an entropy weight method, low-frequency load shedding round optimization target and low-frequency load shedding operation constraint conditions. The invention discloses a local power grid low-frequency load shedding modeling method, which is a local power grid low-frequency load shedding modeling method integrating feeder net load, load importance, distributed power supply output and network topology characteristics at the same time, based on a low-frequency load shedding decision-making method of a graph neural network and multi-agent reinforcement learning, generating an initial feeder combination meeting load shedding constraint, and executing partition load shedding balance optimization. For a low-frequency disturbance scene, the optimization method can intelligently generate a load shedding round scheme under the condition of meeting frequency and voltage safety constraint conditions. And important load protection, whole-network load cutting total quantity matching and partition load cutting balance are considered in the local power grid low-frequency load shedding intelligent optimization method.
claims: Method and apparatus for local power grid low-frequency load shedding intelligent optimization method based on reinforcement learning and graph neural network.
assignee: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title: Cross-domain power electronic converter open-circuit fault diagnosis method based on dynamic graph neural network margin self-tuning
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-domain power electronic converter open-circuit fault diagnosis method based on dynamic graph neural network margin self-tuning, and relates to the technical field of industrial equipment intelligent operation and maintenance and fault diagnosis, in particular to a cross-domain power electronic converter open-circuit fault diagnosis method. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting three-phase current signals of the power electronic converter under different fault types; preprocessing a three-phase current signal of the power electronic converter to obtain a node characteristic matrix; s2, constructing a fault diagnosis model; the model sequentially comprises a multi-layer dynamic graph convolutional network, a global average pooling layer and a multi-layer perceptron; s3, training the fault diagnosis model based on the source domain data until the total loss function converges, and obtaining a trained fault diagnosis model; and S4, inputting a three-phase current signal of the power electronic converter in the target domain data into the trained fault diagnosis model, outputting a feature vector by a multi-layer perceptron in the trained fault diagnosis model, and obtaining a fault type based on the feature vector.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-domain power electronic converter open-circuit fault diagnosis method based on dynamic graph neural network margin self-tuning.
assignee: UNIV OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title: Private data abnormal access behavior detection method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electric digital data processing, in particular to a private data abnormal access behavior detection method based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: a dynamic access graph construction module pre-processes a multi-source system log, generates static sub-graphs based on a time window, and connects the static sub-graphs in series to form a heterogeneous multi-relation dynamic access graph; the time sequence feature decoupling module is used for splitting time-varying access features and time-invariant identity features by adopting a time sequence decoupling network, and optimizing feature expression by matching with orthogonal constraint and a gating mechanism; and the graph feature aggregation and detection module is used for completing topological feature extraction through feature alignment and relation perception aggregation, outputting an anomaly detection result after fusing features, improving model performance by combining topological prediction and multi-loss joint optimization, and generating a dynamic access control strategy according to an anomaly path. According to the method, the problems of semantic information loss, feature mutual interference and difficulty in hidden anomaly recognition of an existing scheme are solved, and the accuracy and the real-time performance of privacy data anomaly access detection are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for private data abnormal access behavior detection method based on graph neural network.
assignee: BEIJING KAIPUDUN MEDICAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title: Text logic anomaly detection method based on Bert and graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a Bert and graph neural network-based text logic anomaly detection method, which comprises the following steps of: performing word segmentation on an input text, finishing basic semantic coding in combination with a BERT model, constructing a text semantic graph through a graph convolutional network, and converting the input text into a graph structure with dominant semantic association; accurately extracting high-frequency features in the text semantic graph through a high-pass filter, completely capturing low-frequency features in the text semantic graph through a low-pass filter, fusing the high-frequency features and the low-frequency features, and superposing a node-level attention mechanism focusing key node to obtain an abnormal boundary probability matrix; and finally, inputting a text according to the abnormal boundary probability matrix to carry out anomaly positioning, and finding out a position with semantic anomaly.
claims: Method and apparatus for text logic anomaly detection method based on bert and graph neural network.

title: Carbon emission tracking method and system of Internet of Things and graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, discloses a carbon emission tracking method and system based on the Internet of Things and a graph neural network, and aims to solve the problem that an existing carbon emission monitoring method depends on static accounting and lacks a multi-modal data fusion framework. The method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multi-modal data in real time through the Internet of Things; constructing and updating a carbon emission correlation map; utilizing a multi-head attention mechanism to align and fuse features to generate node embedding; carbon flow is dynamically modeled through a time decay map attention network, and future emission is predicted; the incremental learning adapts to atlas change; and carbon flow traceability and responsibility attribution are realized. The system comprises corresponding modules: a data aggregation module, a graph construction module, a feature fusion module, a network prediction module, an incremental learning module and a traceability attribution module. According to the invention, high-precision, real-time and traceable carbon emission dynamic tracking can be realized, and a transparent responsibility attribution mechanism is provided.
claims: Method and apparatus for carbon emission tracking method and system of internet of things and graph neural network.

title: In-station passenger flow situation identification method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an in-station passenger flow situation identification method and system based on a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of neural networks. The in-station passenger flow situation identification method and system based on the graph neural network comprises the steps that S1, in-station dynamic operation data and in-station static space data are collected and processed in a unified mode; s2, constructing an in-station region node set, a basic adjacency matrix and an in-station source point fidelity dynamic graph; s3, constructing a source point fidelity graph neural network model, and carrying out source point peak residual holding and passenger flow propagation time sequence chain extraction; and S4, determining the type of a source point, and outputting a shunting linkage output instruction. The method solves the problem that the recognition of a congestion source point, a risk propagation path and a diversion control basis is not accurate due to the fact that the sudden passenger flow peak values of boundary source points such as a vehicle door area, a vehicle arrival entrance, a gate area and an entrance and exit are easily and smoothly weakened in the neighborhood feature aggregation process in an existing recognition method.
claims: Method and apparatus for in-station passenger flow situation identification method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Abnormal behavior real-time identification method based on data fusion and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an abnormal behavior real-time identification method based on data fusion and a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent fault diagnosis. Acquiring real-time operation data of each elevator, and screening out answering but uncompleted call events from the real-time operation data; constructing a graph structure with elevator nodes and call event nodes as vertexes and response relations as edges, directly inputting node attributes into a graph neural network, and updating representation of each node through a message passing mechanism; and on the basis of the updated node characterization, comparing the expected arrival order and the actual arrival order of each call event pair by pair, identifying an order reversal abnormity, a path bypassing abnormity and a repeated response abnormity, and outputting an abnormity type and a corresponding elevator identifier and a call identifier. According to the method, the modeling capability of the graph neural network on the structured incidence relation can be fully utilized, the abnormal operation caused by sequence deviation after the multiple elevators respond to the call is detected in real time, and the accuracy of abnormal recognition and the response timeliness are effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for abnormal behavior real-time identification method based on data fusion and graph neural network.
assignee: JINAN SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION INST JINAN ELEVATOR SAFETY OPERATION MONITORING CENTER

title: ODN topology restoration method and system based on feature classification and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an ODN topology restoration method and system based on feature classification and a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of optical communication networks, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, collecting first-stage features and second-stage features of an ONU, the first-stage features being obvious features capable of directly reflecting a network abnormal event, and the second-stage features being non-obvious features capable of reflecting a long-term change rule of an optical signal; performing preliminary classification on the ONU based on the first-level features, and determining preliminary optical splitter affiliation of the ONU; and processing the characteristic data of the ONU based on a graph neural network, forming genealogy characteristics reflecting ONU group characteristics by aggregating neighbor node information, and carrying out optimization determination on the optical splitter attribution of the ONU. According to the method, the accuracy is improved through two-stage classification and genealogy features, automatic topology restoration can be helped to be achieved, and favorable conditions are provided for fault recognition and delimitation.
claims: Method and apparatus for odn topology restoration method and system based on feature classification and graph neural network.

title: Drainage pipeline fault detection method and system based on parallel dynamic graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a drainage pipeline fault detection method and system based on a parallel dynamic graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of water pipeline fault detection. Firstly, TCN is used for extracting time sequence characteristics of pressure, flow and the like on sensor nodes; then, mapping the features to a graph space, and respectively capturing a global adjacency relation and a dynamic attention relation through parallel GCN and GAT; and finally, further integrating the time sequence information of the fused graph features through the TCN of the other layer, and obtaining the state information of the current drainage pipe network through node-level and global fault detection. According to the method, high-precision and high-robustness fault quantitative analysis is realized by fusing the composite model of the time sequence convolutional network and the graph neural network.
claims: Method and apparatus for drainage pipeline fault detection method and system based on parallel dynamic graph neural network.
assignee: SHANDONG FENCER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: General atomic potential molecular dynamics reasoning method and system based on transferable graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a general atomic potential molecular dynamics reasoning method and system based on a transferable graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: pre-training: constructing a general graph neural network atomic potential model through pre-training, and mastering the basic representation of the degree of freedom of atoms and electrons through the learning of information such as energy, force, stress and magnetic moment; distillation fine adjustment: knowledge of the pre-training model is transferred to a small model by utilizing knowledge distillation, and a special model is formed; reasoning: outputting the energy, the atomic force and the confidence coefficient of the system by using the small model; uncertainty processing: when the confidence coefficient is lower than a preset threshold value, triggering online quantum mechanics calculation to obtain new data, and updating the model weight online; hardware optimization: applying structured pruning and vectorization kernel in the reasoning process to improve the parallel efficiency; and near memory processing: mapping the graph neural network aggregation operation to a near memory processing system to realize processor-memory collaborative acceleration.
claims: Method and apparatus for general atomic potential molecular dynamics reasoning method and system based on transferable graph neural network.
assignee: XINWEI BITE NANO TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title: Silicon nitride ceramic strength prediction and failure positioning method based on twin graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a silicon nitride ceramic strength prediction and failure positioning method based on a twin map neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional data of internal holes of silicon nitride ceramic; processing the data to obtain node features and global features, constructing a normalized partially reconnected KNN graph structure and a twin graph neural network model, inputting to-be-detected ceramic into the trained twin graph neural network model to predict the strength, and meanwhile, realizing failure positioning of a key fractured hole through interpretability analysis; according to the method, the problem of small sample overfitting is solved through the constructed twin graph neural network architecture in combination with a sample pair amplification strategy and a multi-dimensional feature space, and an intelligent model with high precision, excellent generalization ability and physical interpretability is constructed, so that the reliability design and quality control of the silicon nitride ceramic material are guided.
claims: Method and apparatus for silicon nitride ceramic strength prediction and failure positioning method based on twin graph neural network.

title: Rotary machinery fault diagnosis method and system based on graph neural network, and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a rotating machine fault diagnosis method and system based on a graph neural network, and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a vibration signal and generating a standardized image sample set; extracting deep features of the image samples to construct image structure data; a fault diagnosis model is constructed, the model propagates features through a multi-modal representation graph convolutional network, a binding gain pooling layer is utilized to fuse mean value and maximum value pooling in a weighted mode, a gradient correction term is introduced, and a mixed space calculation layer is utilized to mine feature association in multiple spaces with different curvatures; and carrying out semi-supervised training on the model and carrying out fault diagnosis by utilizing the trained model. According to the method, the problems of feature loss and Euclidean space limitation are effectively solved, and the diagnosis precision and robustness of multiple types of faults are remarkably improved under the non-stationary working condition.
claims: Method and apparatus for rotary machinery fault diagnosis method and system based on graph neural network, and storage medium.

title: Function level vulnerability detection method based on graph neural network and multi-feature joint training
abstract: The invention discloses a function level vulnerability detection method based on a graph neural network and multi-feature joint training, which relates to the technical field of network security, and comprises the following steps: constructing a code attribute graph by taking a function as a basic analysis unit, obtaining program structure information representation, and combining extracted function level context semantic features to obtain a function level vulnerability detection result; multi-view representation of source code structure information and semantic information is realized; obtaining a program dependency relationship and global node interaction information by using a graph neural network; a gating fusion mechanism is introduced to carry out adaptive weighted integration on the structural features and the context features, a joint training framework is constructed, and collaborative optimization and semantic alignment of multi-source features are realized; and performing vulnerability discrimination on the function-level source code by using the trained vulnerability detection model. According to the method, the expression ability and the detection performance of the model for a complex vulnerability mode are improved, the overall detection accuracy and the model generalization ability are improved, and the actual requirements of modern software security analysis for a high-precision and automatic vulnerability detection technology are met.
claims: Method and apparatus for function level vulnerability detection method based on graph neural network and multi-feature joint training.
assignee: SOUTHWEST UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Mountain low-altitude wind field reconstruction system based on sparse observation data and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a mountain low-altitude wind field reconstruction system based on sparse observation data and a graph neural network, and relates to the cross technical field of meteorological prediction, artificial intelligence and low-altitude economic guarantee. Comprising a data preprocessing module, a multi-scale graph neural modeling module, a physical constraint generation and reconstruction module, a terrain adaptive migration module and a closed-loop cooperative scheduling module which work cooperatively in sequence. The data preprocessing module is used for carrying out sampling enhancement and feature fusion on sparse observation data and topographic data. According to the mountain low-altitude wind field reconstruction system based on the sparse observation data and the graph neural network, the problem of insufficient feature extraction of the sparse observation data is solved, accurate deduction from discrete observation points to a continuous three-dimensional wind field is realized, prediction errors of wind speed, wind direction and turbulence intensity are reduced, and the reconstruction efficiency is improved. And the capability of capturing local wind field characteristics such as a canyon narrow tube effect and mountain vortex is obviously enhanced.
claims: Method and apparatus for mountain low-altitude wind field reconstruction system based on sparse observation data and graph neural network.
assignee: HUAZHONG UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Commodity recommendation method, system and device based on multi-behavior graph neural network and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a commodity recommendation method, system and device based on a multi-behavior graph neural network and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: initializing a first basic embedding of each user in a user set and a second basic embedding of each article in an article set, and respectively projecting the first basic embedding and the second basic embedding to behavior specific semantic subspaces corresponding to different behavior types; independently executing neighbor propagation by taking the initial behavior specific representation as a starting point, and aggregating the representation after propagation of each layer to obtain a behavior channel representation of each user and a behavior channel representation of each article under each behavior type; generating behavior preference weight distribution of each user through a multi-layer perceptron network to obtain a unified representation vector of the corresponding user; calculating to obtain a unified representation vector of the corresponding article; and calculating an inner product of the unified representation vector of the user and the unified representation vector of the article to obtain a matching score, and determining a recommendation result according to the matching score. And meanwhile, the problems of behavior semantic heterogeneity and user behavior preference heterogeneity are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for commodity recommendation method, system and device based on multi-behavior graph neural network and storage medium.

title: Compressor stall time-space intelligent early warning method and system based on graph deviation neural network
abstract: The invention provides a gas compressor stall time-space intelligent early warning method and system based on a graph deviation neural network, and the method comprises the steps: arranging a plurality of circumferential pressure sensor arrays on a gas compressor, collecting pressure sensor data gradually transited from a stable working condition to a stall working condition, and obtaining a multivariate time series data set; constructing a gas compressor multi-sensor graph structure based on the stable working condition data, and training a graph deviation neural network by using the multivariate time sequence data set under the stable working condition of the gas compressor; performing on-line monitoring, inputting real-time sensor data into the trained graph deviation neural network to obtain a predicted value and/or a reconstructed value of each sensor, and performing stall pre-warning on-line detection and early warning triggering; and when early warning is triggered, determining an index of a stall origin sensor from the circumferential sensors, mapping the index to a circumferential physical mounting angle of the gas compressor, and outputting the index as a stall origin angular position. According to the scheme, the accuracy and timeliness of compressor stall early warning are improved, and the weak pre-warning signal before stall is effectively captured.
claims: Method and apparatus for compressor stall time-space intelligent early warning method and system based on graph deviation neural network.
assignee: INST OF ENGINEERING THERMOPHYSICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Multi-camera eye movement self-calibration fusion method based on ensemble learning and graph neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision and eye movement tracking, relates to a multi-camera eye movement self-calibration fusion method based on ensemble learning and a graph neural network, and solves the problems that multiple cameras depend on manual calibration, the head movement is large, external reference correction is difficult under low illumination, and fusion is unstable. According to the method, multi-camera images and timestamps are synchronously collected, and the sight line direction, the eye three-dimensional position and observation quality parameters are obtained through preprocessing and eye movement estimation; calculating candidate external parameter increments and credibility through the two sub-models, constructing an initial graph which takes a camera as a node and takes a relative pose and a time alignment parameter as edges, and obtaining a node fusion weight and a global consistent external parameter increment through graph neural network information transmission and node updating; and constructing an objective function in differential beam adjustment for iteration to obtain self-calibration camera external parameters, converting the sight line direction and the eye three-dimensional position to a reference coordinate system based on the self-calibration camera external parameters, and performing intersection to obtain a fusion fixation result. According to the invention, rapid self-calibration and cross-camera consistent external parameter estimation and fusion are realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-camera eye movement self-calibration fusion method based on ensemble learning and graph neural network.
assignee: NANHANG TECH GUANGDONG HENGQIN CO LTD

title: Low-viscosity insulating oil molecule design method based on graph neural network and multi-objective evolutionary algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a low-viscosity insulating oil molecule design method based on a graph neural network and a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm, and relates to the technical field of high voltage and insulation, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting structural data and viscosity, electrical insulation performance, thermal stability and synthetic accessibility data of natural ester and related ester molecules; converting the molecules into a graph structure and extracting atomic features, bond features and molecular structure features; constructing a graph neural network model with multiple output ends, and respectively predicting viscosity, dielectric properties and thermal stability indexes of candidate molecules; constructing a multi-target fitness function based on each prediction result, the synthesis accessibility score and the structural constraint, and searching candidate molecules with low viscosity and comprehensive performance meeting requirements in a natural ester molecule space by adopting an evolutionary algorithm; and performing quantum chemical calculation and molecular dynamics simulation on the candidate molecules to verify the structural stability and target performance of the candidate molecules. According to the method, low viscosity, insulating property, stability and synthesizability can be synchronously considered in the molecular design stage, the engineering applicability of candidate insulating oil molecules is improved, and the molecular screening period is shortened.
claims: Method and apparatus for low-viscosity insulating oil molecule design method based on graph neural network and multi-objective evolutionary algorithm.
assignee: NAT ENERGY NANNING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title: Neural severe AI auxiliary decision-making system based on knowledge graph and multi-modal time sequence inference
abstract: The invention discloses a neural severe AI auxiliary decision-making system based on a knowledge graph and multi-modal time sequence inference. The following processes are realized through each functional unit: constructing a neural severe dynamic knowledge graph capable of adaptively adjusting weight; collecting and processing multi-modal time series data and generating a feature matrix; identifying a diagnosis and treatment stage through dual-mode reasoning, and matching a knowledge graph to lock a standard path and a taboo rule; a graph neural network is adopted to fuse an attention mechanism, and a whole disease course diagnosis and treatment recommendation path is generated; carrying out medical advice comparison, taboo early warning and omission prompt; evaluating prognosis based on a time sequence trend and performing layered intervention; diagnosis and treatment difference grading, quantitative scoring and traceability are completed according to clinical gold standards; a full-closed-loop framework is established, and iterative optimization of the model and the knowledge graph is realized based on man-machine feedback. According to the method, individualized adaptation of medical knowledge is achieved, diagnosis and treatment time sequence and systematicness are improved, and the method has prospective prevention and control, compliance quality control and iterative optimization capabilities and is suitable for intelligent auxiliary decision making of the whole course of neurological severe illness.
claims: Method and apparatus for neural severe ai auxiliary decision-making system based on knowledge graph and multi-modal time sequence inference.
assignee: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL TO NANCHANG UNIV

title: NEURAL GRAPH WITH MACHINE LEARNING TRAINED MODEL FOR CIRCUIT MANUFACTURING
abstract: Graph-based mechanisms to model and control the synthesis of circuits on a layer basis, including a deep learning model trained on light-weight graph structures rather than complex circuit designs encoded in collateral files generated by EDA systems, and utilizing graph-based algorithms one the graph structure to determine candidate circuit structures and synthesis processes.
claims: Method and apparatus for neural graph with machine learning trained model for circuit manufacturing.

title: Recommendation method based on trusted graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of convolutional neural networks, and discloses a credible graph neural network-based recommendation method, which comprises the following steps of: converting a target node interaction relationship into topological mapping and constructing a local convolutional tensor; calculating a characteristic difference vector modulus length of a neighborhood relative to the central node and determining a structural coherence parameter; determining a relationship between the structural coherence parameter and a preset steady-state threshold through a bit mask gating unit, and determining an activation state of a convolution kernel channel; zero clearing is carried out on the channel weight which is judged to be the structural noise; according to the method, in-situ modulation is carried out on the weight of the convolution kernel to realize feature isolation, a feature over-smoothing phenomenon caused by a noise component in network interlayer transmission is eliminated, and the fidelity and traceability of feature extraction logic are ensured.
claims: Method and apparatus for recommendation method based on trusted graph neural network.

title: Self-adaptive gated graph neural network method and system for different illustration graph learning
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive gated graph neural network method and system for different illustration graph learning, and belongs to the technical field of graph machine learning and graph data mining. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, respectively constructing a node self-feature encoder and a neighborhood information encoder, and independently extracting node self-information and neighborhood information; then mapping the two types of representations to a unified feature space, and carrying out dimensionally adaptive fusion on the two types of information based on a learnable gating vector; further, classification constraints are applied to node self representation, neighborhood representation and fusion representation at the same time, a mixed loss function is constructed, and the problem of false convergence caused by inconsistent convergence speeds of different coding branches is solved. According to the method, the retention ratio of the node characteristics to the neighborhood information can be adaptively adjusted according to the synonym or disparagraph of the graph data, and the method has good robustness, interpretability and generalization ability under the scene of the disparagraph graph and the scene of the synonym graph.
claims: Method and apparatus for self-adaptive gated graph neural network method and system for different illustration graph learning.

title: CDN access acceleration method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a CDN (Content Delivery Network) access acceleration method based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting node state data and link state data of a CDN and constructing a dynamic attribute graph; 2, responding to the access request, extracting a user area identifier and a target content identifier, and generating a content instance virtual node; 3, screening candidate edge nodes and constructing a candidate insertion graph; 4, executing random walk based on a link state, a node state and a path accumulation state to generate a path sequence; 5, inputting the path features into an improved RWNN model, and executing differential path coding to generate a path representation result; step 6, calculating access delay based on a path representation result and determining a target deployment node; and step 7, executing content writing and request redirection, and recording access data. According to the invention, the CDN access time delay is effectively reduced.
claims: Method and apparatus for cdn access acceleration method based on graph neural network.
assignee: NINGDE MINAN SECURITY AND PROT CO LTD

title: Text backdoor data purification method and system based on dependency graph and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a text backdoor data purification method and system based on a dependency graph and a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target data set, and analyzing a text sample in the target data set into a directed dependency graph; extracting node local features and global topological structure features in a directed dependency graph of the target data set by adopting a pre-trained graph neural network encoder to obtain a graph-level embedded vector; inputting the graph-level embedding vector into a first classifier to obtain a poisoning probability score corresponding to the graph-level embedding vector; and filtering back door samples in the target data set according to the poisoning probability to obtain a purified target data set. According to the method, the text samples in the target training set are analyzed into the directed dependency graph, the graph structure features are extracted through the graph neural network encoder, and the poisoning probability score is obtained through the first classifier to complete filtration and purification. According to the method, detection can be performed in the graph structure space, unified coverage of various trigger types is realized, and effective purification of text backdoor data is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for text backdoor data purification method and system based on dependency graph and graph neural network.
assignee: HUAXIN WANGAN ZHENGZHOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: Intelligent data storage and analysis method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent data storage and analysis method based on a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of data storage, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining entity data and an association relationship to construct a heterogeneous graph topological structure; s2, by improving a GATNE model, generating a multi-dimensional attention weight based on edge type mapping and in-and-out degree direction features, restoring a weighted edge feature matrix by using an eccentric distance, and finally aggregating and outputting weighted graph data; s3, outputting an edge state bitmap; s4, generating a hot edge write-in instruction and a cold edge write-in instruction; s5, returning the physical storage address mapping table; s6, reading data from the corresponding storage medium and returning a query result; s7, outputting an elimination candidate set; and S8, erasing the physical sector occupied by the elimination candidate set. According to the method, the limitations of single popularity judgment, neglect of topological constraints and elimination of mistaken killing of high-frequency long tail edges of a traditional method are overcome, and an efficient solution is provided for intelligent storage of heterogeneous graph data.
claims: Method and apparatus for intelligent data storage and analysis method based on graph neural network.
assignee: CHENGDU LIANGZI GONGFANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title: Epilepsy electroencephalogram signal detection method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of electroencephalogram signal analysis, and provides an epilepsy electroencephalogram signal detection method and system based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining and preprocessing a multi-channel EEG signal, and converting the multi-channel EEG signal into an initial adjacent matrix; processing the initial graph structure based on a multi-level graph connection generator HGG, performing spatial coarsening, and generating a multi-scale adjacent matrix; introducing time dynamics based on a space-time attenuation generator STDGG, constructing a time-varying brain network diagram, and generating a time-varying adjacency matrix sequence; the connection weight is optimized based on a dynamic connection weighting module DCW, and self-adaptive weighted fusion is achieved; and outputting the attack type probability distribution. The invention provides a novel graph neural network framework which is used for automatic epileptic seizure detection based on multi-channel EEG data and solves the limitation of an existing method in processing space-time variability.
claims: Method and apparatus for epilepsy electroencephalogram signal detection method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Three-dimensional boxing method based on graph neural network, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional encasement, in particular to a three-dimensional encasement method based on a graph neural network, a medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a heterogeneous relation graph containing multi-dimensional complex constraints such as mutual exclusion, pressure bearing and temperature control, and generating a relation sensing embedding vector and a global graph embedding vector through the coding of the graph neural network; the defect of constraint perception which only depends on a space geometric state is overcome; container space occupation, global constraint general situation and cargo personalized constraint features are fused at the same time through decision state representation, and deep fusion of space and constraint information is achieved. By cyclically executing the boxing action and dynamically updating the state, it is ensured that each step of boxing action is based on the latest constraint topology and space condition decision, a complete boxing scheme meeting multiple constraints is finally output, and the compliance and the space utilization rate of the boxing scheme are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for three-dimensional boxing method based on graph neural network, medium and equipment.
assignee: TIANJIN ANXIN SHUKE TECH CO LTD

title: Flight delay prediction model training and prediction method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of graph neural networks and space-time prediction, in particular to a training and prediction method of a flight delay prediction model based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring training samples including a historical delay sequence, a real-time meteorological covariable and a future delay supervision signal; constructing an environment perception element graph learning device, and mapping meteorological covariables into a dynamic space transfer matrix by adopting a super network so as to represent meteorological-driven space topology changes; a physical constraint time attention module is constructed, a physical causal mask is generated based on the inter-airport flight time, and attention is forced to only pay attention to historical time steps conforming to the propagation rule; and jointly inputting the matrix and historical data into a graph neural network for spatio-temporal characteristic propagation, calculating the difference between prediction and supervision signals, and updating parameters. According to the method, the graph neural network has environment adaptive capability and physical causal constraints, and the precision and robustness of flight delay prediction are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for flight delay prediction model training and prediction method based on graph neural network.

title: Marketing link short board positioning method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a marketing link short plate positioning method and system based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a marketing link heterogeneous graph; extracting a behavior sequence matrix of each marketing node according to the marketing link heterogeneous graph; obtaining a pseudo-active factor of the user according to the interaction track matrix and the time interval matrix, obtaining a pendulum decision factor according to the pendulum state transition matrix, and obtaining a semantic mirror image factor according to the semantic pair; and constructing a short plate propagation equation of each marketing node according to the pseudo-active factor, the pendulum decision factor and the semantic mirror factor, solving the short plate propagation equation according to the marketing link heterogeneous graph to obtain a short plate value of each marketing node, and determining a short plate node according to the short plate value. According to the invention, accurate positioning of the marketing nodes with real short boards can be realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for marketing link short board positioning method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: UNICOM JIANGXI IND INTERNET CO LTD

title: Milling chatter monitoring method based on manifold learning and dynamic graph neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of online monitoring in the machining process, and provides a milling chatter monitoring method based on manifold learning and a dynamic graph neural network. Collecting a cutting force signal and an acoustic emission signal in a milling process, performing synchronous and sliding window segmentation, and constructing a windowed multi-source signal sample; manifold learning is utilized to obtain a manifold geometric target representing milling state evolution, and flutter sensitive key features are screened by taking the manifold geometric target as a constraint in combination with mutual information and a minimum redundancy maximum correlation criterion; further mapping the flutter sensitive key features into graph nodes, and constructing a milling flutter dynamic graph; a milling chatter monitoring model comprising a graph attention coding module, a graph level reading module, a time sequence enhancement module and a classification module is established, cross-window chatter evolution enhancement features are extracted, and real-time monitoring of milling chatter is achieved. According to the method, the early-stage weak flutter feature recognition capability, the monitoring accuracy and the robustness can be improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for milling chatter monitoring method based on manifold learning and dynamic graph neural network.

title: Differential privacy graph neural network training method fusing jump knowledge and adaptive optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a differential privacy graph neural network training method fusing jump knowledge and adaptive optimization, and relates to the technical field of graph neural network privacy protection, in particular to a differential privacy graph neural network training method fusing jump knowledge and adaptive optimization. According to the method, a jump knowledge mechanism is introduced in a feature extraction stage, and intermediate representation of each layer of a multi-layer perceptron encoder is aggregated by establishing a cross-layer information bypass, so that a deep network retains local discrimination features of a shallow layer while capturing high-order graph structure information, and damage of over-smoothing and noise accumulation to deep features is effectively resisted; in a model training stage, a self-adaptive cutting mechanism based on a historical gradient norm quantile and a self-adaptive learning rate adjusting mechanism based on first-order moment and second-order moment estimation are combined, so that a parameter updating step length can be dynamically adjusted according to statistical characteristics of a noise gradient. Experimental results show that under the condition of low to medium privacy budget, compared with a baseline scheme, the method reduces the number of training rounds required for achieving the target accuracy and suppresses the success rate of member reasoning attack to be close to the random guess level at the same time.
claims: Method and apparatus for differential privacy graph neural network training method fusing jump knowledge and adaptive optimization.

title: Metallurgical furnace kiln condition identification method based on streaming multi-mode graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a metallurgical furnace kiln condition identification method based on a streaming multi-modal graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: extracting visible light image features of a furnace material surface through employing a convolutional neural network, and extracting time series data features through employing a multi-layer Transform encoder; performing deep fusion on the bimodal features through a bidirectional cross attention mechanism; constructing a dynamic memory library, and storing historical sample features by adopting a first-in first-out strategy; current sample features are used as query vectors, neighbor nodes are screened based on bimodal similarity, and a dynamic topological graph is constructed through an adaptive edge weight fusion module; and carrying out weighted aggregation and updating on the node features by adopting a lightweight graph neural network, and outputting a furnace condition recognition result. According to the method, a semi-supervised learning strategy is adopted, joint optimization is carried out in combination with cross entropy loss, Laplace loss and consistency loss, high-precision furnace condition recognition is achieved under the condition that only a small number of labeled samples are needed, and the method has the advantages of being light in weight, low in time delay and capable of supporting streaming incremental reasoning and is suitable for metallurgical industry field edge deployment.
claims: Method and apparatus for metallurgical furnace kiln condition identification method based on streaming multi-mode graph neural network.

title: MR passive positioning method based on graph neural network and environment modulation hybrid expert
abstract: The invention provides a measurement report (MR) passive positioning method based on a graph neural network and an environment modulation mixed expert. Firstly, a global macroscopic graph is constructed by extracting work parameters to extract high-order topological features of the whole network; secondly, creating a local microscopic subgraph for a single MR, and injecting a physical signal to measure priori for attention correction; then, performing loop adaptive modulation on node features by using feature linear modulation, and completing coordinate basic offset and fine compensation prediction through combination of a multi-expert hybrid network and an environment residual network; and finally, carrying out model optimization by adopting a Huber-Haversine joint loss function. The method effectively breaks through the limitation that the generalization ability is poor when traditional global single modeling faces a complex heterogeneous propagation environment, and greatly reduces long-tail positioning errors caused by non-line-of-sight propagation through the combined constraint of topology collaboration, physical prior injection and multi-expert routing. And finally, high-robustness and high-precision passive positioning of the mobile terminal in a large-scale cellular network scene is realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for mr passive positioning method based on graph neural network and environment modulation hybrid expert.
assignee: CHONGQING UNIV OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Graph neural network design method for Steiner point prediction based on obstacle avoidance strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a graph neural network design method for Steiner point prediction based on an obstacle avoidance strategy, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, reckoning or counting. The method comprises the steps of analyzing an input layout file and generating an enhanced hanan grid, screening a set of candidate Steiner points in the grid, constructing heterogeneous graph information of pins, obstacles and the candidate points, inputting a pre-constructed heterogeneous graph neural network, and outputting positions and mass scores of all the candidate Steiner points through a multi-head prediction mechanism. According to the method, a complex Steiner point combination explosion search problem is converted into a high-concurrency local sub-grid cooperative reasoning process by introducing a global topology prior graph neural network, and the calculation efficiency and the connection precision of generating the optimal tree are remarkably improved under the harsh obstacle constraint.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network design method for steiner point prediction based on obstacle avoidance strategy.
assignee: NANJING UNIV OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Multi-band motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding method based on shared graph convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention provides a multi-band motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding scheme based on a shared graph convolutional neural network. The multi-band motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring motor imagery electroencephalogram data of a user; preprocessing the motor imagery electroencephalogram data, and constructing an independent brain function connection diagram structure of each frequency band; sending the independent brain function connection graph structure of each frequency band and the corresponding original node data into a shared graph convolutional neural network to obtain electroencephalogram feature information of each frequency band; the obtained electroencephalogram feature information of each frequency band is merged and then sent to a multi-head attention network, and global electroencephalogram data features are extracted; performing classification processing on the global electroencephalogram data features; and performing embedded implementation on the trained model. According to the method, the problems of large parameter quantity and characteristic isolation between frequency bands of a traditional multi-frequency-band model are solved, and the cross-frequency-band electroencephalogram decoding precision under the small sample condition is remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-band motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding method based on shared graph convolutional neural network.

title: Parallel program hotspot function static identification method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a parallel program hotspot function static recognition method and system based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of high-performance computing program performance analys.The method comprises the steps that S1, function-level performance data are obtained through instrumentation, and a sample set is obtained after hotspot labeling, category balancing and graph scale cutting; s2, performing basic block semantic embedding to obtain node features, and performing gating graph neural network message transmission to obtain structural features; s3, sequence features and external features are extracted from adjacent matrixes of the control flow graph and the call graph through residual convolution; s4, inputting the calling graph into the graph attention network, and extracting attention features; and S5, splicing the structural features, the sequence features, the external features and the attention features, inputting the spliced features into a multi-layer perceptron with a weight for classification, and generating a hot function candidate list. The method can statically predict the potential hotspot function and automatically generate the function-level tracking filtering list only according to the intermediate representation compiled and produced by the source code on the premise of completely not needing any program pre-execution.
claims: Method and apparatus for parallel program hotspot function static identification method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Drainage basin meteorological station association forecasting method and system based on graph neural network modeling
abstract: The invention relates to a graph neural network modeling-based watershed meteorological station association forecasting method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent hydro-meteorological forecasting, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining digital elevation model data, a multi-source meteorological and hydrological historical data sequence and meteorological radar volume scanning basis data of a target region; obtaining a directed acyclic graph structure containing K sub-basin units; constructing a meteorological element background field, and generating a three-dimensional radar reflectivity factor cube aligned with the grid; generating an initial embedded feature set of each site at all moments in the historical time window; constructing a physical prior graph containing topological connection edges and terrain dynamic similar edges; generating a multi-step forecasting sequence including future rainfall of each station, future temperature of each station and future ex-warehouse flow of each sub-basin; and outputting the trained graph neural network forecasting model. According to the method, physical constraints such as basin space topology, water balance and temperature gradient are embedded into a model training process, and the precision and physical consistency of hydrological forecasting are effectively improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for drainage basin meteorological station association forecasting method and system based on graph neural network modeling.
assignee: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title: Multi-station ISAR space target small sample classification method based on sparse graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-station ISAR space target small sample classification method based on a sparse graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a small sample classification task including a support set and a query set based on an obtained to-be-classified multi-station ISAR image sample; inputting a to-be-classified multi-station ISAR image sample into the trained embedded network for feature extraction to obtain a multi-station embedded feature set; inputting the multi-station embedded feature set into a trained node initialization module, and constructing an initial node feature set comprising support child nodes, support father nodes, query child nodes and query father nodes; and inputting the initial node feature set into the trained sparse graph neural network, and outputting a prediction category label of a query set sample. According to the method, the number of connecting edges and the network parameter quantity are reduced, transmission of category-independent noise is effectively isolated, and higher flexibility and robustness are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for multi-station isar space target small sample classification method based on sparse graph neural network.

title: Cross-modal structure-function connection mapping method based on feature decoupling and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-modal structure-function connection mapping method based on feature decoupling and a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing and computer vision. According to the method, explicit decoupling of domain/task information and suppression of domain interference are realized, parallel heads including a domain head and a task head are set after a shared coding backbone is adopted, and constraints of complementary orthogonal loss and domain heterosexual loss are used, so that domain-related factors are concentrated to the domain, and task-related semantics are concentrated to the task; the graph-level vectors of the structure and the task are aligned in the feature space by adopting task consistent loss, the reconstruction loss is supervised by the truth value of the function diagram, the semantics which can be used for restoring the function diagram in the structure diagram are aligned, and a decoder can learn stable cross-modal mapping more easily.
claims: Method and apparatus for cross-modal structure-function connection mapping method based on feature decoupling and graph neural network.
assignee: UNIV OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title: Tray demand dynamic prediction and cooperative scheduling method and system based on causal discovery and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a tray demand dynamic prediction and cooperative scheduling method and system based on causal discovery and a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of a tray demand supply chain; generating a causal variable set and a lagging relation matrix based on a time sequence causal structure learning algorithm; in combination with the causal variable set and the lagging relation matrix, constructing a dynamic supply chain knowledge graph of which node attributes contain causal features; inputting the dynamic supply chain knowledge graph into a causal time sequence diagram attention network model, and outputting a tray demand space-time prediction result of each node in a plurality of preset periods in the future; and based on the tray demand space-time prediction result, generating a dynamic cooperative scheduling scheme including a tray allocation path, an inventory supplement strategy and a transport capacity allocation scheme. According to the embodiment of the invention, accurate prediction of tray demands can be realized, a global collaborative and dynamic adaptive intelligent scheduling scheme is formed, and the operation efficiency, the resource utilization rate and the anti-fluctuation robustness of a supply chain are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for tray demand dynamic prediction and cooperative scheduling method and system based on causal discovery and graph neural network.
assignee: ZHEJIANG JIUDING ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title: Alternating current and direct current hybrid power flow initial value estimation method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an alternating current and direct current hybrid power flow initial value estimation method and system based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of power flow calculation of a power system.The method comprises the steps that a power system is modeled into a graph structure, a node/edge encoder is used for mapping features to a hidden space, and a source-target-edge joint attention mechanism is introduced into message passing. The core is to design a composite loss function containing supervised loss and physical residual, and a two-stage progressive training strategy is adopted: in the first stage, pure supervised training is performed to obtain initialization parameters, and in the second stage, physical constraint fine tuning is introduced. Through the physical information neural network idea, the power flow equation is embedded into the training process, the problems that a traditional method is heavy in calculation burden, and a pure data driving method is poor in generalization ability and lack of physical consistency are solved, the high-precision alternating-current and direct-current power flow initial value can be rapidly generated, and the online analysis efficiency of a power system is remarkably improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for alternating current and direct current hybrid power flow initial value estimation method and system based on graph neural network.

title: Heterogeneous graph node classification method based on multi-view prototype enhanced graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a heterogeneous graph node classification method based on a multi-view prototype enhanced graph neural network, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and graph data mining. Aiming at the problems of insufficient multi-relation semantic description, insufficient multi-view fusion, insufficient category prior utilization and the like of the existing method, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a multi-view homogeneous graph structure based on meta-path and node feature similarity; secondly, constructing a multi-view series graph convolutional network, and sequentially executing graph volume integration and residual connection on each view in each layer; building a category prototype based on the training label nodes, carrying out index moving average updating, and endowing the unknown label nodes with pseudo labels; and finally, carrying out intra-class sorting on the same type of nodes, inputting the same type of nodes into a one-dimensional convolutional network to extract intra-class features, carrying out prototype fusion and splicing mapping to obtain final node representation, and carrying out classification. According to the method, the precision and robustness of heterogeneous graph node classification are remarkably improved, and the method is suitable for recommendation systems, social network analysis and knowledge graphs.
claims: Method and apparatus for heterogeneous graph node classification method based on multi-view prototype enhanced graph neural network.

title: Pneumatic optimization method based on physical enhancement graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an aerodynamic optimization method based on a physical enhancement graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an airfoil design demand and a plurality of working condition constraints, carrying out the parameterization of an airfoil through a class function/shape function transformation method, and generating candidate airfoil geometry; constructing a physical enhancement graph structure based on candidate airfoil profile surface discrete points, and taking node coordinates, local curvatures and unit normal vectors as node features; carrying out multi-fidelity training on the physical enhancement graph neural network by utilizing the low-fidelity aerodynamic data and the high-fidelity aerodynamic data to obtain a proxy model for predicting the aerodynamic performance of the airfoil; using the proxy model to carry out iterative optimization under the constraint of multiple working conditions by adopting a differential evolution algorithm; historical trajectory archiving is carried out on candidate airfoil profile parameters, aerodynamic performance predicted values and constraint states in the optimization process, and explicit design rules between the airfoil profile parameters and aerodynamic performance are extracted through symbolic regression. According to the method, the high-fidelity simulation calling cost can be reduced, and the multi-working-condition airfoil optimization efficiency is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for pneumatic optimization method based on physical enhancement graph neural network.

title: Garment customization quotation prediction method and system based on knowledge graph and graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a clothing customization quotation prediction method and system based on a knowledge graph and a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining clothing customization demand data, and extracting entity types, entity attributes and relationships between entities in a corresponding clothing customization order based on the clothing customization demand data; instantiating the extracted entity type, the entity attribute and the relationship between the entities by using a pre-constructed process knowledge graph of the clothing manufacturing field to construct a process execution sub-graph for the corresponding clothing customization order; wherein the set is a node set and an edge set; inputting the constructed process execution subgraph into a pre-trained prediction model, and outputting a clothing customization quotation prediction result; wherein the prediction model comprises a physical constraint coupling layer and a process adaptive graph neural network, and the physical constraint coupling layer is used for taking a physical conservation edge in the process execution subgraph as a hard constraint. According to the method, real-time accurate prediction of the garment customization quotation can be realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for garment customization quotation prediction method and system based on knowledge graph and graph neural network.

title: Component circuit board defect detection method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a component circuit board defect detection method based on a graph neural network, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an optical image and a list coordinate of a circuit board, and extracting welding spots, pins and wiring features to form a fine-grained entity; constructing an electrical connection and spatial adjacency relation to generate a multi-relation structure diagram and a gating matrix; graph neural network coding is carried out on the multi-relation structure graph to obtain structural representation, and abnormal evidence and complexity indexes are generated; determining a cluster number in defect sensitive pooling and fusing to generate a fine-grained distribution matrix; forming device-level structure characterization based on distribution matrix aggregation and outputting device-level defect judgment; and outputting a final defect result through interlayer mutual identification and local re-pooling.
