Based on the multi-relation perceptual graph neural network and the defect sensitive hierarchical pooling method, the structural joint judgment of the defects of the component circuit board is realized, and the method has the advantages of high detection accuracy, high stability and low false detection rate.
claims: Method and apparatus for component circuit board defect detection method based on graph neural network.
assignee: SHANGHAI YINENGDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title: Grid smoothing method and system based on physical embedded graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a grid smoothing method and system based on a physical embedded graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial tetrahedral mesh data and carrying out Gaussian enhanced physical embedding feature coding; carrying out local deformation modeling and feature updating based on Jacobian guidance; initial displacement is calculated through anisotropic attention aggregation and a self-adaptive gating mechanism; executing microline search, and outputting a final smooth grid; and end-to-end model training based on symmetric Dirichlet energy. According to the method, the physical mechanics principle and the graph neural network are deeply fused, and the quality of the three-dimensional grid is efficiently and robustly improved on the premise of thoroughly eliminating grid inversion.
claims: Method and apparatus for grid smoothing method and system based on physical embedded graph neural network.

title: Quantum error mitigation learning method and device based on graph neural network
abstract: According to the quantum error mitigation learning method and device based on the graph neural network, useful information can be extracted from recent hardware without generating too high resource consumption, and the performance cannot be reduced under the condition that complex hardware effects such as crosstalk and readout errors exist. The method comprises the following steps: (1) collecting a real quantum circuit; (2) mapping the real quantum circuit into a directed graph; constructing a node feature matrix; constructing an edge feature set, and depicting a double-bit gate error rate and coupling information; (3) extracting a global statistical feature vector; (4) inputting the directed graph into the graph neural network model for message passing to obtain a graph structure embedded vector; (5) fusing the graph structure embedded vector with the global statistical vector to obtain a joint representation vector; (6) performing adaptive prediction based on the joint representation vector, and mapping the unified embedding into predictors of different semantic spaces; and (7) outputting the quantum circuit observation value after error mitigation.
claims: Method and apparatus for quantum error mitigation learning method and device based on graph neural network.

title: Power device electrothermal analysis method based on physical information graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a power device electrothermal analysis method based on a physical information graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining grid data of a power device generated by simulation software; inputting the grid data of the power device structure into a thermal analysis model to obtain an electric thermal field distribution result of the power device; wherein the thermal analysis model is constructed based on a physical information graph neural network, is fused with electrothermal equation constraints, and comprises an encoder part used for converting grid data of a power device into nodes and edges of a graph structure, and embedding features to obtain node features; the processor part is used for iteratively updating the node features through a multi-layer message passing network and a multi-layer perceptron connected with a residual error; and the decoder part is used for mapping the updated node characteristics through a multi-layer perceptron to obtain an electrothermal field distribution result of the power device. According to the invention, efficient analysis of static characteristics and transient electric heat of the power device can be realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for power device electrothermal analysis method based on physical information graph neural network.
assignee: SHANGHAI INST OF MICROSYSTEM AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title: Automatic fusion method and system based on knowledge distillation and graph neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of knowledge automatic fusion, and particularly relates to an automatic fusion method and system based on knowledge distillation and a graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: collecting multi-source heterogeneous urban construction project data, extracting a teacher-student model Logit vector, and generating softening probability distribution; teacher knowledge correction loss and non-target category relation extraction loss are calculated based on Logit variance, distillation training is completed in combination with cross entropy loss, and a semantic feature extraction student model is obtained; pairwise connected graphs are constructed based on source and target ontologies, multi-dimensional similarity features are fused, cross-ontology entity matching results are output after convolutional neural network processing, and standardized unified fusion of multi-source urban construction knowledge is realized. The problems that urban construction knowledge is heterogeneous and disordered, the manual fusion efficiency is low, the matching precision is poor, and automatic iteration updating is difficult are solved.
claims: Method and apparatus for automatic fusion method and system based on knowledge distillation and graph neural network.

title: Cable partial discharge incremental learning method and system based on graph convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention provides a cable partial discharge incremental learning method and system based on a graph convolutional neural network, and relates to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring and intelligent fault diagnosis, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining historical partial discharge data and new input partial discharge data; carrying out preprocessing, equalization and graph structure feature construction on the data; establishing a basic recognition model based on the pre-training graph convolutional neural network and freezing an encoder; historical data features and new input data features are extracted, and the maximum mean value difference and the average Euclidean distance are combined to discriminate the incremental task type; and according to the distribution difference in the class increment scene or the inter-domain difference in the domain increment scene, adaptively adjusting the model weight to update the step length, completing model iteration, and outputting a partial discharge type identification result. According to the method, continuous learning of newly-added similar different-domain data and newly-added defect type data can be adaptively realized under the condition that an overall model is not retrained, and old knowledge maintenance and new knowledge absorption are both considered.
claims: Method and apparatus for cable partial discharge incremental learning method and system based on graph convolutional neural network.

title: Graph neural network-based power grid cascading failure propagation path identification method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a power grid cascading failure propagation path identification method and system based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: mapping a bus, a line and a transformer into graph nodes and connecting edges, and constructing a power grid topological graph carrying real-time power flow data, a protection action signal and a switching value state; calibrating a fault immune node by using double criteria and stripping the fault immune node, and redistributing a power flow load to a residual connecting edge according to a capacity margin proportion to obtain a contraction subgraph; inputting the contracted sub-graphs into a graph neural network to perform multilayer neighborhood aggregation, outputting risk scores of each node and screening an active leading-edge node set; and extracting a node difference at adjacent moments as a propagation increment according to a time sequence, restoring a cascading failure diffusion trajectory, and outputting a failure propagation path and an equipment risk rating. According to the invention, the accuracy of fault propagation path identification and equipment risk rating in a complex cascading fault scene is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network-based power grid cascading failure propagation path identification method and system.
assignee: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title: Graph neural network brain disease prediction system based on mechanism driving and causal decoupling
abstract: The invention discloses a graph neural network brain disease prediction system based on mechanism driving and causal decoupling. The method belongs to the cross technical field of artificial intelligence and medical image analysis. A variational auto-encoder and clinical consistency are introduced to construct a priori group diagram of a reward and punishment motivator, and conflicting noise edges are actively stripped to construct a high-purity topological base. And in combination with TopK pooling of the double-branch GTUNet and parallel FFT frequency domain branches, double-track cascade extraction of the spatial topology and the temporal neural rhythm of the core pathological hub is accurately realized. Through hierarchical bidirectional cross attention and a gating mechanism, image and phenotypic semantics are deeply aligned, and low-quality modal interference is thoroughly immunized. Finally, a causal adversarial decoupling mechanism is originally created, a gradient inversion layer (GRL) maximum and minimum game and space orthogonal constraint are utilized, the backbone network is forced to erase heterogeneity environmental noise of multi-center scanning equipment, and the pure disease biomarker with extremely high cross-domain robustness is successfully purified.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network brain disease prediction system based on mechanism driving and causal decoupling.

title: Credit anti-fraud method and system fusing multi-modal data and graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a credit anti-fraud method and system fusing multi-modal data and a graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of financial credit anti-fraud, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting the multi-modal data of a credit applicant, and carrying out the preprocessing of the data; s2, performing forged feature detection on the multi-modal data, and synchronously associating a time sequence corresponding relationship between physiological reaction and test content; s3, calculating a single-mode risk score and a comprehensive credit risk score of the applicant; s4, judging the credit fraud behavior of the applicant based on the comprehensive credit risk score and a preset judgment level; and S5, outputting an anti-fraud detection result. Through verification of multi-modal data, social association verification data and physiological reaction data are adopted to form cross verification of subjective and objective information, fraudulent behaviors are rapidly identified, common information, equipment and other characteristics of fraudulent gangs are identified, the gang fraud identification accuracy is improved, and the limitation of dependence on a single data dimension is avoided.
claims: Method and apparatus for credit anti-fraud method and system fusing multi-modal data and graph neural network.

title: Shale reservoir cross-scale pore characterization method and system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention provides a shale reservoir cross-scale pore characterization method and system based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of rock physical parameter evaluation and artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: cooperatively obtaining nuclear magnetic resonance echo data and scanning electron microscope or micron CT image data of a shale sample; performing pore segmentation on the image data and constructing a pore topological graph; relaxation features are extracted from the echo data, and initial inversion is executed to obtain initial T2 distribution; inputting the topological graph, the relaxation features and the initial T2 distribution into a graph neural network multi-modal fusion model to generate an adaptive correction function; performing nonlinear reconstruction on the initial T2 distribution by using the correction function to obtain corrected T2 distribution; and outputting a full-scale pore size distribution model and multiphase fluid saturation. According to the method, physical constraint correction of the high-resolution image on the nuclear magnetic signal is realized through feature level fusion, the problem of multiplicity of solutions of ill-conditioned inversion of the nuclear magnetic resonance T2 spectrum is solved, and the pore characterization precision of the shale reservoir is improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for shale reservoir cross-scale pore characterization method and system based on graph neural network.
assignee: HANGZHOU HARMONY CLOUD TECH CO LTD

title: Fetal congenital heart disease intervention decision support information processing method and system based on dynamic knowledge graph and interpretable graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a fetal congenital heart disease intervention decision support information processing method and a fetal congenital heart disease intervention decision support information processing system based on a dynamic knowledge graph and an interpretable graph neural network, which are used for solving the problem of lack of interpretability and individual adaptability in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a static global map containing medical ontology constraints; mapping the multi-modal clinical data to an atlas standard entity by using deep learning; generating a local sub-graph taking the case node as the center in the computing memory, and embedding the local sub-graph into the global graph to form a fusion graph; carrying out feature propagation and multi-head attention calculation by adopting a graph attention network, and outputting a confidence score of an intervention scheme; an interpretable auxiliary report is generated through limited beam search and meta-path filtering. According to the method, the logic constraint of the knowledge graph and the representation capability of the graph neural network are fused, and accurate, transparent and individualized auxiliary decision support is provided.
claims: Method and apparatus for fetal congenital heart disease intervention decision support information processing method and system based on dynamic knowledge graph and interpretable graph neural network.

title: Image processing method and image processing device based on graph neural network, and computing equipment
abstract: The invention provides an image processing method based on a graph neural network, an image processing device and computing equipment. The image processing method comprises the steps of obtaining a center line of a blood vessel based on a three-dimensional medical image containing the blood vessel; a plurality of nodes are arranged on each center line, and cross sections corresponding to the nodes are obtained; obtaining rays pointing to the pipe wall in a plurality of directions by taking the node as the center in each cross section; sampling is carried out along a plurality of sampling points on each ray, data of all the sampling points on each ray are constructed into feature sequences, each feature sequence is used as a vertex to construct a graph structure, and the vertex comprises intensity change features corresponding to the ray direction; and based on the graph structure and the trained graph neural network, predicting a target length from each node to the tube wall in the corresponding ray direction, and reconstructing the blood vessel according to the target length in each ray direction. Therefore, the prediction precision of the lumen inner diameter of the reconstructed blood vessel can be remarkably improved, and the reconstructed blood vessel is closer to the anatomical form of a real blood vessel.
claims: Method and apparatus for image processing method and image processing device based on graph neural network, and computing equipment.

title: Discrete manufacturing enterprise energy consumption prediction method based on multi-scale dynamic causal graph neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial energy management, and discloses a discrete manufacturing enterprise energy consumption prediction method based on a multi-scale dynamic cause and effect graph neural network, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the historical energy consumption data of each production unit of an enterprise, and constructing a time series data set; calculating a causal relationship between production units based on transfer entropy, constructing dynamic causal diagrams of a short-term time scale and a middle-term time scale, and fusing the dynamic causal diagrams with the static diagrams to form a mixed diagram structure; time features and space features are extracted at the same time, a multi-head attention mechanism and multi-scale time convolution are adopted in time feature extraction, and space feature extraction is based on a Mix-Hop graph convolution network; and designing a double-stage aggregation prediction module, learning contribution degree weights of all production units to the total energy consumption in the first stage, and performing weighted feature aggregation and estimating the total energy consumption features in the second stage based on contribution degrees. According to the method, the implicit causal relationship between the production units can be modeled under the condition of lacking production data, and the prediction precision of the total energy consumption of the discrete manufacturing enterprise and the interpretability of the prediction model are improved.
claims: Method and apparatus for discrete manufacturing enterprise energy consumption prediction method based on multi-scale dynamic causal graph neural network.

title: Graph neural network NS partial differential equation solving method based on physical perception and cross-scale distillation
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of partial differential equation solving, and particularly discloses a graph neural network NS partial differential equation solving method based on physical perception and cross-scale distillation, and the method comprises the following steps: preparing a multi-scale physical topological graph based on fluid dynamics, and carrying out projection mapping; carrying out physical residual perception and cross-scale feature gating distribution; performing double-track system cross distillation and dynamic evolution optimization; and outputting a partial differential equation joint solution prediction field after evolution iteration. According to the method, extreme calculation cost and grid overhead are reduced, and the limitation of grid degree-of-freedom explosion faced by a traditional numerical solution when a macroscopic flow field and a microscopic high-frequency structure are considered is broken through; the defects of spectrum deviation and global information transmission delay of a traditional single scale map neural network are overcome, high-frequency microscopic details (such as shock waves and boundary layer eddy currents) are prevented from being efficiently decoupled and accurately expressed, and cross-band physical characteristics are achieved.
claims: Method and apparatus for graph neural network ns partial differential equation solving method based on physical perception and cross-scale distillation.

title: Bridge safety prediction method based on combination of space-time heterogeneous graph neural network and digital twinning
abstract: The invention relates to a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network and digital twinborn combined bridge safety prediction method, which comprises the following steps of: constructing five types of heterogeneous graph structures comprising environment nodes, vehicle load nodes, cable nodes, main beam section nodes and tower section nodes, and defining six edge types to describe mechanical transmission paths among components of a cable-stayed bridge; establishing ST-HGNN, utilizing a load position matrix to realize structured expression of time-space continuity characteristics of vehicle loads, capturing spatial correlation and time evolution laws of structural response through heterogeneous graph convolution and a long-short-term memory network, and directly outputting the failure probability of a cable-stayed bridge system by adopting a graph classification task; the ST-HGNN and the DT model are fused, a corrected DT response result serves as virtual sensing and is fed back to the ST-HGNN, and a high-frequency online closed loop is formed; and regular inspection data is introduced to carry out low-frequency calibration on the system, error accumulation and model drift in long-term operation are effectively inhibited through a strategy of tightening a static parameter constraint threshold and keeping a load unconstrained, and accurate monitoring and long-term stable prediction of the safety state of the cable-stayed bridge are realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for bridge safety prediction method based on combination of space-time heterogeneous graph neural network and digital twinning.

title: DATA PROCESSING SYSTEM AND METHOD OF DETECTING NOISE AND REDUNDANCY OF MULTI-SENSOR DATA USING GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: [0001a]    [그래프 신경망을 이용하여 멀티 센서 데이터의 노이즈 및 중복을 탐지하는 데이터 처리 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 상기 데이터 처리 시스템에 사용되는 데이터 처리기는 복수의 센서들과의 통신 연결 통로인 통신부 및 상기 센서들로부터 수집된 멀티 센서 데이터를 이용하여 상기 멀티 센서 데이터의 적어도 일부에 대응하는 노드들을 포함하는 그래프를 생성하고, 상기 노드들 중 노이즈 또는 중복 데이터에 해당하는 노드에 대하여 기본 손실 함수에 패널티를 추가하여 상기 노이즈 또는 상기 중복 데이터를 감소시키는 데이터 처리부를 포함하는한다. ]
claims: Method and apparatus for data processing system and method of detecting noise and redundancy of multi-sensor data using graph neural network.
assignee: MYONGJI UNIV INDUSTRY AND ACADEMIA COOPERATION FOUNDATION [KR]

title: Deep neural network reasoning optimization method and device based on calculation graph memory peak valley analysis, medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a deep neural network reasoning optimization method and device based on calculation graph memory peak valley analysis, a medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of neural network model deployment, the method is applied to deploying a neural network model on a calculation device, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a to-be-optimized calculation graph; determining an execution sequence according to operator dependence, counting tensor distribution release behaviors, and generating a memory occupation sequence; identifying a peak operator through a sliding window and dividing a peak region; traversing along the dependency graph by taking the non-peak operators as starting points, and aggregating continuous non-peak operators as valley regions; memory reduction optimization is applied to the peak region, performance enhancement optimization is applied to the valley region, and an optimization graph is generated; and calculating the peak memory and delay, if the constraint is satisfied, outputting, otherwise, adjusting strategy iteration. Through global modeling, peak-valley division, differentiation optimization and iterative evaluation, peak memory and performance are balanced, and an effective means is provided for efficient deployment of the deep neural network in a memory limited scene.
claims: Method and apparatus for deep neural network reasoning optimization method and device based on calculation graph memory peak valley analysis, medium and product.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD TO LEVERAGE AGENTIC FOUNDATIONAL MODELS TO ENHANCE GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS IN MOBILE COMMUNICATION
abstract: Enhanced network graphs and graph neural networks (GNNs) are disclosed. In a system that includes a radio access network and a radio intelligent controller (RIC), the RIC is configured to receive multi-modal data along with other data. Semantic features from the multi-modal data are combined with features from the other data. The combined features are used to enhance a network graph of the network and to train a GNN whose feature embeddings are enhanced with the multi-modal data. Decisions made in the network may be based on the feature embeddings, which account for multi-modal data and network inter-dependencies.
claims: Method and apparatus for system and method to leverage agentic foundational models to enhance graph neural networks in mobile communication.

title: Campus implicit spoofing detection method based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a campus implicit spoofing detection method based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the following steps: collecting consumption track data of students in a campus, and extracting a feature vector of each consumption; a dynamic time warping algorithm is used to calculate trajectory similarity between students, and a space-time co-occurrence network is constructed; introducing a time decay mechanism to calculate an edge weight, and capturing a near cause effect of the social relationship; extracting centrality indexes, clustering coefficients and social entropies from the network as node features; constructing a graph convolution auto-encoder model, carrying out unsupervised anomaly detection by adopting reconstruction errors, and introducing contrast regularization to improve anomaly discrimination; and determining an abnormal node related to the spoofing based on a comparison result of the abnormal score and a dynamic threshold value. According to the method, the network construction precision is remarkably improved, the unsupervised detection precision is high, the anomaly detection distinction degree is high, and a sufficient time window is provided for early intervention of schools and parents.
claims: Method and apparatus for campus implicit spoofing detection method based on graph neural network.

title: Laser scanning tire pattern recognition system based on graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a laser scanning tire pattern recognition system based on a graph neural network, and the system comprises a collection and preprocessing module which is used for collecting and preprocessing three-dimensional scanning data, and obtaining three-dimensional pattern representation; the structure extraction module is used for generating a node set and an edge set according to the three-dimensional pattern representation; the topological composition module is used for constructing a pattern topological graph and determining node features and edge features; the improved graph Markov neural network module is used for outputting a node state result and a graph level recognition result; the consistency propagation module is used for obtaining an identification result after consistency correction; and the output recording module is used for generating category judgment and confidence and completing recording and output. According to the invention, by improving the graph Markov neural network and the pattern topology consistency propagation module, stable and high-precision identification and similar pattern disambiguation of the tire pattern are realized.
claims: Method and apparatus for laser scanning tire pattern recognition system based on graph neural network.
assignee: HUIXIANG INTELLIGENT TECH TIANJIN CO LTD

title: Power grid fault positioning and isolating method of fusion graph neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a power grid fault positioning and isolating method based on a fusion graph neural network, and relates to the technical field of power systems and automation of the power systems. An event credibility feature is generated in the event evidence graph based on an event generation moment, an event receiving moment, a communication state, a topology version number, an adjacent equipment state and a telemetry switch consistency feature; a circuit breaker locking event, a feeder terminal fault indication event, a ring main unit switch remote signaling deflection event and a telemetering abnormal event can form evidence association in the same graph data.
claims: Method and apparatus for power grid fault positioning and isolating method of fusion graph neural network.
